location: Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States of America
description:
Director, US Oncology Internal Communications and Above Brand Campaigns Gaithersburg, MDUS Corporate Affairs Hybrid Work- on average 3 days/week in office

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing and commercializing medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. In Oncology, we are working to redefine cancer care with the ambition to one day eliminate cancer as a cause of death.

The Director, US Oncology Internal Communications and Above Brand Campaigns will play a central role in helping employees understand, connect with and deliver against the US Oncology strategy. As part of the US Oncology Corporate Affairs team, this person will lead internal communications across the organization and support select above-brand campaigns that strengthen AstraZeneca Oncology’s reputation and impact in the US.

This role is ideal for a thoughtful communicator and strong project leader who can turn complex business, scientific and organizational information into clear, engaging stories. You will advise leaders, shape communications plans, manage high-visibility internal moments and help bring signature oncology campaigns to life through partnerships, events, social content, earned media and agency collaboration.

What You'll Do

  • Lead internal communications for US Oncology, helping employees understand business priorities, key milestones, organizational changes and the broader oncology strategy.

  • Develop integrated communications plans that drive employee engagement, support business objectives and align with US Oncology and AstraZeneca priorities.

  • Counsel senior leaders on messaging, sequencing, tone, style and channel strategy, particularly during moments of change or high visibility.

  • Lead and execute organizational announcements and internal change management counsel

  • Lead the planning and delivery of senior leadership forums and strategic business meetings, partnering closely with the SVP of US Oncology to shape agendas, develop executive communications, align leadership teams, and drive key business priorities.

  • Plan and deliver internal flagship programs and channels, including webinars, leadership updates, Nucleus articles, Workplace content, short-form video and other digital storytelling formats.

  • Lead the US Oncology internal editorial calendar, ensuring communications are timely, coordinated, audience-focused and connected to business priorities.

  • Translate complex scientific, medical, commercial and organizational information into clear and compelling content for internal audiences.

  • Use employee insights, engagement trends and business context to identify communications opportunities, risks and areas for improvement.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical, HR, Legal, Compliance and other teams to ensure aligned planning and execution.

  • Lead the strategy, development, and execution of above-brand communications and reputation programs, including partnerships, consumer engagement, events, earned media, social and digital content, and other high-impact initiatives.

  • Lead key partnership initiatives focused on community engagement, building strategic collaborations that strengthen corporate reputation, deepen stakeholder relationships, and advance business priorities.

  • Manage agency and vendor partners to deliver communications materials, campaign assets, events and program milestones with quality and efficiency.

  • Measure communications performance and use data, feedback and insights to strengthen content, channels and overall impact.

Essential for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 7-10 years of experience in internal communications, corporate communications, public relations, agency communications or a related field.

  • Ability to develop and implement integrated, multi-channel communications strategies and plans.

  • Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for different audiences.

  • Experience advising senior leaders and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed organization.

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to handle priorities, deadlines, resources, agencies and multiple workstreams at once.

  • Strong understanding of digital, social and employee engagement channels, including how to tailor content by platform and audience.

  • Experience using data and analytics to evaluate communications, improve engagement and demonstrate impact.

  • Ability to understand scientific and medical information, or demonstrated ability to learn complex subject matter quickly.

  • High personal accountability, sound judgment, strong collaboration skills, and attention to detail.

Desirable for the role

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing or a related field.

  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology or oncology communications.

  • Experience working for a communications and public relations agency

  • Experience supporting commercial, sales, marketing or field communications.

  • Experience with above-brand campaigns, corporate reputation programs, consumer engagement initiatives or partnerships.

  • Experience managing communications agencies, vendors or external partners.

  • Knowledge of the US healthcare environment and issues affecting oncology care.

  • Experience producing short-form video, digital storytelling or social content for internal or external audiences.

  • Experience supporting organizational change communications, employee engagement or culture-building initiatives.

Key Skills and Attributes

  • Clear, concise and audience-first communicator.

  • Strategic thinker who connects communications to business priorities and employee needs.

  • Trusted collaborator who builds strong relationships across teams and functions.

  • Organized project leader who can manage complex work in a fast-moving environment.

  • Creative storyteller with strong editorial judgment and a feel for compelling content.

  • Calm and effective when navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities and sensitive information.

  • Proactive problem solver who spots risks, finds opportunities and improves ways of working.

Office Working Requirements

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. title: ServiceNow Engineer III
description:

The ServiceNow Engineer III is a senior technical contributor within ServiceNow platform team, responsible for advanced platform development, enterprise integrations, and ongoing optimization of the organization's ServiceNow environment. This role provides hands-on development expertise across scripting, integrations, and custom applications, and provides guidance to junior team members on the team. Partners with platform architects and the CMDB Manager on solution design to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable implementations. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical, independent senior developer who can take on the platform's most complex build work while mentoring junior team members.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience: 10+ years of ServiceNow development/engineering experience, including advanced server-side and client-side scripting

Travel: 0-5%

Work Schedule: This position works between the hours of 7 AM and 5 PM, Monday- Friday. However, work may be performed at any time on any day of the week to meet business needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Advanced Platform Development & Scripting

  • Develop and enhance ServiceNow functionality using server-side and client-side scripting, including Glide API, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Scheduled Jobs.
  • Design, develop, and configure complex ServiceNow modules, including ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Request), Service Catalog, Flow Designer, and custom applications.

Integrations & Automation

  • Evaluate and implement AI-enabled automation use cases (e.g., Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence) to extend platform capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to ServiceNow functionality, performance, and data integrity across environments.

Platform Support & Upgrades

  • Support platform upgrades, instance cloning, and multi-instance environments, including regression testing and customization remediation.
  • Partner with platform architects and the CMDB Manager on solution design to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable implementations.
  • Maintain working familiarity with Domain Separation and multi-tenant architecture considerations as they affect development work.

Code Quality & Mentorship

  • Participate in and lead code reviews, enforcing coding standards and platform best practices.
  • Mentor junior team members on scripting techniques, debugging, and platform conventions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for developed solutions, integrations, and customizations.

title: Product Manager, Associate – Business Finance Technology
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Business Description:

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTI) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone’s businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency, and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTI is fast paced and entrepreneurial – our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development means that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge

Role:

This role is responsible for leading and executing product and project workstreams across a varied set of stakeholders, with a strong emphasis on engineering-aligned solution delivery. You will partner closely with Finance and Operations teams across the firm –including Real Estate and Private Equity to design and implement scalable, code-driven solutions that automate complex business processes and calculation models.

The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of product, business analysis, and engineering – either an engineer transitioning into product/business roles or a product manager/business analyst with strong technical fluency.

All projects are prioritized and selected to achieve measurable operational efficiencies and contribute to our stakeholders’ technology strategy.

Responsibilities:

  • Translate business needs into clear, structured technical requirements, including data models, logic flows, and system interactions

  • Partner closely with engineering teams to design scalable, maintainable solutions using modern programming languages and architectures

  • Identify and drive opportunities to re-platform or modernize legacy solutions into modern code-based implementations

  • Design, build, and implement solutions leveraging the most appropriate technologies (e.g., Python, SQL, cloud-based services)

  • Contribute to solution architecture discussions, including trade-offs across performance, scalability, and maintainability

  • Manage project delivery – define milestones, track progress, and provide clear updates to stakeholders

  • Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) with a focus on validating logic, data integrity, and system behavior

  • Oversee data migration, reconciliation, and validation, ensuring accuracy and auditability of outputs

  • Collaborate with offshore and affiliate teams with an emphasis on clear technical communication and alignment

  • Serve as a technical-functional bridge, supporting end users while guiding adoption of more robust, engineering-driven solutions

  • Promote and establish best practices in system design, data management, and process automation

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or software engineering, preferably in a hybrid or highly technical role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field

  • Prior experience in real estate or private equity along with knowledge of performance calculations, deal life cycle, forecasting, and investor reporting

  • Demonstrated experience working closely with engineering teams and translate business requirements into implementable technical specifications

  • Strong working knowledge of programming and data manipulation (e.g., Python, SQL APIs, data pipelines, or backend logic preferred)

  • Experience designing or contributing to code-based solutions (beyond configuration-driven tools)

  • Familiarity with software development concepts: version control, testing, modular design, and deployment practices

  • Experience with modern data/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma) with an understanding of underlying data structures

  • Exposure to cloud platforms or modern data architectures is a plus

  • Experience operating as a hands-on individual contributor while influencing technical direction

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with comfort operating in complex environments

  • Excellent communication skills, with experience bridging business and technical audiences effectively

  • Experience summarizing complex concepts succinctly for senior stakeholders

  • Comfortable working in a global, cross-functional team environment

title: Systems Administrator (Systems) III
description:

Now Hiring at AMERICAN SYSTEMS

Epsilon, Inc. has joined AMERICAN SYSTEMS! As one organization, we offer expanded resources, streamlined operations, and increased opportunities for growth and development.

Join us to be part of a dynamic, collaborative environment dedicated to innovation and customer success.

An Average Day: As the System Administrator (Systems) III you will lead the support for various operating systems, including VMware, Storage, and appliance-based systems, while taking on a significant responsibility for backup and restore support, security, antivirus technologies, and application support. Execute change management procedures, troubleshoot complex computer hardware issues, and assess new server hardware and software requirements.   • Manage maintenance tasks and maintain meticulous inventory records of all servers and server-related equipment and software.
  • Develop and uphold standard procedures for routine and recurring activities, ensuring efficiency and consistency.
  • Lead backup and restore support efforts, overseeing the health of the backup environment, including annual restore tests, and managing communication/troubleshooting for failed backups, including database backup and restore.

​​At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancer.​

​​We are professionals with purpose, beating cancer every day. But we need to go much further and much faster. That’s why we’re looking for someone talented, someone who wants to develop their skills, someone like you. ​

We’re looking for a motivated store assistant to join Cancer Research UK’s trading team. You’ll be acting as an ambassador for Cancer Research UK. Your shop will be a place where your community gets to meet our people, understand our brand, and see some of the great things we do.

You’ll also be surrounded by people who are as dedicated to beating cancer as you are.

  • Assisting with maintaining shop standards including visual presentation, safeguarding compliance and health and safety.

  • Creating relationships with your local community and Cancer Research UK colleagues.

  • Supporting fundraising events for your store to achieve fundraising targets.

  • Taking keyholder responsibility as required (training provided).

  • There will be a varied amount of manual handling and physical activity required within the day-to-day duties of the role.

What are you looking for?

  • An understanding of what makes great customer service.

  • Experience of working in a busy customer service environment.

  • The ability to manage your own workload and work independently when required.

  • The ability to work well in a team.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Flexibility, our retail teams cover the needs of their stores by working on a rota basis. Whilst a level of flexibility is needed to meet the needs of the business, we don’t forget that you have a life outside of work too.

[Download the Candidate Pack]

What will I gain?

We make sure you are supported by a generous salary and benefits package, a wide range of career and personal development opportunities and high-quality tools, policies and processes to enable you to do your job well.

Our benefits package includes a substantial retirement plan, a generous and flexible leave allowance, discounts on anything from travel to technology, gym membership, and much more.

Our work – from funding cutting-edge research to developing public policy – will change the world. It’s exciting to be part of our team.

Our retail teams also have access to confidential wellbeing support from the Retail Trust.

How do I apply?

CVs are required for all applications; but we won’t be able to view them until we invite you for an interview. Instead, we ask you to complete the work history section of the online application form for us to be able to assess you quickly, fairly and objectively.

Owing to the nature of this position, any offer of employment for this role will be subject to a satisfactory basic DBS check.

title: Intern – Data Engineer (Hybrid: Onsite & Remote)
description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE

Join Our Community of Food People!

The US Foods Summer Internship Program provides a forum for students to apply classroom skills and academic training in a real-world business environment. In addition to being assigned business-impacting projects throughout the summer, students will be matched with a manager who will meet with them on a regular basis to provide direction on assignments as well as deliver performance feedback and a mentor who will be available to offer day-to-day guidance and support.

Interns will also get exposure to US Foods executive leadership; have an opportunity to participate in learning and social events with other interns across business functions and have an opportunity to deliver an end of summer presentation to showcase their accomplishments with key business leaders.

US Foods internships are full-time paid positions (40 hours per week from June - August) with the possibility of transitioning to a full-time position post-graduation dependent on availability and overall performance.

This position has been segmented as Hybrid meaning the work is a combination of onsite and remote.

Please note: We are unable to provide internships to students that require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., OPT, F-1, H-1B or any other visa status) now or in the future.

Local candidates are encouraged to apply. For qualified students whose permanent home of record is located outside 50 miles from US Foods Corporate HQ, a sign-on bonus will be offered to partially offset housing costs for the summer.

BASIC PURPOSE:

With direct supervision and oversight, this intern position provides exposure and opportunity to investigate a career, gain business knowledge and practical application of data engineering within the food distribution industry.

The Data Engineering intern is responsible for the development and implementation of data pipeline solutions to support the organization’s reporting, analytics, and other data needs. The developer will work closely with stakeholders across functional areas to deliver well-structured data in a reliable, efficient, and timely way.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and build large scale datasets for a wide range of consumer needs
  • Build, test and implement highly efficient data pipelines using a variety of technologies
  • Ensure consistent use of standard data structures
  • Analyze new data sources to understand quality, availability and content
  • Write technical design documentation
  • Create and executes unit tests
  • Supports QA team during testing

BASIC REQUIREMENTS:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems/Science or related area of study
  • Must be enrolled in school during internship
  • Typically, students currently between their Junior and Senior years or between their 1st and 2nd years of graduate school will be considered for internships
  • Proven ability to model data for reporting and analytics needs
  • Proven ability to analyze and understand existing processes and code
  • Works and communicates effectively with all levels of management
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills
  • Must work well within team-oriented environments

PREFERRED SKILLS:

Proficiency in one or more of the following:

  • SQL
  • Oracle, MySQL, other relational databases
  • Python
  • AWS (ERM, Lambda, IAM, S3)
  • Linux
  • ETL experience
  • Exposure to Cloud Environments

Familiarity with:

  • Use of CI/CD tools (Chef, Jenkins, Bamboo, Git/Bitbucket)
  • Supporting self-service reporting and analytics
  • Working with semi-structured data
  • LLM Concepts, along with Agentic Development

Nice to have:

  • Snowflake
  • Airflow
  • Spark Data Frames or Pandas
  • API development (Mulesoft)
  • Machine Learning
  • Tableau
  • Kafka
  • Experience with Copilot or Claude or Cursor

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have regular, reliable method of transportation to commute to US Foods’ location.

title: Summer Associate (Summer 2027)
description:
The Summer Associate – Corporate role offers an immersive look into the strategic engine powering Clark’s nationwide operations. Embedded directly within a corporate department, you will partner with our project delivery, development, and executive teams to solve complex business challenges, drive operational efficiency, and strengthen Clark’s competitive advantage as an industry leader.

The Role

The Summer Associate Program is your opportunity to build a comprehensive understanding of the construction industry and our business.

As a summer associate, you will be fully embedded with a corporate department, gaining hands-on experience across our business operations.

Beyond your project work, you will become an integrated member of the Clark community through training and development opportunities. Build your network through social events and jobsite tours, and sharpen your skills with formal training sessions led by Clark experts.

Other cornerstones of the Summer Associate Program include:

  • The Capstone Project: A team-based project that challenges you to develop innovative solutions for real-time business opportunities. You will present your findings directly to company leadership, gaining visibility and the chance to make a tangible impact.

  • The Passport Experience: A curated series of experiences designed to guide your summer journey. The Passport showcases the full breadth of Clark’s business, helps you establish meaningful connections across the company, and ensures you gain essential industry knowledge.

This immersive, full-time program runs for 8 -10 weeks and begins in late May or early June.

Responsibilities

The size and breadth of the Clark organization provides the opportunity for a variety of different assignments beyond the jobsite. Many corporate departments work along with the project delivery and development teams to further develop our competitive advantage as a market leader.

While roles will vary based on your assigned department or jobsite, your assignments might include:

  • Human Resources

  • Talent Acquisition

  • IT

  • Marketing

Basic Qualifications

  • Pursuing an undergraduate degree or equivalent, or a graduate degree

  • Interest and passion for the construction industry

What a Successful Candidate Looks Like

We look for individuals who embody these core principles:

Enthusiasm & Drive: Be punctual and dedicated, staying until work is done. Arrive early for meetings and events. Be a proactive team player – ask how you can help and be present. Take initiative, represent the company professionally (dress, demeanor), and build trust with your team, clients, and stakeholders. Proactively seek ways to contribute to team success, and always maintain a positive attitude.

Delivery & Performance: Reliably meet the expectations of your role and commitments. Understand and follow Clark's standard procedures. Take on new responsibilities, dig into the details, and bring solutions to problems. Take ownership, be accountable, and demonstrate responsiveness with a sense of urgency.

Learning & Growth: Immerse yourself in Clark's culture, your team, and your community. Fulfill Clark Corporate University learning requirements. Be engaged, accountable, and self-directed in your learning – be curious! Continuously build your technical expertise and grow your business acumen.

The Physical Side of the Role: A good portion of your day will be spent at a desk, so you should be comfortable with prolonged sitting while working on a computer, handling documents, or participating in meetings. The role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reviewing documents and performing computer work. You'll also need to be able to move around the office and travel occasionally to various locations, including construction sites, using different modes of transportation. You should be able to lift and move objects up to 10 pounds regularly, and up to 25 pounds on occasion (think a box of files or small office equipment).

Your Work Environment: Your primary workspace will be in our professional office, which has a typical, quiet-to-moderate noise and light levels. As part of your work, you may also be required to visit active construction sites. These environments are naturally more dynamic and can include exposure to outdoor weather conditions, louder noise, and moving equipment. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.

Our High-Performing Culture: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines.

A Drug Free Workplace: Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment fitness for duty screening is required, and random fitness for duty tests of employees are conducted quarterly.

Clark offers a total compensation package. Benefits could include commuter benefits or fitness reimbursement. Hourly rates will be determined by factors such as geographic location, education, experience, and market considerations. For this role the hourly rate is $23 - $29/ hr.

title: Head of Regulatory Bioanalysis
location: Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States of America
description:
Title: Head of Regulatory Bioanalysis

Location: Gaithersburg, Maryland, US

Hybrid Working: 3 days per week in the office

Bold Disruptors. Push the boundaries of science. Fearlessly break new ground.

Are you ready to work at the cutting-edge, where scientific innovations and an entrepreneurial spirit are the norm? We’re looking for dynamic thought leaders with curious minds, who are comfortable taking smart risks and constantly challenging the boundaries of science all the while learning and developing core skills and experiences.

What we do

We are a global, science-led BioPharmaceutical business and our innovative medicines are used by millions of patients worldwide.

Why we love it

The future is bright at AstraZeneca as we bring ground-breaking therapies to complex disease to patients with critical needs. Scientific innovations are at the core of what we do across our industry leading portfolio which drive exciting opportunities and varied work. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare!

The role

The Integrated Bioanalytical team within Clinical Pharmacology and Safety Sciences provides broad discovery, preclinical, and clinical support including life cycle management across all therapeutic areas enabling pipeline delivery, decision making, innovation and advancement to improve the lives of patients through life-changing medicines.

We have an opening for a strong strategic and scientific thought leader with extensive experience in regulatory bioanalysis to drive portfolio value. Key attributes of the role include robust scientific and technical depth, demonstrated ability to drive the strategic development of the regulatory bioanalysis team across a range of impact areas including but not limited to Pharmacokinetics, Biomarker and Immunogenicity testing and interpretation to drive key decisions thought the use of the highest quality data delivery in line with portfolio demand.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in developing talent though mentoring and coaching experience.

What you’ll do

You will be located at our Gaithersburg strategic hub, where you will work alongside TA leads and stakeholders. You will be expected to contribute directly to AstaZeneca’s leading position driving science and innovation in the field of bioanalysis impacting assets across the portfolio. This is a key leadership role leading a team of advance scientists providing technical and scientific solution to complex bioanalytical challenges across a wide array of modalities. You will be expected to have a proven track record as a bioanalytical thought with an outstanding reputation for providing innovative solution in regulatory bioanalysis while ensuring systems are in place to enable data is delivered to the required quality standard. The successful candidate teak up the role as test facility manager ensuring compliance with regulatory guidance, SOPs and quality standards. In this highly visible role, you will be required to use your scientific knowledge and expertise to drive the strategic direction of the regulatory bioanalysis group leveraging advanced AI tools. You will also work with team members to ensure interfaces with regulatory agencies and Health Authorities across a range of countries and geographies to mitigate risk, submit regulatory documents and responding to Health Authority questions.

Education/Experience required:

  • PhD. or MSc. With at least 10 years’ experience in a regulatory bioanalytical leadership role.

Essential for the role:

  • Capable of contributing directly to AstraZeneca leading position in driving science and innovation in the field of bioanalysis

  • Proven ability to lead a team of advanced scientists providing scientific direction and technical input while ensuring on time portfolio delivery

  • Capable of working with staff to maximise their potential and achieve career goals

  • Experience in driving innovative solutions to complex portfolio needs though innovative bioanalytical solutions

  • Actively contribute to driving advancement of Integrate Bioanalysis via impact in leadership teams, partnering with peers and stakeholders

  • Ability to partner with leaders across CPSS and the wider AstraZeneca community to advance portfolio assists.

  • In depth understanding of regulatory submission needs across geographies

  • Proven track record in assessing and developing talent

  • Accountable for ensuring data is delivered on time to the required quality standards

  • Proven ability to act as test facility manager, with expertise in driving, executing and leadership in ensuring compliance with scientific standards and regulatory quality systems

  • Clear understanding of context of use and deployment in developing, validating and utilizing assay to support biomarker analysis needs

  • Proven publication and presentation record

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

Desirable for the role:

  • Advanced experience in implementing automated AI solutions

  • Internationally recognised bioanalytical thought leader

  • Line management experience

  • Experienced in multiple therapeutic modalities

  • Expertise of multiple analytical methods including but not limed to ligand binding assays mass spectrometry, flow cytometry and techniques to determine immune response

So, what’s next?

Are you already imagining yourself joining us? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you!

Additional information

Our Company Values & Behaviors underpin everything we do so please take a moment to familiarize yourself with them. You may also want to check out our new R&D Video showing how we turn Science into Medicines.

This includes but not limited to patient assessment, education, medication administration, treatments and patient safety.

Qualifications

title: Supervisor, Health & Welfare Claims
description:

Who We Are

Established over 70 years ago, we are two of the largest Taft-Hartley trust funds in the United States. With over $50 billion in assets and $7 billion in benefits paid each year, we provide critical health insurance and lifetime retirement benefit services to nearly one million Teamster participants and family members. At Central States/TeamCare we jointly administer two trusted organizations:

TeamCare, a Central States Health Plan

Since 2014, the Fund has done business under the tradename TeamCare. Today TeamCare covers the lives of 550,000 members, from 1,100 different employers, making it the largest labor healthcare fund in the

Central States Southeast and Southwest Areas Pension Fund was founded in 1955 and has blazed a trail to retirement security. Paying over $90 billion in lifetime pension benefits for 690,000 retirees and beneficiaries to-date and has revolutionized the pension world of American workers.

Position Summary

The Supervisor, Health & Welfare Claims is responsible for leading a team of Claims Adjusters and overseeing the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of health and welfare claims.   • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex or disputed claims, providing guidance and resolution support to staff.
  • Partner with PPO Network Representatives to resolve claims inquiries, discrepancies, and issues in a timely and professional manner.
  • Collaborate with fellow supervisors and department managers to align operational strategies and drive consistency across the Claims Processing function.
  • Design and deliver onboarding and ongoing training programs that equip staff with the knowledge and tools needed to perform at their best.

title: Facility Modeling & Analysis Engineer
description:
Overview

Job Title: Facility Modeling & Analysis Engineer

Location: Arnold AFB, TN

Job Family Code: O-Engineering

Function/Branch: Engineering/Engineering Solutions

Directorate: Engineering & Tech Support

Position Type: Regular, Full Time

Pay Type: Exempt

Grade: L07 (OA0753) – L08 (OA0848)

Salary Range or Starting Hourly Rate: LO7: $89,600- $123,100, L08: $106,300 - $146,000

Overview

Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an exciting opportunity for a Facility Modeling & Analysis Engineer, supporting TOS II, at AEDC in Arnold AFB, TN. The engineer will be working as a member of the Engineering Solutions branch responsible for supporting the United States Air Force Test Operations and Sustainment efforts. The Engineering Solutions branch performs cutting edge technology development work in support of the National Defense Strategy.

Open to internal and external candidates.

Job Summary

Facility analysis and system modeling engineers provide tools to assess concepts, analyze expected performance, trouble shoot problems with ground test infrastructure systems used in the execution of ground testing of air and space vehicles at the AEDC. They evaluate, select, and apply standard and custom engineering methods, techniques, procedures and criteria, at times using independent judgement in making adaptations and modifications. They perform work which involves the preparation, interpretation, or review of calculations, specifications, plans, and investigations, develop and apply computational and hardware-in-the-loop systems models.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, have effective verbal and written communication skills, be able to work with discretion and confidentiality, proven time management skills, be proactive, and be willing to continually learn new duties and skills.

Job Duties:

  • Support execution of technology development tasks for Facility Modeling solutions, including development of Matlab/Simulink physics-based models of AEDC test facilities and test articles.
  • Support any Mission Execution area by evaluating, selecting, and applying standard engineering methods, techniques, procedures and criteria, using independent judgment in making adaptations and modifications.
  • Perform work which involves the preparation, interpretation, or review of multi-disciplined computations and hardware-in-the-loop systems using a first principles approach. Add computational complexity as deemed necessary by work to be performed.
  • Apply engineering tools to support capital improvement and maintenance projects.
  • Analyze and identify deficiencies in existing system and component level simulations; formulate, implement, and validate improvements to overcome those deficiencies.
  • Develop new systems and component level simulations and expand capabilities of existing simulations to meet future requirements.
  • Develop and validate new computational approaches in the areas of fluid modeling, thermal modeling, numerical algorithms, and code-processing.
  • Draft, review, and present results in a written and / or visual format to both technical-detailed and high-level audiences.
  • Implement system level models into hardware-in-the-loop architecture; monitor and troubleshoot communication, data-transfer, and feedback-loops between simulation and other components.
  • Develop and maintain positive, open relationships with AEDC counterparts and with FM&A technology development customers.
  • Engage with colleagues as required to push for technological advances, facility improvements, advanced diagnostics, and complex problem solutions.
  • Champions a work environment which fosters openness, trust, communications, teamwork, empowerment, innovation, and satisfaction.
  • It is a condition of employment to wear company issued PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
  • Interact effectively with engineering, management, and craft personnel.
  • Perform other related duties as required.

Basic Qualifications:

  • S. degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related scientific discipline from an accredited university with a minimum of at least 2 years’ applicable post degree experience.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense Secret level security clearance and access to the AEDC local area network.
  • Due to Air Force Security requirements, U.S. Citizenship is required for employment at AEDC.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in ME, AE, or EE with 3 years’ experience doing computational development and analysis.
  • Education in fundamental engineering and science, and advanced knowledge of mathematics, algorithms and computer languages.
  • Demonstrated technical knowledge of general engineering principles, including basic knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and multidisciplinary modeling and the application of this knowledge to engineering problems.
  • Familiarity with one or more AEDC facilities.
  • Experience with Matlab/Simulink product suite.
  • Experience with PLC-based control systems.

title: Roll off Driver CDL B
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: A Driver- CDL (B) is responsible for safely operating a collection truck, and providing prompt, courteous and complete waste removal services for customers. In addition, a Driver – CDL (B) is responsible for ensuring his or her vehicle is in compliance with the Company’s safety standards prior to operating the vehicle, ensures that all Company, state and federal regulations are adhered to at all times while operating the vehicle, and completes vehicle condition reports (“VCRs”) on a daily basis to ensure that any vehicle defects are repaired in a timely manner.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform complete pre- and post-operation inspection of the vehicle in accordance with Company policy to ensure tire pressure, fluid levels, safety equipment, gauges, and controls are in proper working order. Report any safety issues on standard reports.
  • Safely operate his or her heavy truck along his or her designated route and to the disposal site; read route sheet, follow map and service each customer as identified on the route sheet or as assigned by the dispatcher and/or supervisor.
  • Operate manual and/or automatic controls in accordance with Company safety policies and procedures to lift and load refuse, operate compactor and dispose of collected material at the designated facility.
  • Courteously interact with all customers, dispatchers and others on a daily basis to ensure all customer routes are serviced in a timely and professional manner.
  • Identify unsatisfactory waste containers and tag containers in accordance with applicable departmental procedures.
  • Continuously monitor waste for evidence of unacceptable waste.
  • Clean area around an accidental waste spill, ensuring adherence to all applicable safety standards and policies.
  • Continuously monitor the condition of the vehicle to ensure it is operationally ready at all times to minimize down time; clean waste from the packer blade and truck body (where appropriate) on each disposal trip.
  • Complete required route/productivity sheets, VCRs and other reports, as required.
  • Maintain adherence to required productivity standards for the department to ensure all customers are serviced in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Follow all required safety policies and procedures.
  • Actively participate in the Company’s ReSOP program.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.
  • Good customer services skills to meet and exceed customer expectations; acts in a professional, courteous and cooperative manner toward customers and co-workers; works with a sense of honesty and trustworthiness.
  • Good time management skills to ensure assigned responsibilities are completed in an efficient and safe manner.
  • Good follow through ability; adheres to work schedule and follows through on challenges as they arise.
  • Ability to adhere to Company policies and rules set forth; promotes the Company’s safety standards; does not take inappropriate risks.
  • Maintains a feeling of pride in work; strives to achieve all goals.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Class B or higher Commercial Driver’s license with air brakes endorsement.

We Are Currently Interviewing for Roll off Drivers in Nashville

Saturday - Tuesday or Sunday -Thursday Start time 4am

Matching 401K, Full benefits and Weekly Pay

Rewarding Compensation and Benefits

Eligible employees can elect to participate in:
• Comprehensive medical benefits coverage, dental plans and vision coverage.

• Life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment insurance.

• Benefits:

Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the Company.

EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: ServiceNow Solutions Developer
description:
Keen to become part of a truly global, collaborative team of professionals? Your journey begins here.

Job Title


ServiceNow Solutions Developer

Office Location


London or Birmingham

Department


IT Service Management Applications

Working Hours


35 hours per week, 9:30am to 5:30pm but additional hours may be required. We are happy to consider agile and flexible working patterns. Our approach to hybrid working allows for up to 40% of time working from home and 60% working in the office, please contact a member of the recruitment team to discuss further.

Role Overview

This role blends technical and functional ServiceNow expertise with strong business analysis and communication skills to turn agreed business requirements into effective, scalable solutions. The role holder manages their own work with minimal supervision, uses sound judgement where there is no clear precedent, and escalates complex architecture, advanced scripting or specialist engineering decisions to the Principal ServiceNow Developer where needed.

ServiceNow is an enterprise-wide platform supporting Business Teams and functions across the firm, including Information Technology, M&BD, Finance, People, Knowledge, the Office of the General Counsel, Operations and Communications. It operates across one production and four sub-production instances and includes a broad range of ServiceNow products, custom scoped applications and enterprise integrations.

The right candidate has strong ServiceNow expertise and good business acumen and takes a pragmatic, collaborative approach. They are comfortable working with stakeholders to understand the why and how behind a requirement and translating agreed business needs into reliable, user-focused solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, technical feasibility and long-term platform health.

Key Responsibilities

Specific duties or responsibilities may be reviewed from time to time to reflect changes in personnel and management structure, staff location or services. All members of the firm participate in our Responsible
Business program.

  • Work with the ServiceNow Engagement Lead and business stakeholders to translate agreed requirements into functional and technical solution designs, contributing to and, where appropriate, facilitating solution-design workshops.

  • Design, configure, develop and implement end-to-end ServiceNow solutions, including Flow Designer workflows, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, access controls, notifications, catalog items, forms and applications, through to testing support, deployment and post-implementation support.

  • Look for opportunities to simplify and improve business processes through workflow automation, self-service and a better user experience, feeding recommendations into the platform roadmap.

  • Design, configure and help embed approved ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist and AI Agents, into new and existing solutions. Work with the Principal ServiceNow Developer on more advanced agentic use cases and contribute to the platform's AI roadmap.

  • Design, develop and support integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems, working with the Principal ServiceNow Developer on complex integrations and technical design decisions.

  • Produce and maintain functional and technical documentation, including solution designs, configuration records, technical test requirements and operational support documentation, making sure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, performant and easy to upgrade in line with ServiceNow and firm standards.

  • Assess the impact of ServiceNow releases, upgrades, patches and new capabilities on solutions within their area of responsibility. Work with the Principal ServiceNow Developer, Test Engineers and ServiceNow Platform Specialist to identify risks, define testing requirements, resolve defects and support deployment and operational handover.

  • Provide technical expertise for platform incidents and problems escalated by the ServiceNow Platform Specialist, and share solution-specific documentation, technical guidance and knowledge across the ServiceNow Platform team.

  • Work with the ServiceNow Data and CMDB Specialist where solutions create, use or change CMDB or platform data, to keep data quality and governance on track.

  • Collaborate across the ServiceNow Platform team, business stakeholders, other IT functions and managed service partners to deliver joined-up services, drawing on a good understanding of the firm's services, processes, policies and operating environment.

  • Work within agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, and help drive service excellence and continual improvement in how the team works.

  • Help build a supportive workplace where colleagues can do their best work, and take part in the firm's Responsible Business programme.

Skills & Experience

Experience

  • Typically, at least five years' hands-on experience designing, developing, configuring and implementing ServiceNow solutions across the full lifecycle, from discovery and design through to testing, deployment and operational handover, ideally in a complex, global organisation.

  • Very good functional knowledge of the ServiceNow platform, supported by a sound understanding of its architecture and development best practices. Able to engage stakeholders, contribute to solution-design workshops and turn business requirements into effective solutions, explaining the benefits, limitations and technical implications to both business and technical audiences.

  • Strong experience configuring Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, access controls, notifications, forms and catalog items.

  • Experience developing or supporting integrations using REST, SOAP, APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server and Import Sets, with working knowledge of JavaScript, Glide APIs, HTML, CSS, XML and other relevant ServiceNow technologies.

  • Experience building custom scoped applications from scratch and delivering enterprise workflows across multiple ServiceNow product areas, such as Security Operations, Workplace Service Delivery, Contract Management, Discovery and ITSM, including CMDB and external data integration where relevant.

  • Experience configuring or implementing ServiceNow AI capabilities is desirable. Candidates should otherwise demonstrate a strong understanding of, and ability to develop expertise in, Now Assist, AI Agents and AI Agent Studio.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply expertise, assess options and recommend proportionate solutions where there may be no clear precedent.

  • Able to recognise when specialist technical input is needed and to manage and deliver work with minimal supervision, balancing competing priorities in a busy, global environment and working within Agile methods, including Scrum.

Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and / or ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification, or equivalent demonstrable platform experience, is desirable.

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certification in a relevant product area is desirable.

Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and build good relationships across business and technical teams.

  • Able to see how individual requirements fit into wider business processes, with a genuine commitment to service excellence, continual improvement and a positive customer experience.

  • Happy to share knowledge and give solution-specific guidance to colleagues, helping build a collaborative, supportive team culture in line with the firm's values.

Equal Opportunities Statement

It is the policy of Hogan Lovells Cadwalader to provide equal opportunities for all employees in relation to recruitment, training and promotion. Decisions in these areas will be made only by reference to the requirements of the job and shall not be influenced by any consideration of racial or ethnic origin, religion, sex, gender and gender identity, age, sexual orientation, marital and civil partnership status, pregnancy or disability.

Our goal is to embed flexibility across our business by giving everyone the opportunity to work in an agile way, whether as a regular pattern or on an ad hoc basis, and we will be happy to discuss this further.

title: Associate Consultant Engineer - Security Systems
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


We are seeking an experienced Senior Genetec Platform Engineer to lead the architecture, deployment, and lifecycle management of our enterprise Genetec Security Center environment across multiple sites. This role owns the technical roadmap for our video management (VMS) and access control infrastructure, driving scalability, resiliency, and standardization as the organization grows. The ideal candidate combines deep Genetec platform expertise with enterprise systems architecture experience, and partners closely with IT, physical security operations, and site stakeholders to deliver a unified, high-availability security platform.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, deployment, and ongoing architecture of enterprise-scale Genetec Security Center environments spanning video management (VMS), access control, and integrated security systems across Indianapolis.
  • Develop and maintain the technical roadmap for the Genetec platform, including server infrastructure sizing, storage architecture, failover/redundancy design, and capacity planning for enterprise growth.
  • Own platform health and performance: monitor system uptime, troubleshoot complex site issues, and manage patching, upgrades, and firmware lifecycle across servers, edge devices, and appliances.
  • Design and implement system integrations between Genetec Security Center and third-party systems (identity management, building automation, alarm monitoring, analytics) via SDK, APIs, and native connectors.
  • Establish and enforce platform standards, configuration baselines, and documentation for site deployments, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity hardening.
  • Partner with IT infrastructure, network engineering, and physical security operations teams to align the Genetec platform with enterprise network, virtualization, and security policies.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers and site-level technicians / integrators; serve as the escalation point for complex platform issues.
  • Manage vendor relationships with Genetec and system integrators, including licensing, support contracts, and technology roadmap alignment.
  • Lead new site onboarding and system migrations, ensuring minimal downtime and adherence to enterprise architecture standards.

Required Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of experience administering and engineering enterprise physical security systems.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Genetec Security Center architecture and deployment experience.
  • Genetec certification(s) required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire (e.g., Genetec Certified Support Technician (GCSST) or Genetec Certified Support Professional (GCSP)).
  • Deep understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure: Windows Server administration, SQL Server, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), storage (SAN/NAS), and enterprise networking (VLANs, QoS, multicast).
  • Experience designing high-availability, Site security architectures including failover, redundancy, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Working knowledge of IP video surveillance, access control hardware, and integration standards (ONVIF, Wiegand/OSDP).
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity best practices as applied to physical security systems, including network segmentation, certificate management, and hardening guidelines.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
  • Genetec Certified Architecture Design (GCADT) or equivalent advanced Genetec credential.
  • Experience with Genetec SDK/API development or scripting for custom integrations and automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud-connected or hybrid-cloud Genetec deployments (Genetec Clearance, Genetec Mission Control, or SaaS-based offerings).
  • Experience supporting security operations in a regulated or highly distributed enterprise environment (e.g., healthcare, pharmaceutical, critical infrastructure, financial services).
  • PMP, ITIL, or similar project/service management certification.

Additional Information:

  • Location: On-site
  • Reports To: Associate Director Fire and Security Systems

title: ISSM - Information System Security Manager
description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related Science or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibilityrequirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S.citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

General Dynamics Mission Systems has an immediate opening for an Information Assurance Security Professional. This position provides an opportunity to further advance the cutting-edge technology that supports some of our nation’s core defense/intelligence services and systems. General Dynamics Mission Systems employees work closely with esteemed customers to develop solutions that allow them to carry out high-stakes national security missions.

The candidate will be designated as an ISSM - Information System Security Manager supporting multiple programs administering the Information Assurance (IA) Cyber duties for government customers. Components of the IA program include Assessment and Authorization (A&A) activities (i.e., documentation preparation, system configuration/validation, certification testing), security sustainment activities (i.e., hardware change management, software change management, account management, media protection, user interface, file transfers), conducting self-inspections, audit trail review, and delivering information systems security education and awareness. The candidate must be a self-starter capable of multitasking and efficiently managing their time in a dynamic environment while requiring minimal levels of supervision. Additionally, the candidate will possess effective written, speaking, analytical, organizational, and customer service skills that will assist them in identifying solutions to complex compliance and security problems. The ISSM will coordinate duties with the System Administrators and/or Information Technology (IT) staff to ensure all configuration requirements are implemented and functional. The ISSM will conduct technical and nontechnical reviews and audits as prescribed by the Information Assurance Manager.

REPRESENTATIVE DUTIES AND TASKS:

  • As a member of the Information Assurance Security team the IAP supports system security categorization efforts, security requirements selection/analysis, security control assessments and performs continuous monitoring.
  • Executes or supports the execution of A&A activities, including development of required security documentation, including items such as System Security Plans, Security Assessment Reports, SCTM’s and POA&Ms in compliance with IA policy
  • Perform weekly system audit reviews, media reviews, hardware/software configuration management
  • Executes security testing and evaluation to ensure correct implementation of security controls
  • Supports the assessment and mitigation of vulnerabilities throughout a systems life cycle
  • Conduct IA security education training for all system users on appropriate risk mitigation strategies
  • Perform incident response and cleanup actions, when necessary, per company or customer directions
  • Ensure systems are operated, maintained, and disposed of in accordance with internal security policies and procedures outlined in the System Security Plan (SSP).
  • Assume ISSM responsibilities as assigned by the Region Manager and/or in the absence of the ISSM

KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Proficient understanding of cyber security specifications such as Risk Management Framework (RMF), JSIG (Joint SAP Implementation Guide), ICD-503, NIST SP 800-53.
  • This role requires a technical background creating POA&Ms, developing corrective action plans, and writing security plans, policies, and procedural documentation (not just reviewing or performing documentation review)
  • Experience implementing government security requirements to include technical computer/network system auditing
  • Trained and proficient in Assured File Transfer (AFT) processes and tools
  • Experience with various security assessment/hardening tools - STIGs, SCAP, ACAS, Nessus, etc.
  • Systems administration experience is highly desirable
  • Very strong writing, speaking, analytical, and customer service skills
  • Ability to participate in or lead security work groups
  • Must be a self-starter capable of multitasking and efficiently managing your time in a dynamic environment while requiring minimal levels of supervision
  • Maintains contact with external customer security professionals
  • Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

PREFERRED DEGREE TYPES AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstrated comprehensive knowledge of the NISPOM, JSIG, ICD-503, NIST SP 800-53 and CNSSI 1253
  • DoD 8140 IAM-II level professional certification (i.e. Security + CE, CAP, GSLC) or ability to obtain within six (6) months of hire.

OUR COMMITTMENT TO YOU:

  • An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
  • Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
  • Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule)
  • Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more
