title: X Ray Technician Limited Scope Per Diem
description:
Overview

Schedule: Per Diem/ This position is to work on an as-needed schedule

Location: Meridian, ID (3272 E Pine Ave)

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At Concentra, you will be a vital member of our patient care team and play a crucial role in providing exceptional care to our patients. Our mission is to improve the health of America's workforce, one patient at a time. Join us at Concentra and see how your clinical competency and compassion can make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients you serve.

The X Ray Limited Scope & Medical Support Specialist performs routine x-ray, medical, and testing procedures under direct supervision of the treating clinician as well as supports in other areas of the facility as needed including registration and referral management. This position will also perform routine X-ray examinations in accordance with Concentra policies, practices, and procedures and applicable regulations. This role requires efficient and accurate delivery of one-on-one patient care while thriving in a fast-paced environment. Also will ensure that every patient is treated with quality clinical care and receives an excellent patient experience from welcoming, respectful, and skillful colleagues.

Responsibilities

X-ray Technician Duties

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety and comfort during the x-ray exam
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety
  • Use radiation safety measures and protection devices to ensure safety of patients and team members
  • Ensure radiologic equipment remains in working order. Report equipment malfunctions to Center Operations Director
  • Ensure all Radiology workflows are followed and all Radiology reports cross correctly to EMRFollows documentation procedures and completes required documentation related to patient x-ray visit.
  • Maintain all x-ray equipment, including calibration, QA/QC procedures, and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures

Medical Support Specialist Duties

  • Perform Department of Transportation (DOT) and Non-DOT drug and alcohol testing
  • Prepare patients for physical examinations, including taking vital signs and any required or requested ancillary testing including but not limited to vaccines and injections, phlebotomy, PFTs, audiogram testing and respirator fit testing
  • Perform rapid screening tests (influenza, strep, mono, glucose, etc.)
  • Assist providers during examination and treatment
  • Responsible for performing routine medical procedures as ordered by treating clinician as well as triaging emergent patients as needed
  • Prepare and assist clinician with procedure set up and injury care
  • Apply bandages, dressings and splints as ordered by the treating clinician
  • Dispense medications and DME as ordered by the treating clinician in accordance with state regulations
  • Complete quality assurance activities on equipment and medical devices as well as testing processes used in the center
  • Maintain supplies, clean rooms and equipment, and stock exam rooms
  • Maintain and operate all medical devices and equipment, including calibration and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures
  • Notify supervisor immediately if equipment is not functioning properly, supplies are needed, or facility is not operating as expected
  • In partnership with center leadership, assist with patient flow and volume
  • Keep patients informed of expected wait times during all aspects of the center visit
  • Responsible for clerical tasks in both the front and back office associated with patient care and proper record keeping
  • Ensure accuracy in documentation
  • Perform front office duties: greet patients, obtain authorization, check in/out, communicate wait times, answer multi-line telephone system, and distribute employer results/paperwork as needed
  • Follow HIPAA guidelines and safety rules
  • Attend center staff meetings or huddles as required

title: Senior Engineering Support Specialist - Weapons Launcher Test Engineer
description:
Basic Qualifications

Requires a Bachelor’s or Technology degree in Engineering or a related specialized area/field, or equivalent (4 years job-related experience). Requires an additional 2+ years of job-related experience, or a Master's degree. Must have experience with one of the following skills: the AN/BLQ-10, AN/BYG-1, Submarine Weapon Launchers, or AN/BQQ-10 systems.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Exceptional Job Opportunity: Test & Evaluation Engineering Support Specialist (CWL)!!

Progeny Systems, a General Dynamics Mission Systems company is a high-tech business focusing on software and hardware system integration, cutting-edge research and development, and manufacturing. We provide premium systems, services, and products for the Department of Defense, government agencies and commercial clients.

We are a technology leader in numerous areas including technology insertion; acoustic sensors; signal processing; combat systems; torpedoes; cyber security; knowledge management; and electronic warfare.

Progeny System's ability to leverage flexibility, rapid turnaround, customer responsiveness, and encourage an environment for experimental research has been critical to our success in developing, producing, and supporting numerous mission critical national defense systems.

Progeny is on the lookout for an enthusiastic and driven Test & Evaluation Engineering Support Specialist to join our dynamic team. At Progeny, we lead the charge in designing, developing, producing, integrating, and sustaining the Common Weapon Launcher (CWL) on both U.S. and Australian submarines, as well as the Multi-Tube Weapon Simulator (MTWS) on U.S. and Foreign Military submarines. Our dedicated CWL and MTWS team collaborates closely with the Navy, internal production teams, and industry partners to ensure the flawless delivery and operation of these critical systems in laboratory and submarine environments.

Key Responsibilities:

As a CWL Test & Evaluation Engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in the success of our projects. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating with CWL and MTWS engineers to conduct testing and integration.
  • Employing a professional and confident approach when working with various engineering groups within Progeny and external entities to define, document, analyze, conduct, and interpret tests.
  • Identifying functional issues and proposing effective resolutions.
  • Operating in a fast-paced, integrated product development team comprising professionals from multiple contracting organizations and DoD laboratory entities.
  • Developing and analyzing test cases while providing regular progress updates.
  • Reporting to a supervisor or manager, demonstrating a high degree of autonomy in your work.

This role may require intermittent travel, both independently and as part of a team, to support test events in partner and government labs, as well as shipboard installations in domestic and international locations.

Specific Responsibilities:

Your day-to-day tasks will involve:

  • Crafting comprehensive test procedures.
  • Proficiently utilizing electrical measurement tools, such as oscilloscopes and multimeters.
  • Conducting Verification and Validation for corrective changes.
  • Performing installations, rip-outs, testing, and validation of tactical systems.
  • Assisting in configuring the lab in accordance with relevant drawings and port maps.
  • Supporting informal and formal test events, as well as other customer-driven test activities.
  • Identifying, analyzing, and documenting software, firmware, and hardware defects and collaborating with the engineering team to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Occasional travel to submarine home ports for Field Services activities.
  • Supporting the Logistics team in the development of installation and operation procedures.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

To excel in this role, you should possess:

  • Proficiency in software testing and analysis.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • General knowledge of network configurations, operations, and commands.
  • Navy or Submarine experience is a valuable asset.
  • Ability to lift up to 45 pounds.

This is a remarkable opportunity to be at the forefront of cutting-edge technology and make a real impact. If you are passionate, self-driven, and ready to contribute to our mission, we encourage you to apply. Join us at Progeny and be a part of a team that shapes the future of maritime defense.

What you’ll experience:

  • Technologies that aren’t just top-notch, they’re often top-secret
  • A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
  • Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered

What you bring to the table:

  • Solid knowledge in use and understanding of test engineering concepts, principles, and theories
  • Solid knowledge and experience with object-oriented programming, system processes and scripting languages
  • Openly proposes ideas that enhance productivity and efficiency, solicits input, and optimizes solutions

What sets you apart:

  • Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success, meeting and exceeding personal and team commitments
  • Ability to grasp and apply new information quickly and handle increasing responsibilities with growing complexity
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development

Workplace Options:

This position is fully on-site, with opportunity for flex based on tasking. While on-site, you will be a part of the Manassas, VA facility.

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Combined Salary Range

USD $99,395.00 - USD $110,266.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

title: Staff Software Engineer – ML Inference Runtime
description:
Job Overview:

We have a phenomenal opportunity to help shape the future of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence on Arm platforms. Arm technology is used wherever computing matters. Are you passionate about ML systems and keen to influence how generative AI and other machine-learning workloads run efficiently on next-generation hardware?

Then we should talk!

We are growing our ML framework integrations team and seek dedicated and motivated engineers to join us. You will work with teams across Arm and with leading technology companies building products based on Arm technologies. You will share ideas, learn from outstanding engineers, and make contributions that have a real impact. This role offers the opportunity to provide develop the software that connects widely used machine-learning frameworks and runtimes to Arm acceleration technologies.

Responsibilities:

Responsibilities include developing and optimizing C++, C, and Python software that integrates machine-learning platforms and execution environments with Arm hardware acceleration. This work entails integration with open-source LLM software such as llama.cpp. You will design and implement integrations between ML frameworks, runtimes, and hardware-acceleration technologies, as well as analyse and improve the performance of ML and LLM workloads. The role also involves leading significant work from design through delivery, mentoring junior engineers, and supporting technical decisions.

We are looking for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who enjoys finding innovative solutions to complex technical challenges. You will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and collaborating across complementary teams to achieve shared goals.

Required Skills and Experience :

  • Strong C++, C, and Python programming and software-design skills
  • Experience delivering significant software features across multiple teams
  • Familiarity with Git, GitLab, continuous integration, and automated testing
  • Effective technical leadership and communication skills
  • Knowledge of LLM inference, including tokenization, attention, KV caches, batching and quantisation

“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :

  • Experience with llama.cpp or other open-source ML or LLM runtimes
  • Experience with profiling and optimizing ML workloads
  • Experience with compiler or ML graph technologies
  • Experience with Vulkan, GPU compute, or other hardware-acceleration APIs
  • Experience using AI-assisted software-development tools effectively

In Return:

All Arm employees are provided with vital training to succeed in their respective roles, as well as a friendly and high-performance working environment.

You will be working with a bunch of enthusiastic and brilliant colleagues. We are proud to have a set of behaviours that reflect our DEI (Diversity, Equity & Inclusion) culture and guide our decisions, defining how we work together to shape extraordinary!

Please note that no relocation package is available for this role.

Working at Bank of America Chester offers a far-reaching global career for a world-renowned organisation, whilst being ideally situated against the backdrop of the rolling North Wales hills and the banks of the serene River Dee.

Responsibilities:

Transaction Reporting is responsible for ensuring the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of the Bank’s transaction reporting obligations across multiple global regulatory jurisdictions.

This role sits within the Remediation team, whose purpose is to drive improvements in Transaction Reporting through remediation assessment, root cause oversight, management information, process optimisation and effective governance.

A key focus of your role is assessing multi-layered, aged and blocked reporting breaches to establish whether viable remediation options remain available. The role provides independent task to ensure all reasonable remediation avenues have been explored before closure is considered. It also supports the team’s broader targets through the production of management information, root cause analysis, procedural and training documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What we are looking for:

  • Understanding of the regulatory trade and transaction reporting landscape would be ideal
  • Familiar with key regulations: EMIR, MIFID, SFTR, CFTC and others.
  • Prepared to remain current on the regulatory reporting landscape to ensure the firm’s reporting remains in step with any changes
  • Industry Experience:
  • Experience in remediating transaction reporting issues, including back-reporting
  • Familiar with key trade flow components: how trades are booked, cleared, captured, consumed by the reporting systems, processed, submitted to the regulatory / repository)
  • Experience in key transaction reporting systems and how they interact with each other
  • Business Analysis / Project Management
  • Project experience: business analysis, project management, data analysis, and testing skills are required for this role.
  • Experience in managing cross-functional stakeholders

  • Product specific knowledge inside / outside of transaction reporting operations.

title: Engineer - Sustainment
description:
Overview

There’s never been a better time to join the shipbuilding industry. As demand for cutting-edge naval technology grows, General Dynamics Electric Boat is at the forefront—designing, building, and maintaining the most advanced submarines in the world. Our work is mission-critical, supporting the U.S. Navy and strengthening national security.

About Department 408 - Life Cycle Engineering

D408 Life Cycle Engineering is responsible for the development of Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) products and maintenance of ship design requirements to maximize the Operational Availability (Ao) of all ships in the fleet. From cradle to grave, this organization is involved during early concept arrangement, detail design, new construction, and support in-service assets to ensure fleet readiness and modernization efforts. Our influence during the design phase and documentation produced directly support the ship and all maintenance stakeholder during the ship’s lifecycle.

Role Overview

Life Cycle Engineering is seeking a highly motivated engineer to support execution of Sustainment initiatives for VIRGINIA Class and SSN(X) Programs. In this role, you will work with the VIRGINIA Sustainment Engineering team to advise submarine concept designs as they are developed in the Teamcenter 3D model. You will apply your experience to influence designs in order to maximize the operational availability goals of the platform and reduce total ownership costs to the NAVY during all levels of maintenance.

As a new member of the Design-Build-Sustain (DBS) team, you will interface with all design and engineering disciplines, shipyard operations personnel, and advocate for downstream maintenance stakeholders. This process establishes a feedback loop between the frontline maintainers and the design agent where lessons learned are shared and implemented. In this capacity, you will be expected to be the voice of post-delivery maintenance and overhaul considerations, while striving to strike a balance between design requirements and the operational needs of the fleet.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop comprehension of ship specifications and desktop guides, as well as proficiency with key resources such as the Class Maintenance Plan (CMP), Planned Maintenance System (PMS) Viewer, and the Open Architectural Retrieval System (OARS) 3M system
  • Contribute to VIRGINIA and SSN(X) programs in a supporting role to task leads in the completion of applicable projects and deliverables
  • Perform entry level assessments of ship systems and component designs for maintenance and accessibility, reliability, facilitating lifting and handling needs, as well as life cycle cost analysis to support relevant trade studies
  • Become proficient with NX Teamcenter in order to support major area team reviews and working level meetings with Design & Engineering
  • Engage in regular training with technical leads to increase knowledge of ship operations underway, in-port, and dry docking periods
  • Participate in periodic industrial area walkthroughs of the shipyard and submarine hulls under constructions to raise deck plate awareness

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor of Science degree or higher in Engineering
  • 0-5 years of post graduate engineering experience
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance through the department of defense

Preferred

  • Knowledge in Mechanical, Ocean, Structural, Electrical, Materials or Systems Engineering application
  • Entry level awareness of specification requirements, maintainability principles, failure history research, interpreting drawings and diagrams

Skills

  • Must possess an open-minded approach to learning new concepts, thinking critically, and speaking with confidence
  • Strong written, verbal, and organizational skills

Why Join Us

  • We offer a workplace where integrity, innovation, and excellence drive everything we do
  • Competitive Pay & Benefits – Comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, and tuition assistance
  • Career Growth – Training, mentorship, and opportunities to advance within the company
  • Stability & Expansion – We’re growing, adding thousands of new jobs across our facilities
  • Inclusive Culture – Employee Resource Groups and community engagement
  • Impactful Work – Every role contributes directly to national defense and the U.S. Navy’s mission

description:

Er du drevet af resultater og elsker at tage ansvar, og vil du være med til at designe og sælge drømmekøkkener?

Vi søger en engageret, handlekraftig og serviceminded køkkenkonsulent, der brænder for at skabe salg, hjælpe kunderne med at finde den helt rigtige løsning - og samtidig levere rådgivning i topklasse. Du motiveres af at skabe målbare resultater og har et stærkt drive for at lykkes – både individuelt og som del af et team. Derudover forventer vi, at du:
• Har en struktureret og grundig tilgang til dit arbejde – med fokus på at skabe resultater.

• Har måske erfaring med køkkensalg eller indretning – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

En dag I dit liv hos os

Som køkkenkonsulent hos IKEA Aalborg har du ansvaret for at rådgive og sælge løsninger, der matcher kundens behov og budget – uden at gå på kompromis med kvalitet eller funktionalitet.
Du vil bl.a.:
• Designe og sælge køkkener i vores tegneprogram.
• Rådgive om og sælge hvidevarer og tilbehør.
• Afholde og koordinere rådgivningsmøder med kunder – både planlagte og spontane.

Du får en grundig oplæring, så du bliver fortrolig med vores systemer og arbejdsmetoder.

Sammen som et team

Du bliver en del af et engageret og professionelt team med både fuldtids- og deltidsansatte. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, deler viden og hjælper hinanden – fra første kundemøde til det færdige køkken. Vi tager vores arbejde seriøst – men vi gør det med godt humør og en åben tilgang til hinanden.

Har du spørgsmål eller brug for hjælp? Lad os tale med hinanden!

Du er velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Tobias Lund på mail tobias.lund1@ingka.ikea.com ved spørgsmål. Vi gør opmærksom på, at vi udelukkende modtager ansøgninger via vores rekrutterings-system og ikke via e-mail.

Øvrig information

Dette betyder, at man er garanteret 8 eller 13 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit og at arbejdstiden ikke kan overstige 15 eller 20 timer pr. uge i gennemsnit. Vær opmærksom på om du opfylder betingelserne for at blive ansat på fleksibel deltid (som udgangspunkt skal man være studerende, pensionist eller have et job med væsentligt flere timer ved siden af)
• Din arbejdstid placeres primært indenfor åbningstiden, og du skal forvente at have 1-2 lukkevagter pr. uge samt arbejde hver 2. weekend, både lørdag og søndag. Det er muligt for dig at komme med input til arbejdsplanen
• Løn efter HK’s butiksoverenskomst, herunder pension- og fritvalgsordning samt forskudttidstillæg
• Vi har diverse personalegoder som helbredsforsikring, personalerabat, rabatordninger med samarbejdspartnere, årsgave osv.
• Der kan i ansættelsesprocessen blive stillet krav om fremvisning af straffeattest
• Ønsket opstart efter aftale

title: Corporate Finance Intern (Summer 2027)
description:

  • Assist with rating agencies' meeting materials by conducting peer company research, benchmarking, ad-hoc analysis, and preparing supporting documentation and presentations.
  • Collaborate with the IT department to track and manage IT expenses and investments.
  • Participate in financial reviews and audits related to IT projects and expenditures.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Basic understanding of finance and accounting principles. - Required
  • Familiarity with IT financial management concepts. - Preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Required
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. - Required
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. - Required
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. - Required

Visual acuity is required to determine accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned.

title: Director, Enterprise Finance Data & Analytics
description:
Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and services that support the entire travel journey. Our platforms - including Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable - utilize advanced AI, machine learning and other innovative technologies to simplify and personalize the travel experience for consumers and partners in over 220 countries and territories. Our mission is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. For more information, visit BookingHoldings.com and follow us on X @BookingHoldings.

This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

The Director, Finance Performance Strategy & Analytics will play a critical leadership role in how Finance defines performance, governs key metrics, prioritizes reporting and planning needs and turns data into actionable business insight across Booking Holdings and its brands. Partnering closely with Enterprise Applications, Brand FP&A teams, Finance Centers of Excellence, and Finance leadership, this role will architect and champion a unified finance data strategy to lead the evolution of our finance data platform, establish enterprise-wide KPI governance and drive next-generation forecasting and AI-enabled insights to support decision making capabilities across the organization. Success in this role requires the ability to align stakeholders around common definitions, priorities, and outcomes. The successful candidate will combine deep FP&A expertise with strong business process and data acumen to drive the modernization of Finance’s capabilities while advancing management’s vision of consistent, actionable, and near real-time insights.

In this role you will get to:

Enterprise Finance Data Strategy

  • Partner with Finance leadership, Enterprise Applications, and Data Engineering teams to shape and execute the enterprise finance data strategy across Booking Holdings and its brands.

  • Enhance and evolve the centralized repository for financial and operational data (“Cross Brand Analytics Platform” (CBAP) ” on Snowflake) that supports enterprise reporting, planning, and analytics needs.

  • Develop and maintain a multi-year roadmap for finance data standardization & modernization, executive analytics, forecasting, and management reporting.

  • Serve as Finance's primary liaison for enterprise data initiatives, ensuring alignment across data, metrics, reporting, and planning capabilities.

KPI Governance & Business Ownership

  • Establish and govern consistent business definitions for key financial and operational metrics across brands and corporate functions.

  • Align Finance stakeholders on KPI definitions, business rules, reporting hierarchies, and management views needed for planning and performance analysis.

  • Partner with Enterprise Applications to translate Finance definitions and reporting needs into scalable solutions, while maintaining clear functional ownership within Finance and technical ownership within delivery teams.

  • Partner with Risk & Compliance to ensure key performance metrics, reporting processes, and data governance frameworks are disclosure-ready, appropriately controlled, and aligned with enterprise governance and regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with stakeholders to develop and maintain a finance semantic layer that enables trusted, self-service reporting and analytics.

  • Drive alignment on KPI definitions, business rules, metric hierarchies, and data lineage.

  • Improve data quality, reconciliation, transparency, and governance across finance data assets while balancing enterprise consistency with brand-specific requirements.

Executive Analytics & Reporting

  • Lead business agenda to develop scalable reporting and analytics capabilities that provide management with timely, consistent, and actionable insights into financial performance, operational trends, and strategic priorities.

  • Enable executive dashboards, management reporting, business reviews, and cross-brand performance analysis through a common data and metrics framework.

  • Promote self-service analytics capabilities that improve access to trusted information and accelerate decision-making.

  • Define the reporting outputs, decision-support needs, and management routines that will help Finance leaders access timely, consistent, and actionable insight.

  • Improve the effectiveness of reporting by focusing on clarity, comparability, and decision usefulness rather than volume of output.

Forecasting Transformation

  • Work with FP&A teams to evolve forecasting and planning processes toward more driver-based, forward-looking decision support.

  • Identify process, data, and reporting improvements that will increase forecast quality, transparency, and efficiency.

  • Define and prioritize business requirements for scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and improved forecasting capabilities.

  • Help standardize planning assumptions, review routines, and cross-functional alignment needed to support stronger performance management.

AI & Advanced Analytics

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and advanced analytics across forecasting, reporting, and decision support.

  • Partner with Enterprise Applications and other delivery teams to ensure AI-enabled solutions are grounded in Finance workflows, decision needs, and governance expectations.

  • Support the development of automated variance analysis, predictive performance indicators, natural-language finance insights, and other emerging analytical capabilities.

What you have:

  • 12+ years of experience in FP&A, finance transformation, finance analytics, enterprise performance management (EPM), or related disciplines.

  • Demonstrated ability to gather business requirements into scalable data, reporting, analytics, and technology solutions.

  • Experience operating in a complex, multi-business-unit or multinational environment.

  • Strong understanding of finance data models, master data governance, KPI governance, and forecasting and planning processes.

  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate across Finance, Enterprise Applications and executive leadership teams.

  • Experience building and leading high-performing analytics teams.

  • Experience with modern finance, data analytics platforms, and visualization tools including Snowflake, Databricks, OneStream, Tableau and more.

  • Familiarity with planning and forecasting platforms such as Anaplan, Pigment, and Fintastic is preferred.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Through the Booking Holdings brands, we help our customers reach all corners of the earth. Our ability to provide great service rests on how well we understand our diverse customer base, which is why having a diverse team is so important to us. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

There are a variety of job related factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus and equity grant.

Remote Administrative Support

  • Create routes with maximized capacity and review loads per driver per day goals to maximize profitability.
  • Monitor daily routing activities and resolve issues to ensure pickup and delivery is on time. Evaluate and assess need for swing routes and verify all swing opportunities have been identified.

  • Ability to expect the unexpected and monitor and adjust today and tomorrow’s plans throughout the day.
  • Understand daily disposal plans to help identify optimal disposal sites for each load to hold drivers accountable to adhering to the assigned disposal sites.
  • Meet to discuss disposal plans and recommendations with the Operations Manager and make updates if any intercompany or 3rd party changes occur.

  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE:

  • Courteously interact with customers, as required.
  • Route design is the first defense against customer service issues, and non-compliance from both hours of service and weight compliance standpoint. Routes must be set up in a way that allows drivers to be safe, successful, and efficient.
  • Analyze and prioritize the promises that we make to customers to ensure that these customers are serviced, and our promises are kept.
  • Call Center communication must be updated daily. Continual assessments and communications are required to reduce missed pickups and improve the communication channel between the division and the customers.
  • Evaluate route issues that may cause delays and utilize the tools available to communicate to the impacted customers.
  • Continually review routing media to process service exceptions/general messages/extra services information in order to meet the customer’s needs.
  • Ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction by adhering to and executing our universal service commitments.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities.
  • Skillful with Microsoft Office Suite or similar software.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

The primary purpose of this position is as an Employee Services Program Manager to ensure that residential services are delivered per Washington Administrative Code and administration policy and ensuring the staff are hired and trained to provide for the health and welfare needs of our clients.

This position may supervise administrative staff. This position works collaboratively with field services resource staff, residential case management staff, and members of the SOCR Management Team. The primary purpose of this position is to ensure that residential services are delivered per WAC and administration policy and to ensure the staff are hired and trained to provide for the health and welfare needs of SOCR clients.

Some of what you'll do:

  • Manage all the hiring needs of the program
  • Read reports and interpret data to develop or modify client support plans.
  • Establish processes for meeting goals and objectives within the work unit.
  • Consult on individual cases and complex problems/issues with clients and/or service providers and collaborate with internal teams, service providers, and community partners.
  • Supervise, train, and evaluate staff in a collective bargaining environment, including assigning work, managing caseloads, and supporting performance development.
  • Oversee training coordination, and compliance tracking, including Washington State Learning Center training requirements.
  • Analyze reports and data to inform decision-making, support client service planning, and improve program outcomes.
  • Represent the program in meetings and support operational planning, including staffing needs, performance measures, and process improvements.

What we are looking for:

  • Experience working with Individuals with Developments Disabilities and their families in a social service setting
  • Ability to lead others and organize work assignments
  • Experience consulting with staff on services offered to clients and families
  • Ability to plan, organize, direct, and evaluate the work of others
  • Possess mental health crisis management experience
  • Ability to identify and notify appropriate entities of dangerous situations
  • Demonstrate sensitivity to cultural diversity

Who should apply?

A bachelor’s degree in behavioral sciences, special education, business administration, public administration, or related fields.
And
Four years of professional experience in the human services field of which two years involved individuals with developmental disabilities or other handicapping conditions and one year of supervisory, administrative, or professional program service delivery responsibility.
Graduate training may be substituted year for year for the required experience except for two years involved individuals with developmental disabilities.
Or
Additional Professional experience described above will substitute year for year for the required education.

Interested?

We encourage you to tailor your resume to this position and highlight specific examples of work involving case management, client assessments, service planning, home visits, crisis intervention, eligibility determination, documentation, and coordination with community partners and other agencies.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

We are seeking a technically skilled & highly motivated individual to work within our growing Global IT Organization. This role requires a range of experience supporting Linux servers running customer-facing and internal applications.

What You’ll Do

• Effectively deploy, configure and maintain Linux servers in a Data Center environment.

• Be accountable for server health, uptime, monitoring and disaster recovery.

• Routinely patch, remediate and secure operating systems in alignment with security policies.

• Create and maintain standardized OS templates and employ automation to rapidly deploy virtual machines.

• Assist project teams in technical design, strategy, planning and implementation of server and software rollouts.

• Perform daily operational tasks such as completing change requests, resolving support tickets, server monitoring and problem triage.

• Produce and maintain server documentation.

• Adopt DevOps practices to drive the use of automation to simplify routine tasks.

What You’ll Bring

Key skills

• Linux server installation, configuration and administration (RedHat, Centos).

• Scripting and other automation (ie Shell, Ansible, Perl or Python).

• Performance tuning and troubleshooting.

• VMWare, Networking and storage fundamentals.

• Good, clean documentation skills.

Desirable skills

• AIX or Solaris Server admin.

• Windows Server admin.

• OS security and server hardening .

• Software deployment tools (Octupus, Jenkins, GIT, etc).

• Linux management tools (Red Hat Satellite, Katello Foreman, FreeIPA/RH IDM or Spacewalk).

• Monitoring tools (Icinga, New Relic, Opsview, Zabbix, etc).

• Disaster Recovery methodologies and implementation.

Experience

• 5+ years experience supporting Linux servers in a production environment.

• Undergraduate degree in computer science or related field preferred, or equivalent work experience.

• Working experience in a multi-platform, multi-data center IT environment.

• Experience automating tasks using scripting languages like shell (bash, csh, etc), Perl or Python

• Proven experience supporting web-based applications running on Apache Tomcat.

• Experience creating and maintaining good documentation.

Personal Characteristics

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

• Willingness to identify, implement and drive improvements.

• Proactive, enthusiastic and output driven.

• Flexibility with regards to working outside normal business hours as required.

title: BC Foreman- Outby
description:
We are looking for an Outby Foreman to join our underground team at our Blue Creek mine located in Berry, Alabama. We expect this person to be a role model for the "Warrior Way" and uphold the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and teamwork.

Who We Are:

All teammates are required to work in a manner that exemplifies the “Warrior Way” - Safer, Accountability, Follow Through, Excellence, Responsibility. Mining positions may be required to work various shifts, rotating schedules, weekends, and holidays as scheduled. We provide a generous compensation and benefits package, including incentive plans, 401(k) match, paid time off and company paid medical, dental and vision care - all of which start the day you join the Blue Creek team!

About the Role:

As an Outby foreman you will need to have strong technical skills, leadership abilities, and teamwork spirit. You will also need to comply with all the relevant regulations, standards, and policies regarding mine safety, health, and environment for the daily operations in an underground coal mine.

Responsibilities:

  • Follow all applicable State and Federal safety rules and regulations, and all applicable Company-issued safety guidelines and policies. Ensuring compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and production goals.

  • Conduct proper examinations as required by State, Federal and Mine policy.

  • Coordinate required preventive maintenance and repairs to equipment and communicate results.

  • Coordinate and conduct crew safety and safety meetings.

  • Coordinate and conduct training for safety, task, and operational needs.

  • Inspect mine areas and equipment regularly to identify and correct any hazards or defects.

  • Monitor and control the ventilation, water, and drainage systems to maintain a safe and healthy environment for the team.

  • Install, maintain, and recover underground belts.

  • Coordinate with the production and maintenance departments to ensure the smooth operation of the mine.

  • Train and evaluate the performance of the outby team and enforce the company policies and procedures.

  • Prepare and maintain accurate records and reports of the outby activities, such as inspections, repairs, accidents, and incidents.

  • Respond to and manage any emergencies or disruptions that may occur in the outby areas of the mine.

  • All other duties assigned by management.

Who You Are:

  • Valid Alabama Mine Foreman Certificate.

  • Proficient in the use and maintenance of continuous mining equipment and systems.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and teamwork skills.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  • High attention to safety, detail, and quality.

  • Ability to work under pressure, in challenging and dynamic environments.

Environment and Safety:

  • Improve on safety standards by holding safety meetings, conducting safety interactions, and taking corrective action where required.

  • Ensure adherence to State, Federal and Company workplace policies and standard work procedures for risk identification, risk assessment and risk control.

  • Maintain a high level of Safety performance through effective communication, monitoring, and revision of standard work procedures.

  • Identify and report safety risks, accidents, incidents, injuries, and property damage at the workplace.

  • Attend and participate in all scheduled safety meetings and training.

  • Investigate accidents and near misses with a view toward positive action, through training, equipment set-up or equipment repair and report on findings and conclusions.

  • Maintain environmental awareness amongst the workforce by holding meetings and involving the environmental department in related subjects.

  • Ensure adherence to environmental policy, work standards, management plans and regulatory obligations and requirements.

  • Integrate environmental policies, programs, and practices into all activities of the organization.

Physical Requirements - Underground:

  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time on uneven, rocky surfaces.

  • Must be able to sit for up to 4 hours to operate equipment or vehicles.

  • Must be able to walk for up to 4 hours at a time.

  • Will need to walk through different sections of the mine with different amounts of clearance and headroom.

  • Walking ability will be based on SCSR emergency evacuation plan required and approved by MSHA.

  • Must be able to wear the required protective footwear, hearing and eye protection, and other personal protective equipment as required by Company and MSHA.

  • Must be able to bend or stoop for a full work period because of mine height.

  • Must be able to climb up and down stairs/steps and climb on and off equipment and ladders.

  • Must be able to do repetitive hand and wrist motions (push, pull, twist, handle), and have quick reflex movements of the arms and legs as well as good hand to eye coordination.

  • Must be able to lift 25 to 50 pounds frequently and occasionally lift items weighing up to 75 pounds.

  • Must be able to work in extreme conditions, including but not limited to changing weather conditions, dust, mud, varying levels of noise from low to high decibels, varying degrees of light and dark, in and around artificial light and in a confined work area.

title: FNTS  Sr. IBM iSeries Engineer (Remote/Work from Home)
description:
ABOUT FNTS

As a nationally recognized Cloud Service Provider, FNTS has a proven history guiding our customers through their cloud journey. FNTS has a passion for all things multi-cloud and provides flexible cloud solutions, with a continued focus on orchestrating agility, transparency and IT optimization for our customers, all while keeping cost containment top-of-mind. With an elevated security posture consisting of layered security solutions, FNTS specializes in partnering with customers in highly regulated and compliance-driven industries.

Our culture and our employees are the heart of our story – and we’re committed to their success! Please see below the details of this career opportunity and how it fits into our organization’s success.

Summary of the Job:

The Sr. Engineer, FN Technology Solutions is responsible for a multitude of technologies related to networking. These accountabilities may include routing, load balancing, firewalls and standard protocols. This role works directly with implementations and new projects.

About This Role:

The Sr. IBM iSeries Engineer Position is part of a managed services engineering team. The Sr IBM iSeries Engineer is responsible for maintaining customer IBM i /iSeries environments and solving technical problems in an efficient manner. In addition to maintaining the existing IBM i systems, you will help plan and migrate customer systems via tape save/restore or software replication, expand our existing customer's environments, ensure proper handling of system backups and react in a break/fix capacity to escalate technical issues that compromise system operability and functionality. Candidates for this position must show previous IBM i administrative, operator and support experience in similar environments with emphasis on supporting technology such as BRMS, Replication Software (Mimix/iTera) and common networking knowledge related to IBM i connectivity.

This position is a remote position( work from home) available to work anywhere in the US. This role is not available for Sponsorship due to current contacts with FNTS customers.

Company Overview:

With 30+ years in the managed IT services industry, First National Technology Solutions (FNTS) is a leading provider of flexible, customized hosted and remotely managed services. Operating a state-of-the-art data center and offering customized solutions and best-of-breed technology, FNTS is a nationally recognized leader in managed IT services. With a classic Midwest culture, FNTS employs an expert team who place high value on work ethics and personalized customer service.

FNTS is a subsidiary of First National of Nebraska Inc. (FNNI), a $20 billion multi-state holding company headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, with a strong heritage of banking excellence that dates back more than 150 years.

Job Overview

The Sr. IBM iSeries Engineer Position is part of a managed services engineering team. The Sr IBM iSeries Engineer is responsible for maintaining customer IBM i /iSeries environments and solving technical problems in an efficient manner. In addition to maintaining the existing IBM i systems, you will help plan and migrate customer systems via tape save/restore or software replication, expand our existing customer's environments, ensure proper handling of system backups and react in a break/fix capacity to escalate technical issues that compromise system operability and functionality. Candidates for this position must show previous IBM iSeries administrative, operator and support experience in similar environments with emphasis on supporting technology such as BRMS, Replication Software (Mimix/iTera) and common networking knowledge related to IBM i connectivity.

The Ideal Candidate for This Role:

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to incidents and requests in a timely manner providing in-depth analysis and solutions to meet service level agreements
  • Review previous issues looking for opportunities to proactively avoid future problems as part of the FNTS Continuous Improvement culture
  • Perform reporting functions as required or requested by customer
  • Preparation of special activities (DR Testing/Planning, OS upgrades, PTF deployment)
  • Maintenance and configuration of the IBM i OS and Licensed Program Products (LPP’s)
  • Write and maintain system documentation
  • Work with customers to accomplish their migration to FNTS or remote management setup.
  • Using team roadmap, implement technologies to achieve it, e.g. develop new offerings through taking advantage of new hardware capabilities or additional OS capabilities such as Live Partition Mobility (LPM).
  • Install new software (OS & major subsystem) releases while working with customer on timing/testing/implementation.
  • Maintain golden/sandbox systems for templates
  • Participate in technical infrastructure projects as the IBM i SME

Job Qualifications

  • IBM iSeries System Administration (10+ years experience)
  • Knowledge of i/OS systems from V5R4 to V7R3 and major differentiators
  • Knowledge of POWER systems hardware
  • Experience configuring LPARs using the Hardware Management Console
  • Experience with storage management in JBOD, RAID, and SAN environments and the performance differences with each
  • Experience defining and troubleshooting Printer configurations
  • Experience configuring TCP/IP and associated servers in an IPV4 environment (IPv6 desired)
  • Understanding of journal management
  • Software based replication (MIMIX, iTera, PowerHA)
  • BRMS backup solutions for system recovery/migration
  • Familiarity with Physical and Virtual tape library configuration and implementation
  • OS Upgrades, PTF Deployment and software installation via Image Catalog
  • Experience using performance tools such as MPG
  • Experience configuring and deploying automation and monitoring tools such as Halcyon, absMessage, and Robot products
  • Experience coding and debugging CL
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and presentations)
  • Knowledge of AV/AR, web query, Flash Copy, and Global Mirror desired
Candidates must possess unrestricted work authorization and not require future sponsorship.

Regardless of your location, you'll be fully integrated into our team through robust digital collaboration tools and regular communication. description:

title: Kitchen Exhaust Technician
description:
Who We Are

At Encore Fire Protection, we are proud to be the east coast's largest full-service fire protection company, serving over 90,000 customers from Maine to Louisiana. With a team of over 2,200 dedicated employees, we provide innovative, customized fire suppression, fire sprinkler, and fire alarm solutions that protect lives and properties every day. Our goal is to deliver superior experience to those who trust us to safeguard what matters most. We are passionate about continuous growth, innovation, and maintaining a culture that thrives on success and commitment to safety. Our mission? To be the best fire protection company the industry has ever seen.

The Opportunity

Encore Fire Protection is seeking a Kitchen Exhaust Technician to support our commercial kitchen ventilation and exhaust system services. This is a field-based role that offers hands-on, independent work with limited supervision once training is complete.

In this role, you’ll perform essential fire-prevention services within customer facilities, helping reduce fire risk and support the safe operation of commercial kitchen exhaust and ventilation systems. You’ll represent Encore on job sites by delivering quality workmanship, following established procedures, and maintaining a safety-first mindset.

Key Responsibilities

You are responsible for ensuring work is completed safely, cleanly, and in accordance with Encore standards so customers can operate with confidence. Responsibilities include:

· Clean and degrease commercial kitchen exhaust systems, including hoods, ducts, fans, and rooftop components.

· Set up and break down job sites in accordance with Encore standards to ensure safety, cleanliness, and efficiency.

· Perform power washing and detailed cleaning using specialized tools, equipment, and approved techniques.

· Approach all work with a safety-first mindset while working in customer facilities.

· Maintain company vehicles by organizing, inventorying, and stocking tools and supplies.

· Drive company vehicles to and from job sites throughout the assigned territory.

· Complete assigned work efficiently while maintaining quality standards.

· Support team members on job sites to ensure work is completed safely and professionally.

What You Bring to the Table

· 2–3 years of experience cleaning commercial kitchen exhaust systems (hoods, ducts, and fans).

· Flexibility to work varying schedules based on customer and operational needs.

· Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record.

· Ability to lift and carry up to 60 lbs and climb ladders to access all areas of the exhaust system.

· Comfort performing hands-on, physical, technical, and mechanical work.

· Ability to pass initial and ongoing background checks and drug screenings.

· Dependability, professionalism, and the ability to work independently in the field.

What Will Make You Stand Out?

· High school diploma or equivalent; technical or trade coursework is a plus.

· 3+ years of hands-on kitchen exhaust cleaning experience across a variety of commercial kitchens (restaurants, hotels, schools, healthcare, or industrial facilities).

· Leadership experience on job sites (acting as a lead tech, training newer technicians, or coordinating job setup and breakdown).

· Knowledge of kitchen exhaust system requirements and inspection readiness, including familiarity with NFPA 96 expectations.

· Certifications such as IKECA Technician certification (or the ability and willingness to obtain it).

· Safety credentials such as OSHA 10 (or willingness to obtain), and comfort working safely at heights and on rooftops.

title: International Operation Specialist
description:

About SEKO

SEKO started out in business in 1976, operating out of a single Chicago office. Since then, we have built a solid reputation throughout the world as an innovative and flexible provider of first-class logistics services. We provide complete Supply Chain Solutions, specializing in transportation, logistics, forwarding and warehousing. We also lead the industry with innovative and customizable IT solutions, which provide a seamless flow of information and give our growing customer base true supply chain visibility. With over 120 offices in 40 countries worldwide, our unique shareholder management model enables you to benefit from Global implementation experience and expertise across all industry sectors, coupled with vital in-country knowledge and service at the local level.

  • Communicates with customers via phone, email, and company web portal.
  • Manages time specific pickups and provides best import routing by Ocean and Air.

title: VP Digital Editorial
location: Bristol, Connecticut, United States of America
description:
At ESPN, we are shaping the future of sports storytelling and how fans discover, experience, and engage with sports across digital platforms.

The Vice President, Digital Editorial will be a senior leader responsible for defining and advancing ESPN’s digital editorial strategy, ensuring our storytelling remains distinctive, relevant, innovative, and deeply connected to fans. This leader will set the vision for how ESPN creates, packages, distributes, and evolves digital content while balancing editorial excellence, audience growth, innovation, and business performance.

Leading a multi-layered organization of editors, reporters, and digital content leaders, the VP will bring exceptional editorial judgment, strong business acumen, and a deep understanding of evolving consumer behaviors, technology, and the sports media landscape.

What You’ll Do

Set the Digital Editorial Vision & Strategy

  • Define and drive a forward-looking digital editorial strategy that strengthens ESPN’s leadership in sports storytelling and aligns with broader audience and business priorities.
  • Anticipate shifts in consumer behavior, technology, platforms, and the competitive landscape to evolve how ESPN creates, packages, distributes, and delivers digital content.

Drive Audience Growth, Engagement & Innovation

  • Drive audience growth and engagement through distinctive storytelling, editorial franchises, and innovative content experiences across platforms.
  • Leverage audience insights, performance data, and market trends to inform editorial priorities, investment decisions, and new opportunities for growth.
  • Champion innovation in how fans discover, consume, and engage with ESPN content while maintaining the highest standards of editorial quality, accuracy, and credibility.

Lead the Business & Organization

  • Lead and develop a multi-layered digital editorial organization, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and high performance.
  • Own the financial and operating priorities of the function, ensuring resources and investments are aligned to ESPN’s highest-impact audience and business opportunities.
  • Partner across Programming, Product, Technology, Marketing, Research, Sales, Finance, and The Walt Disney Company to connect digital editorial strategy with broader fan experience and business objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in digital editorial, journalism, media, content, or a related field, including significant senior leadership responsibility.
  • A minimum of 7 years of experience leading managers, senior leaders, and multi-layered organizations.
  • Demonstrated success defining and executing digital editorial or content strategies within a complex media, sports, entertainment, or consumer-facing organization.
  • Exceptional editorial judgment and storytelling expertise, with experience overseeing high-profile, complex, and multi-platform content.
  • Deep understanding of digital audience behavior, content distribution, emerging platforms, and the evolving ways consumers discover and engage with content.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage audience insights, data, and market trends to inform editorial strategy, prioritize opportunities, and drive measurable outcomes.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including experience managing budgets, evaluating investments, allocating resources, and connecting editorial strategies to business performance.
  • Proven ability to anticipate industry and consumer shifts and translate them into innovative editorial strategies, capabilities, and experiences.
  • Exceptional leadership capabilities with a track record of building, developing, and inspiring high-performing teams and senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior executives and cross-functional partners within a complex, highly matrixed organization.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to articulate a compelling vision, simplify complexity, and establish credibility across an organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Senior leadership experience within sports media, digital publishing, streaming, subscription, or another scaled consumer media business.
  • Deep familiarity with the sports ecosystem, fan behavior, audience development, and the evolving media and technology landscape.
  • Proven success developing distinctive editorial franchises and multi-platform content initiatives that have driven meaningful audience growth and engagement.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation or modernizing editorial operations, capabilities, workflows, and talent.
  • Familiarity with emerging technologies and their implications for content creation, discovery, personalization, distribution, and audience engagement.

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media, Business, or a related field.

The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $ 236,000.00 to $316,500.00per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

  • Mindset: Adaptable, growth-oriented mindset with a strong willingness to work flexibly across different product domains.

title: Mechanical/Aerospace System Engineer
description:
Overview

Job Title: Mechanical/Aerospace System Engineer

Location: Maryland: AEDC White Oak Campus MD

Job Family Code: O- Engineering

Function/Branch: Tunnel 9

Directorate: Test Operations

Position Type: Regular, Full time

Pay Type: Exempt

Sponsorship: Position Not Sponsored

Grade: M07 (OA0717) – M08 (OA0815)

Salary Range: M07: $87,000 - $119,500, M08: $107,200 - $147,300

Overview

Open to External candidates. Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an exciting opportunity for a Mechanical or Aerospace Systems Engineer, supporting TOS II, at Tunnel 9 in Silver Spring, MD. The Systems Engineer will be working as a member of an integrated team responsible for operating and maintaining, as well as supporting tests the United States Air Force Test Operations and Sustainment efforts.

Job Summary

Systems Engineers provide engineering functions to support hypersonic wind-tunnel testing at Tunnel 9. The candidate will take ownership of major systems; coordinate facility and equipment improvement projects; follow project lifecycle (planning, budgeting, schedule, execution); perform mechanical design of tunnel components and interface hardware; develop many design drawing packages; develop/review analysis for thermo-mechanical structural and stress analysis reports for components in the wind tunnel; and develop improvements to tunnel performance and maintainability.

Job Duties:

  • Own assigned systems across their full lifecycle, including configuration control, reliability, maintainability, upgrades, and end-of-life planning.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute facility and equipment improvement projects, including scope development, budgeting, scheduling, procurement support, installation, testing, and closeout.
  • Develop mechanical designs for components, tooling, fixtures, interface hardware, and modifications needed to support test operations.
  • Produce, review, and maintain engineering drawing packages, models, bills of material, and release documentation in accordance with configuration-management requirements.
  • Perform or review thermo-mechanical, structural, and stress analyses to verify component suitability for wind-tunnel operating environments.
  • Coordinate with operations, technicians, safety, instrumentation, controls, maintenance, and test customers to ensure systems are ready and test requirements are met.
  • Identify and implement improvements to tunnel performance, availability, operability, and maintainability based on test experience, data, and failure trends.
  • Develop technical scopes of work and support vendor/manufacturer engagement for repairs, fabrication, and procured equipment.
  • Ensure engineering changes, maintenance actions, and temporary modifications are documented, reviewed, approved, and communicated appropriately.
  • Review test requests and facility impacts to determine system readiness, constraints, risks, and required modifications or support.
  • Communicate clearly and utilize various methods of communication.
  • It is a condition of employment to wear PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering with a minimum of 2 years of professional mechanical or aerospace engineering experience.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance and the AEDC local area network.
  • Due to Air Force Security requirements, U.S. Citizenship is required for employment at AEDC.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master of Science degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering
  • Active Secret clearance
  • Hands on mechanical design, maintenance, or operations experience acquired through previous employment, education, or internship
  • Experience using PTC Creo CAD software
  • Experience performing Finite Element Analysis (FEA), especially using Ansys software

What We Offer

  • Competitive salaries
  • Continuing education assistance
  • Multiple healthcare benefits packages
  • 401K with employer matching
  • Paid time off (PTO) along with a federally recognized holiday schedule

Who We Are

Beyond New Horizons (BNH) is a fully populated joint venture of Astrion and Fluor Federal Services, Inc. formed to provide unmatched Test Operations and Sustainment services for the Arnold Engineering Development Complex.

We chose our name to serve as an enduring reminder of our commitment to AEDC’s rich aerospace research and development legacy anchored in AEDC’s Toward New Horizons founding study and the unprecedented opportunities to greatly expand AEDC’s capabilities and capacity Beyond those existing today. Leveraging the capabilities of our parent companies, BNH specializes in testing and evaluation for military and space systems combined with proven capability in large-scale Government program management, integration, engineering, and construction services for specialized and technically advanced high-hazard facilities.

Join our Team!

U.S. Citizenship is required. At this time BNH will not sponsor any applicants for employment authorization or offer any immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1b, F1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, E-2, E-3, L-1, or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Salaries for part-time jobs will be adjusted based upon the number of hours agreed to work at location Tennessee: Arnold Air Force, TN.

description:

  • Complete required route/productivity sheets, VCRs and other reports, as required.

  • Follow all required safety policies and procedures.
