title: Counsel, Commercial
description:
Overview

As a member of the Corporate legal team, you will provide exceptional legal services to internal business units by responding to routine matters and questions in a timely manner. You will also review, draft and negotiate various contracts, but not limited to business associate agreements and statements of work. Additional responsibilities include contracts library research, administration, review of regulatory agreements and answering inquiries on RFPs.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the drafting, review, negotiation, and management of complex commercial agreements, including customer agreements, master services agreements, statements of work, vendor agreements, NDAs, licensing agreements, partnership agreements, business associate agreements, and other strategic contracts.
  • Apply advanced legal and business judgment to evaluate complex contract terms, variable risk factors, regulatory considerations, and business objectives; recommend creative, practical, and effective solutions that balance legal risk with commercial goals.
  • Independently determine appropriate negotiation strategies, methods, and procedures for new or complex assignments, adapting established legal principles, templates, playbooks, and evaluation criteria to achieve business-aligned outcomes.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on complex commercial, operational, and regulatory matters, translating legal concepts into clear guidance and influencing outcomes through sound reasoning, persuasion, and business acumen.
  • Understand and evaluate the interrelationships among legal, sales, operations, finance, compliance, privacy, security, and other business functions to identify downstream impacts and support coordinated decision-making.
  • Develop, enhance, and guide the application of contract templates, standard terms, negotiation playbooks, policies, procedures, and workflow improvements to improve consistency, efficiency, scalability, and risk management across the commercial contracting process.
  • Resolve complex contracting issues and escalations by analyzing facts, data, precedent, stakeholder positions, and business context; exercise independent judgment in selecting, adapting, and communicating recommended courses of action.
  • Support strategic transactions, partnerships, renewals, amendments, terminations, and other business initiatives from initial discussion through execution, ensuring alignment with company objectives and applicable legal requirements.
  • Prepare and review legal summaries, termination analyses, risk assessments, correspondence, and other documents that synthesize complex information for legal, business, and leadership audiences.
  • Monitor relevant legal, regulatory, industry, and business developments and advise stakeholders on potential commercial implications, recommended actions, and updates to practices or documentation.
  • Network and collaborate with key contacts outside the immediate legal function, including senior business stakeholders and outside counsel, to drive timely resolution of complex matters and support tactical business targets.
  • Frequently provide guidance to business partners and less experienced team members on complex contracting matters, negotiation approaches, risk considerations, and internal processes.
  • Maintain contract records, status tracking, and reporting in applicable systems and support continual improvement of contract administration, review, approval, and knowledge-management practices.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • J.D. or equivalent law degree from an accredited law school.
  • Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • 6+ years legal experience with a law firm or corporate legal department handling contract matters.
  • Ability to work remotely with minimal interruptions to the work day.
  • Proven ability to learn the legal and business drivers of complex contracts.
  • A particular focus on healthcare, technology, and/or professional services
  • Experience handling and negotiating contracts and related agreements preferred.
  • Ability to define problems, consolidate relevant information, establish facts, and draw and defend valid conclusions.
  • Ability to read and apply laws and government regulations with support of in-house counsel.
  • Ability to work independently on matters within purview of the position.
  • Strong PC skills, particularly MS Office Suite of applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly to non-lawyers.
  • Strong judgment and ability to assess risk in the context of business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly collaborative, pragmatic, and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Sense of humor a plus.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

  • Analyze and interpret contracts, legal issues, and business requirements to identify risks, obligations, and appropriate actions.
  • Apply legal reasoning and research to develop sound conclusions, recommendations, and negotiation strategies.
  • Exercise judgment and problem-solving when evaluating contract terms, resolving issues, and determining when matters require escalation.
  • Manage and synthesize information from multiple contracts, systems, databases, and sources while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Communicate complex information clearly through legal summaries, correspondence, reports, and other documents tailored to legal and business audiences.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.

Base compensation ranges from $100,000 to $120,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Date of posting: 08/24/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 08/24/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

description:
Position Title:

Video Producer, World News, Jerusalem (English Services)

Status of Employment:

Temporary Long-Term (Fixed Term)

Position Language Requirement:

English

Language Skills:

English (Reading - P - Professional), English (Speaking - P - Professional), English (Writing - P - Professional)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-10-01 11:59 PM

CBC News is looking for an innovative and versatile video producer with a strong interest in world news and excellent field video producing skills to join our new bureau in Jerusalem, covering the Middle East. If you’re a creator at heart and enjoy storytelling and producing content across visual formats, this job could be for you.

At a time when the world, and Canada’s place within it, is rapidly changing, being present on the ground to bring stories Canadians want and need to know about is critical. As part of our expanding world coverage team, you’ll work closely with a correspondent in Jerusalem, your colleagues in other world bureaus and journalists with Radio-Canada, who will also be working in the Jerusalem bureau.

You bring a deep knowledge of the historical complexities of the Middle East and the confidence to help shape the CBC News editorial coverage.

You’re a technical whiz who will be shooting, editing, packaging and publishing content using a variety of gear and apps. This includes social video content, live hits, live streams and on demand content.

You are also strong editorially. You have story ideas and are thinking about creative treatments to attract new and younger audiences through social-first formats. You excel at guiding stories from concept to post-production, and are quick to pivot when plans change.

You are deeply committed to the values of a public service broadcaster. You uphold the CBC Journalistic Standards and Practices, especially our core principles of accuracy, fairness, balance, impartiality and integrity.

You understand that stories can break at any time of the day and you have a genuine desire to be on-top of that coverage. The position requires long-hours, flexible schedules and a willingness to deploy on a moment’s notice, including to conflict zones. The minimum assignment length for this position is two years and, if agreed to by both parties, may be extended for up to an additional two years.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Pitches, shoots, produces and edits short and long-form digital-first video content tailored for platforms like TikTok and YouTube as well as CBC.ca.

  • Manage on-the-ground gear — including cameras, portable lighting, and wireless mics — to capture visually impactful footage and clean audio for news content.

  • Ingest, organize, assemble, and edit raw footage into compelling narrative formats using industry-standard software (such as Premiere Pro); attention to good sound design and mixing; knowledge of basic motion graphics/titles to elevate production value.

  • Generate and execute compelling journalism, including researching, writing, generating and editing video, audio and text.

  • Performing location surveys and identifying special requirements such as audio, lighting, camera angles and equipment, including production limitations.

  • Providing technical guidance and expertise focused on content production techniques, workflows and creative content gathering techniques for complex situations.

  • Collaborate effectively across CBC News to ensure comprehensive coverage across multiple platforms, programs and locations.

What is required:

  • You are a seasoned video-journalist with at least five (5) years of directly related field experience at a network/national level and, preferably in a foreign environment, who thrives in a deadline driven, high pressure environment.

  • A superior level of technical knowledge and understanding of live coverage, social treatments, visual gathering, visual production and post-production methods and remote filing tools.

  • A strong sense of creativity, initiative and a high degree of responsibility for the accuracy and quality of work throughout the complete production cycle.

  • Demonstrated editorial skills, showing proficiency in story preparation and production of highly creative, innovative visual storytelling, from story generation through to the final edits.

  • Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills are required, including active listening, problem-solving and an ability to work across teams.

  • Ability to work independently in a deadline-driven environment while maintaining a professional attitude.

  • Must possess a valid passport and have the ability and willingness to travel internationally on short notice.

  • Graduate degree/diploma from a University or Community college in a relevant course of study or equivalent industry experience.

  • Ability and willingness to work overtime and various shift patterns including overnights and weekends.

Your application will be evaluated on your experience, as well as your portfolio of work.

Please include at least two examples of:

  • Digital / social stories you produced and shot

  • Packaged daily news video content you shot and edited

  • A cover letter that tells us why you want this role, and how you will use your experience to support the bureau

Please, do not use Generative AI in your work samples or cover letter unless, of course, your work example is a story about AI. Consult these guidelines for helpful tips on how to apply, know what’s the process, and how to put your best foot forward.

title: Fresh Foods Clerk
description:
About Us

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Job Summary

Assist customers by providing over-the-counter service and customer service throughout the Fresh Foods department. Operates and maintains the fresh food production areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza), prepares the areas for sales, fries food, operates the rotisserie oven, prepares ready-to-bake/baked pizzas, etc. Receives inventory, verifies receipt of ordered product, and stocks in designated areas. Consistently provides friendly, courteous service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work. Generally works 6-8 hour shifts between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve, and thank customers. Maintains an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Takes orders, answers questions, and performs suggestive selling.
  • Prepares, stocks, displays, straightens, and rotates product in fresh food areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza).

title: Portier Beveiliger
description:
Cargill in Gouda, onderdeel van de multinational Cargill Inc., is wereldwijd een groeiende en dynamische leverancier van standaard en speciale oleochemicaliën. Cargill in Gouda produceert meer dan 200 producten op basis van natuurlijke en vernieuwbare grondstoffen. Deze producten worden verwerkt in onder andere coatings, plastics, kleefmiddelen, wasmiddelen en persoonlijke verzorgingsproducten.

Voor onze site security zijn wij op zoek naar een:

Portier / Beveiliger (5-ploegendienst)

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de toegangsregistratie en controle
  • Je ontvangt bezoekers, personeel en bent het eerste aanspreekpunt
  • Je moet snel kunnen schakelen, je zorgt er voor dat alle binnenkomende alarmmeldingen (en telefoongesprekken buiten kantooruren) correct worden ontvangen en verwerkt
  • Je houdt toezicht op het terrein door middel van camerasystemen
  • Je controleert en verwerkt transport documenten
  • Je maakt controlerondes op het terrein
  • Je hebt een belangrijke rol in de calamiteitenorganisatie

Activiteiten

Als beveiliger heb je een uitdagende functie waarbij service en veiligheid centraal staan. Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende afdelingen en moet snel kunnen schakelen tussen de verschillende werkzaamheden. Het ene moment houd je toezicht bij binnenkomst personeel en bezoekers of verwerkt logistieke documenten en het andere moment neem je acties bij inkomende alarmen en ben je de spil in de calamiteiten organisatie. Het uitgangspunt is altijd een veilige omgeving behouden voor aanwezig personeel, bezoekers en collega’s.

    • Het uitvoeren van meldkamer werkzaamheden; hierbij kun je denken aan het observeren van de camerabeelden en het signaleren van ongewenste personen en situaties, het ontvangen en verwerken van alarmen, het alarmeren van interne hulpdiensten en overheidshulpdiensten;
    • Mede verantwoordelijkheid voor de sleuteluitgifte en beheer;
    • Informeren, attenderen en adviseren van overige afdelingen over veiligheidsmaatregelen;
    • Een belangrijke bijdrage leveren aan de BHV organisatie;
    • Verwerken van laad- en losopdracht documenten van in- en uitgaande goederen;
    • Kleine onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan eigen systemen;

Profiel

Als beveiliger moet je snel kunnen schakelen. Hierbij is het een voorwaarde dat je sterk in je schoenen staat. Je kan met verschillende emoties te maken krijgen van personeel en bezoekers en het is belangrijk dat je in staat bent hier op de juiste manier mee om te gaan en situaties goed in kunt schatten.

    • Diploma MBO beveiliger of bereid deze te behalen;
    • Certificaat EHBO;
    • Ervaring in een servicegerichte functie of klantvriendelijke omgeving;
    • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (mondeling en schriftelijk) en kennis van de Engelse en Duitse taal (mondeling);
    • Gedegen kennis en ervaring met het werken met MS Office en bij voorkeur SAP;
    • Uitstekende communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden;
    • Representatief voorkomen en een goede fysieke en mentale gesteldheid;
    • Oplossingsgericht, dienstverlenend en gedisciplineerd;
    • Flexibel inzetbaar en bereid om op onregelmatige tijden en dagen te werken in een 24/7 setting;
    • Stressbestendig en een echte teamplayer.

Wat wij bieden

Wij bieden een dynamische en prettig werkomgeving. Er is veel ruimte voor het nemen van initiatief. Ben jij ambitieus en wil je graag doorgroeien? Cargill biedt uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden en secundaire voorwaarden. Naast een salaris tussen de € 3.342,- en € 4.123,- ontvang je 8% vakantiegeld, een goed pensioen en 29% ploegentoeslag voor het werken in een 5-ploegendienst rooster. Je krijgt 24 vrije dagen. Vanaf je 35e lopen deze elke vijf jaar op met een extra dag met een maximum van 6 extra vrije dagen. Ook krijg jij de kans om door te groeien, te leren en je te ontwikkelen.

Interesse?

Ben jij de Portier / Beveiliger die wij zoeken? Dan wordt het tijd dat wij jou gaan ontmoeten. Ik ontvang graag je CV en motivatiebrief. Reageer direct en dan neem ik, Gencer, contact met je op.

Volg ons op LinkedIn:
Cargill streeft ernaar een inclusieve werkgever te zijn. Klik hier voor meer informatie

title: Director, Workplace Technology
description:
The Director of Workplace Technology serves as a strategic leader overseeing the full lifecycle and performance of daily technologies used by employees at DFCI across all regional sites. The Director oversees high-performing teams that deliver endpoint management and on-site support for user workstations, thin clients, peripheral replacements, mobile devices, and printer support, asset troubleshooting, and the deployment of new operating systems. The Director is responsible for setting the vision and roadmap for end-user technology services, ensuring that all solutions align with the institution’s mission and operational needs. The successful candidate will bring a customer-focused mindset and a proven track record of building high-performing teams, optimizing processes, and implementing scalable solutions in a dynamic healthcare environment.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for technical support and asset deployment.
  • Drive the strategy for workstation management, including imaging, patch management, and security compliance for Windows, macOS, iOS/Android devices, and thin-client environments in collaboration with DFCI stakeholders.
  • Manage the lifecycle of all IT assets, from procurement and provisioning of new assets to secure decommissioning and peripheral replacement.
  • Partner with peers in Facilities to ensure timely moves and new campus go-lives.
  • Collaborate with Security and Infrastructure teams to ensure endpoint configurations meet rigorous corporate safety standards.
  • Continuously improve the on-site support experience through feedback loops and user-centric design of IT services.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop multi-functional teams to deliver world-class IT services and support across eight New England campuses, in addition to a future 300-bed inpatient oncology hospital, opening in 2031.
  • Supervises staff. Hires, develops, and manages staff to achieve organizational goals. Sets clear expectations, delivers feedback, and monitors performance for quality, efficiency, and compliance with policies and procedures. Mentors staff, fosters career growth, and cultivates a positive and productive work environment.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated knowledge of IT service delivery best practices, including the development and oversight of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for technical support and asset deployment. Ability to monitor service outcomes, identify performance gaps, and implement improvements that increase efficiency, quality, and user satisfaction. Skilled in using metrics to drive accountability and operational excellence across distributed support environments.
  • A track record of prioritizing the "end-user experience" during migrations, ensuring that technical changes do not cause significant productivity dips for the institute.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise workstation management, including imaging, software deployment, patching, device configuration, and security compliance across Windows, macOS, iOS/Android, and thin-client environments. Ability to define and execute endpoint strategies in collaboration with key stakeholders to support reliability, scalability, and standardized user experiences. Proven ability to manage relationships with hardware and software vendors (e.g., Dell, HP), including contract negotiations and performance reviews.
  • Strong knowledge of IT asset lifecycle management, including procurement, provisioning, inventory control, refresh planning, peripheral replacement, and secure decommissioning. title: Product Manager, VP – Business Finance Technology
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Business Description:

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTI) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone’s businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency, and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTI is fast paced and entrepreneurial – our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development means that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge

Role:

This role is responsible for leading and executing product and project workstreams across a varied set of stakeholders, with a strong emphasis on engineering-aligned solution delivery. You will partner closely with Finance and Operations teams across the firm –including Real Estate and Private Equity to design and implement scalable, code-driven solutions that automate complex business processes and calculation models.

The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of product, business analysis, and engineering – either an engineer transitioning into product/business roles or a product manager/business analyst with strong technical fluency.

All projects are prioritized and selected to achieve measurable operational efficiencies and contribute to our stakeholders’ technology strategy.

Responsibilities:

  • Translate business needs into clear, structured technical requirements, including data models, logic flows, and system interactions

  • Partner closely with engineering teams to design scalable, maintainable solutions using modern programming languages and architectures

  • Identify and drive opportunities to re-platform or modernize legacy solutions into modern code-based implementations

  • Design, build, and implement solutions leveraging the most appropriate technologies (e.g., Python, SQL, cloud-based services)

  • Contribute to solution architecture discussions, including trade-offs across performance, scalability, and maintainability

  • Manage project delivery – define milestones, track progress, and provide clear updates to stakeholders

  • Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) with a focus on validating logic, data integrity, and system behavior

  • Oversee data migration, reconciliation, and validation, ensuring accuracy and auditability of outputs

  • Collaborate with offshore and affiliate teams with an emphasis on clear technical communication and alignment

  • Serve as a technical-functional bridge, supporting end users while guiding adoption of more robust, engineering-driven solutions

  • Promote and establish best practices in system design, data management, and process automation

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or software engineering, preferably in a hybrid or highly technical role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field

  • Prior experience in real estate or private equity along with knowledge of performance calculations, deal life cycle, forecasting, and investor reporting

  • Demonstrated experience working closely with engineering teams and translate business requirements into implementable technical specifications

  • Strong working knowledge of programming and data manipulation (e.g., Python, SQL APIs, data pipelines, or backend logic preferred)

  • Experience designing or contributing to code-based solutions (beyond configuration-driven tools)

  • Familiarity with software development concepts: version control, testing, modular design, and deployment practices

  • Experience with modern data/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma) with an understanding of underlying data structures

  • Exposure to cloud platforms or modern data architectures is a plus

  • Experience operating as a hands-on individual contributor while influencing technical direction

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with comfort operating in complex environments

  • Excellent communication skills, with experience bridging business and technical audiences effectively

  • Experience summarizing complex concepts succinctly for senior stakeholders

  • Comfortable working in a global, cross-functional team environment

The Professional, Data & Analytics Reporting job is responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing moderately complex datasets to generate actionable insights and builds detailed reports and dashboards using specifics tools. This job supports the effective presentation of data findings to partners to meet business objectives.

Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Job Summary

Supports, analyzes, and documents an Enterprise WAN/LAN/WLAN focused on corporate offices, stores, and distribution centers. Installs, configures, and maintains all network hardware and software to meet network performance requirements of the company. Diagnoses, resolves and documents hardware and software network problems in a timely and accurate manner, ensuring minimal downtime. Provide end user training, consulting, and assistance as required. Will manage IT network projects at times. Consistently provides world class customer service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with IT Staff to create optimal network performance and configurations.
  • Provide system support for all aspects of cabling and networking hardware and software products.
  • Maintain all network hardware and software including routers, switches, WLAN controllers, VPNs, and PBX’s.
  • Monitor network performance and respond to alerts as necessary.
  • Maintain security solutions, including firewall, intrusion prevention systems and VPN’s.
  • Practice network asset management, including maintenance of network component inventory.
  • Conduct research on network products, services, protocols and standards in support of network procurement and development efforts.
  • Prepare and ensure accuracy of documentation, procedure manuals, and help guides for network installations.
  • Respond to emergency network outages.
  • Perform on-site analysis, diagnosis, and resolution of common network problems for hardware and software solutions.
  • Conduct automated routine updates to network infrastructure configurations.
  • Maintain current knowledge of business continuity and disaster recovery plan executables.
  • Participate in incident response for network or security related instances.
  • Provide guidance and training to IT Staff as required.
  • Manage assigned projects to deliver services that meet established objectives on time and within budget.

title: Gasoline Engine Controls Software Engineer
description:
In this position...
As a member of the Engine Controls software team, you will collaborate across departments—including calibration, systems engineering, and vehicle integration—to develop robust, production-ready solutions for current and next-generation boosted engine programs.

What you'll do...

  • Design and implement embedded engine controls and diagnostic monitors within the powertrain control module software

  • 3 years of experience with programming embedded automotive controls in the C language.
  • 3 years of experience with testing and debugging of automotive embedded controls.
  • 3 years of experience with C software development in automotive powertrain systems.
  • 3 years of experience with software version control, ClearCase and GitHub.
  • 3 years of experience with Matlab Simulink Software Development and Simulation.


Even better, you may have…

  • M.S. degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related field
  • Experience with fuel injection, 3-way catalyst, gas particulate filters, and exhaust sensor controls and diagnostic monitors

title: Senior Digital Health Innovation Analyst
description:
Serving as an internal consultant across Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, the Senior Digital Health Innovation Analyst identifies, evaluates, implements, and optimizes emerging digital health technologies that address business and clinical challenges. As part of the Digital Health Innovation Group (DHIG), this role partners with innovators across Dana-Farber to understand user needs, conduct discovery and applied research, benchmark external trends and leading practices, and translate insights into practical digital health strategies, pilots, and scalable solutions.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, DFCI Digital Consulting Services, the Senior Digital Health Innovation Analyst partners across IT, operations, clinical, research, and innovation teams to assess opportunities, improve performance and workflows, and deliver high-impact solutions that enhance patient, provider, and staff experiences and/or create sustainable revenue streams.

This position is funded through September 2028, with the potential for extension.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as an internal consultant to clinical, research, operational, and administrative teams, leading intake, discovery, and opportunity assessment for digital health innovation; clarify problem statements, user needs, strategic objectives, scope, success metrics, and evaluation approaches.
  • Partner cross-functionally with clinical, research, operations, IT, compliance, privacy, security, patient-facing, and staff-facing stakeholders to conduct interviews, workshops, workflow observation, and needs assessment; synthesize findings into feasible digital solutions that address business and clinical challenges.
  • Guide the planning, implementation, and delivery of digital health pilots and solutions, partnering with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to align on approach, timelines, risks, requirements, testing, training, go-live, stabilization, and post-launch optimization to support adoption and operational performance.
  • Conduct external benchmarking, market scans, literature and industry research, and vendor/partner engagement to evaluate emerging capabilities, compare leading practices, inform solution selection, support demos and RFP processes, and help manage deliverables, performance, and issue resolution.
  • Develop clear, decision-oriented documentation and implementation artifacts, including research summaries, benchmark findings, recommendations, workflow analyses, requirements, roadmaps, and governance approaches to support adoption, enhancements, delivery planning, and change management.
  • Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to assess user needs, adoption, experience, outcomes, efficiency, and ROI; synthesize internal findings and external benchmarks into actionable insights and recommendations for leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Advise stakeholders on alignment with institutional strategy and ensure solutions are evaluated and implemented in accordance with applicable policies, regulatory requirements, and risk considerations, including privacy, HIPAA, security, clinical safety, and data stewardship.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of primary and secondary research methods used to identify digital health opportunities, including stakeholder interviews, workshop facilitation, workflow observation, process mapping, opportunity mapping, landscape assessment, external benchmarking, and gap analysis; ability to synthesize findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Skill in eliciting, documenting, and managing business, functional, and non-functional requirements; ability to translate requirements into workflows, user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Skill in analyzing qualitative and quantitative data; ability to define success metrics and evaluate outcomes related to adoption, user experience, operational efficiency, and return on investment.
  • Knowledge of end-to-end digital health delivery methodologies, including human-centered design, applied research, prototyping, pilot execution, implementation, post-go-live optimization, change adoption, and benefits realization.
  • Knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, vendor landscapes, peer institution practices, and evolving care and operating models; ability to translate external insights into relevant digital health use cases, strategic options, and implementation recommendations.
  • Skill in written, visual, and verbal communication; ability to tailor messages for frontline staff, operational stakeholders, and executive audiences.
  • Skill in managing complex cross-functional projects and programs from discovery through delivery, including charter development, project planning, scheduling, status reporting, dependency tracking, risk and issue management, vendor coordination, implementation readiness, and adoption support.
  • Ability to prioritize and execute multiple concurrent initiatives with strong follow-through, dependability, and attention to detail.
  • Skill in stakeholder engagement, meeting facilitation, and consensus-building; ability to negotiate scope, timelines, and expectations, and resolve issues through root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving.
  • Knowledge of digital health solution readiness requirements, including compliance, accessibility, health literacy, privacy, security, data stewardship, and WCAG standards; skill in using relevant collaboration and delivery tools and methodologies such as Microsoft 365, Smartsheet, Agile, and Lean UX; ability to mentor others and drive continuous process improvement.

Minimum Job Qualifications

  • High school diploma required. Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Business, or related field preferred.
  • 8 – 10 years of experience in business and/or healthcare required.
  • Proven experience shaping solutions for complex business, clinical, and operational challenges preferred.
  • Experience leading workshops to align leaders on outcomes and tradeoffs and running hands‑on user research to test assumptions preferred.

  • Experience advising stakeholders on prioritizing and sequencing work, and making realistic decisions based on feasibility, risk, and value preferred.

License/Certification/Registration Required: None

Supervisory Responsibilities: No

Patient Contact: No

title: Retail Employee
description:
Overview

The Retail Employee / Project Specialist is responsible for performing a range of duties that ensures our customers have an amazing experience whether shopping in our store or picking up an order.

This is a non-commissioned, hourly sales & register-focused position that operates days, evenings & primarily weekends. This role focuses on two primary objectives:

  • Providing excellent customer service on our sales floor while actively engaging in selling behaviors, completing selling interactions, and driving store profit.

  • Tendering customer transactions at checkout with speed and accuracy while actively enrolling 35% of our customers in the Container Store loyalty/reward program.

Additional responsibilities include:

  • Retrieving customer orders from our stockroom & loading their vehicles.

  • Cleaning assignments including sales floor, breakroom, stockroom, & restroom areas.

To be eligible for this position, you must have a minimum of weekend availability (Saturday and Sunday).

What We Stand For

Established in 1978, The Container Store has grown to be the leading specialty retailer of storage and organization products in the United States and the only national retailer solely devoted to the category. We provide creative, multifunctional, customizable storage and organization solutions that help our customers save time, save space and improve the quality of their lives. We foster a culture built around our Foundation Principles, which define how we approach our relationships with our employees, vendors, customers and communities and influence every aspect of our business.

Responsibilities

  • Welcomes and greets all customers either as Host in the front entrance or throughout the store
  • Connects with our customers throughout the store suggesting solutions to their organizational challenges
  • Designs and sells custom closets and other storage and organization solutions
  • Serves as a register person with strong focus on providing a great customer experience during check out
  • Introduces and enrolls customers in our rewards program
  • Works merchandise processing during early morning or evenings (based on the schedule)
  • Maintains the Sales Floor – keeping shelves full and presented according to our brand standards.
  • Supports carryout to our customers cars whether through curbside or in the parking lot/garages.
  • Assists with cleaning routines around the store – including dusting, restrooms and vacuuming
  • Processes customers’ orders for curbside pick-up and/or delivery
  • Organizes the stockroom, ensuring it is well-maintained to support selling efforts of the store
  • Adheres to the time expectations established for the role, performing tasks with accuracy and timeliness, while exhibiting pace and attention to detail
  • Actively engages with customers to solve their organizational challenges

We believe in taking care of our team. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package that goes beyond just health insurance (though we've got that covered too!). Here at The Container Store, we're passionate about helping you contain your health, grow your career, and find balance in your life.

Here's a peek at what you can expect:

  • Rewarding pay to recognize the value you bring to the team.
  • Competitive health, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your loved ones well.
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with optional investment guidance and assistance offered through Fidelity.
  • Unique "1equals3" website for easy access to your benefits information and company updates.
  • We've got your back! Competitive sick pay and PTO plan to ensure you can take time off to recharge and come back feeling your best.

For our full-time associates, we offer even more:

  • Peace-of-mind benefits: Basic life insurance, disability insurance options, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, hospital indemnity insurance and flexible spending accounts (FSAs).
  • Family-focused support: Considerate parental leave policies, adoption and surrogacy assistance, and fertility & maternity support program.
  • Work-life balance boosters: Paid holidays, gym membership discounts, and a qualified transportation benefits program to save on commutes.
  • Discounts galore: Enjoy a hefty discount on our amazing products, including merchandise, custom spaces, and services, gift cards, and pet insurance (because fur-babies matter!).
  • Recognition you deserve: We honor our employees with service awards and retirement gifts, celebrate those who exemplify our core principles, and recognize exceptional daily contributions.
  • Thriving with diversity: Participate in our Employee Resource and Affinity Groups and help guide how we give back to the community, while having a space to connect, support one another, and celebrate cultural heritages.

But that's not all! We offer a fun and collaborative work environment where you can learn, grow, and make a real difference.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma preferred
  • Retail sales experience a plus
  • Strong computer skills
  • Enjoys engaging with people and connecting with customers
  • Understands retail is an ever-changing industry and requires flexibility in scheduling
  • Must be at least 18 years of age

The Container Store promotes a smoke-free, drug-free environment.

location: Houston, Texas, United States of America
description:

Chevron is accepting online applications for the position NGL Trader through 09/13/2026 at 11:59 p.m. Central Time Zone

Chevron is seeking an experienced NGL Trader to lead and grow a U.S. Gulf Coast NGL trading portfolio. The role is accountable for executing physical and derivative trades, optimizing and trading equity and third‑party volumes, managing risk, and expanding the commercial footprint. This role works across multiple global trading teams to drive earnings and scale Chevron’s global trading platform.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and grow profitable commercial trading opportunities around a physical US NGL portfolio in the U.S. Gulf Coast region.

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 5 years demonstrated NGL trading experience with focus on Mont Belvieu hub trading

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree

title: Intern Operational Excellence
description:
Job Summary

NiSource Internship Program Introduction

NiSource is currently seeking a Summer Operational Excellence Intern. Successful applicants will become integral members of the department while learning within a team environment, completing meaningful tasks and collaborating with team members and leaders on important projects. This position will be a great opportunity for the candidate desiring to launch their career in the field. Successful applicants will build professional relationships with other interns and all levels of NiSource personnel while participating in rewarding professional development exercises and fun, team-building activities. Interns will obtain a broad overview of NiSource's operations and current events in the utilities industry.

This is a 12-week summer internship program starting in May 2027, for students entering their junior or senior year in fall 2027. The role is based in Columbus, OH. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the reporting location to be eligible.


Essential Functions

  • Electric Planning
    • Assist in the planning, development, and implementation of the operations work plan in support of Power Delivery. Assist in data collection and reports to monitor programs, work plans, operating budgets, and forecasts in support of Power Delivery.
    • Successful candidate to be currently enrolled in an accredited university with a major in business, accounting or engineering discipline.
  • GIS Environmental
    • The GIS Environmental Intern will support the Environmental Department in either Columbus, OH or Merrillville, IN to research and gather environmental files in the public domain and add them to our Geographic Information System (GIS) for our service territory. Candidates with backgrounds in GIS application use or support, and GIS editing are encouraged to apply.
  • Continuous Improvement
    • The Transformation Office (TO) supports and coaches business-led Customer Value teams including business leaders, frontline workers and subject-matter experts to help the business build capabilities to identify ways to work smarter and more efficiently to unlock value for our customers. This role will assist the TO Consultants and Governance Lead positions through multiple activities.

Required Qualifications For Position

  • Major in GIS, Engineering, Accounting, Operations Management, Business Management or related discipline.
  • Required GPA 3.0 and above.
  • Experience working independently

  • Excellent analytical abilities, including process analysis and development, problem-solving and root-cause analysis.

The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities required of the position.

During the summer intern program, interns gain hands-on project experience, develop technical skills, and put their classroom knowledge into action. Our interns get the opportunity to participate in a series of workshops and events, including:

title: Senior Food Scientist, Protein
description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.

This position is in our Food Enterprise where we are committed to serving food manufacturers, food service customers, and retailers with a complete range of innovative ingredients and branded products. Our portfolio includes poultry, beef, egg, alternative protein, salt, oils, starches, sweeteners, cocoa and chocolate.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Senior Food Scientist, Protein leads the development, commercialization, and optimization of fresh beef products for retail and foodservice customers across North America. This role serves as a technical leader within Protein R&D, partnering closely with customers, commercial teams, operations, and cross-functional partners to identify opportunities, solve complex technical challenges, and deliver business results. In this role you will influence product solutions in fresh beef processing. You will identify opportunities to optimize manufacturing and processing capabilities to recommend solutions that support fresh beef business growth, improve product performance, and strengthen customer partnerships. In addition to leading significant development initiatives, this role is expected to coach and mentor other scientists, independently influence technical decisions across functions, and help build organizational capability through knowledge sharing and technical expertise.

Key Accountabilities

  • Provide technical leadership for product and process development initiatives, proactively recommending solutions and guiding teams through complex technical decisions while ensuring alignment with business strategy, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify product growth and new product opportunities in fresh beef processing; adapt plans to capitalize on emerging trends and market demands. Lead scale-up and product qualification activities at manufacturing facilities, ensuring solutions meet quality, food safety, operational, and cost expectations.
  • Support the development and execution of innovation roadmaps and market plans aligned with overall business growth strategy.
  • Build strong partnerships across R&D, sales, marketing, operations, supply chain, quality, regulatory, and business teams to align priorities and drive successful project execution. Develop trusted relationships with customers and commercial partners, representing R&D in customer discussions, technical reviews, plant trials, and innovation initiatives.
  • Maintain and expand technical expertise through scientific literature, industry trends, and emerging technologies, applying new knowledge to business challenges and opportunities and documentation of work for future applications.
  • Coach and mentor scientists and cross-functional partners by sharing technical expertise, providing guidance on project execution, and helping strengthen team capability.
  • Independently handle complex issues with minimal supervision, while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
• Minimum of four years of related work experience
• Ability to travel up to 30% to customer and manufacturing locations
• Previous protein experience
• Ability to occasionally work in a refrigerated environment


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Master's degree or other post-secondary degree
• Experience in meat product development, sensory evaluation, and food safety
• Fresh beef experience
• Previous operations experience
• Ability to present research to all levels within an organization
• Experience communicating to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Experience leading change initiatives

title: Safety Advisor
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview


Reporting to the Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Safety Advisor Program Co-Managers, the Safety Advisor is the EHS primary liaison and point-of-contact for all campus departments, including areas such as research, clinical, academic, athletic, and support services, and is responsible for providing comprehensive health and safety services and assisting in the University's goal of a safe and healthy workplace and academic environment.

Required Skills and Abilities

1. Ability to exercise good judgment regarding health and safety. Demonstrated skills and knowledge in technical safety disciplines (e.g., radiation safety, industrial hygiene, biosafety, chemical safety, environmental monitoring, and sampling methods). Knowledge of radiation detection instrumentation and appropriate calibration procedures.

2. Knowledge of DOT, IATA and RCRA regulations, and hazardous waste management. General knowledge of other State and Federal environmental health and safety regulations. Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks simultaneously due to the diversity of EHS services and the wide range of potential work locations on campus.

3. Ability to read and interpret shipping regulations/guidelines (DOT and IATA), along with being able to determine whether permits and/or licenses are required by CDC, USDA, USFW, DOC, etc. for research/clinical materials. Ability to learn how to read vector maps and review research documentation to evaluate the need for export licenses.

4. Ability to establish and maintain professional, collaborative, service-oriented, cooperative and effective working relationships with students, faculty, staff and regulatory agencies through effective and positive communication.

5. Good verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills, including the abilities to communicate risks effectively, speak clearly and engagingly about health and safety issues before small and large groups. Ability to use word processing, spreadsheet, and database computer programs.

Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. The ideal candidate will have some experience or demonstrated knowledge in Biosafety.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Performs safety audits and field hazard assessments for laboratories, other work areas, facilities and equipment. Job Description

Why join the Oklahoma Turnpike Authority?

The Oklahoma Turnpike Authority (OTA) has been serving Oklahomans since 1947, managing and maintaining a modern, safe, and efficient turnpike system across the state. With a commitment to customer service and innovation, OTA plays a vital role in ensuring smooth and reliable travel for millions of motorists each year. As a part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working in a collaborative and supportive environment. OTA offers competitive pay, excellent benefits, and opportunities for growth, making it an excellent choice to build your career in public service.

Position Overview

This is a full-time position working Monday – Friday approximately 7:30 – 4:00pm, on-site at our Cimarron Maintenance facility located in Morrison, OK.

The Oklahoma Turnpike Authority (OTA) Maintenance division is seeking a dedicated and experienced Fleet Specialist (level III or IV) to join our team. In this role, the Fleet Specialist is responsible for mechanical/technical work in the repair and maintenance of automobile, truck, heavy equipment, or other engines or motors and related assemblies or in the supervision/management of a fleet maintenance or repair facility.

Compensation

Level III – The hourly rate for this position is $25.48 ($53,000 annually)

Level IV – The hourly rate for this position is $28.51 ($59,300 annually)

​

Typical Functions

The functions performed in this job family will vary by level, but may include the following:

  • Perform major and minor preventative maintenance service on state vehicles and equipment; Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic problems; operate diagnostic tools and computer software; weld and fabricate.
  • Maintain clean, orderly, and safe work environment; inspect and test equipment for safety and proper working order.
  • Complete paperwork and assist in writing specifications; maintain workplace inventory; order parts and supplies to maintain an inventory of parts.
  • Adequately explain technical diagnoses and needed repairs to non-mechanical personnel which may include employees and customers on an as-required basis while performing roadside assistance, towing needs, and rollback services.
  • May need to report to work outside of normal working hours for emergency operations.
  • Perform necessary research investigation, analysis, and reporting for the equipment fleet; make recommendations for purchase, replacement, or reassignment of equipment within a division; write preliminary specifications for equipment.

Level Descriptor

Levels are distinguished based on the complexity of assigned duties, the level of expertise required for completion of work assignments, and the responsibility assigned for the supervision of others.

Level III - This is the specialist level, where employees are assigned responsibilities for performing highly skilled mechanical work in the repair and maintenance of specialized and heavy-duty equipment. Responsibilities may include trouble-shooting repair needs which are difficult to identify; independently completing major repair projects, or directing projects requiring a team effort, may direct or review work of others.

Level IV - This is the senior level where incumbents are assigned responsibilities involving Level III job functions in addition to the supervision of an equipment repair facility or unit and assigned specialists. In this role they will provide training, review work, assist in the diagnosis of mechanical problems and perform other tasks involving preparation of reports and ordering parts as required. If applicable, they will have supervisory responsibility for directing the various repair and maintenance functions of the shop.


Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Competencies

Level III - Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required at this level include knowledge of the tools, equipment and terminology of the mechanical trade; of diagnosing problems with light and heavy-duty equipment; of the functioning of internal combustion engines; of drive systems and other systems in various types of vehicles and other equipment; of parts-ordering procedures within the assigned shop; and of repair costs and costs of new equipment. Ability is required to use diagnostic tools; to read and understand parts manuals, service manuals, and schematics; to follow verbal and written instructions; to perform advanced and technical repairs, including the use of welding equipment; to direct the work of other mechanics and helpers; and to use highly technical diagnostic tools such as lab scopes, scanners and computer software.

Level IV - Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required at this level include knowledge of the tools, equipment and terminology of the mechanical trade; of diagnosing problems with light and heavy duty equipment; of the functioning of internal combustion engines; of drive systems and other systems in various types of vehicles and other equipment; of parts-ordering procedures within the assigned shop; of repair costs and costs of new equipment; of supervisory practices and principles; and of standard parts inventory procedures.

Ability is required to use diagnostic tools; to read and understand parts manuals, service manuals, and schematics; to follow verbal and written instructions; to perform advanced and technical repairs, including the use of welding equipment; to direct the work of other mechanics and helpers; to use highly technical diagnostic tools such as lab scopes, scanners and computer software; to train employees, including in the use highly complex diagnostic tools; and to supervise the work of others.

Education and Experience

Level III - Education and Experience requirements at this level consist of three years of experience in automobile, truck, light or heavy duty road equipment, combustion engines or chassis maintenance and repair; or an equivalent combination of education and experience, substituting one year of education/training as an Automotive/Diesel Mechanic.

Level IV - Education and Experience requirements at this level consist of four years of experience in automobile, truck, light or heavy duty road equipment, combustion engines or chassis maintenance and repair; or an equivalent combination of education and experience, substituting one year of education/training as an Automotive/Diesel Mechanic.

  • Up to $21,934 to help cover insurance premiums for employees and their families.
  • Comprehensive Insurance Plans:

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs):
    Pre-tax savings for healthcare and dependent care expenses
  • Retirement Savings Plans:

o Pathfinder Defined Contribution Plan: Employer matches 6% of a minimum 4.5%

employee contribution (up to 7% if the employee contributes 7%).

to November 1, 2015.

  • Paid Leave:

o 15 days annually during the first 1–5 years of service.

o 18 days annually for 5–10 years of service.

o 20 days annually for 10–20 years of service.

o 25 days annually for over 20 years of service.

o Sick leave: Accrued at 15 days per year.

o Paid Maternity leave for eligible employees.

    Eleven paid holidays annually.

    Special rates with various vendors and companies.
  • Longevity Payment:
    Monetary rewards beginning at two years of service to recognize dedicated tenure.
  • Thrive:

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Demonstrated interest in clinical research, healthcare, or financial operations.

title: All-Source Analyst - Senior
description:
Overview

Bluehawk, LLC is seeking an experienced Senior All-Source Analyst to support intelligence operations at the Russell-Knox Building in Quantico, Virginia. The successful candidate will conduct strategic all-source and counterintelligence analysis, integrate information from multiple intelligence disciplines, and develop high-quality intelligence products for senior policymakers and defense stakeholders.

This position requires strong research, critical-thinking, writing, and briefing skills, along with a thorough understanding of Intelligence Community analytic standards and established all-source research tools.

Responsibilities

  • Research, evaluate, and integrate information from multiple intelligence disciplines and sources, including HUMINT, SIGINT, OSINT, GEOINT, and other relevant intelligence reporting.
  • Identify intelligence gaps, emerging threats, trends, patterns, relationships, and potential implications for supported missions.
  • Use Intelligence Community databases, research platforms, and analytic tools to collect, assess, and synthesize complex information.
  • Develop comprehensive intelligence assessments, executive summaries, briefings, information papers, threat products, and other analytical deliverables.
  • Produce clear, concise, and well-supported intelligence products tailored to senior policymakers, military leaders, defense officials, and other mission stakeholders.
  • Apply Intelligence Community analytic tradecraft standards, including those established under Intelligence Community Directive 203 and Intelligence Community Directive 206.
  • Evaluate the credibility, reliability, relevance, and sourcing of intelligence information.
  • Ensure analytic conclusions are supported by available intelligence and clearly distinguish between confirmed information, assumptions, judgments, and intelligence gaps.
  • Provide formal and informal briefings to government customers, senior leaders, and mission partners.
  • Collaborate with analysts, collectors, operational personnel, and interagency stakeholders to support intelligence requirements.
  • Maintain awareness of geopolitical, military, security, and counterintelligence developments relevant to assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Support quality-control and peer-review activities to ensure intelligence products meet customer and Intelligence Community standards.
  • Respond to requests for information and other time-sensitive intelligence requirements.
  • Perform additional mission-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution and at least eight years of relevant intelligence analysis experience.

    OR

  • At least 12 years of relevant intelligence analysis experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.

  • Clearance: Active TS/SCI with CI Polygraph

  • Experience conducting strategic all-source intelligence analysis.

  • Experience using analytic tools and databases to research, evaluate, and integrate information from multiple intelligence sources.

  • Experience conducting all-source counterintelligence analysis using intelligence disciplines such as SIGINT, HUMINT, OSINT, GEOINT, and related reporting.

  • Ability to develop high-quality written intelligence products and other deliverables for senior policymakers or defense stakeholders.

  • Experience preparing and delivering formal or informal intelligence briefings.

  • Experience with or working knowledge of all-source research tools and platforms such as Pulse, RMT, TAC, NGT, or comparable Intelligence Community systems.

  • Experience applying Intelligence Community analytic standards and familiarity with ICD 203 and ICD 206.

  • Strong analytical, research, writing, editing, and oral communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established production deadlines.

  • Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information clearance with a current Counterintelligence Polygraph.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience briefing General Officers, Flag Officers, members of the Senior Executive Service, or similarly senior government officials.

  • Knowledge of the U.S. Indo-Pacific Command area of responsibility.

  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, law-enforcement, or counterintelligence missions.

  • Familiarity with peer review, intelligence product evaluation, or analytic quality-control processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex intelligence findings into clear, actionable assessments for senior decision-makers.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Bluehawk, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Fresh Foods Clerk
description:
About Us

In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Assist customers by providing over-the-counter service and customer service throughout the Fresh Foods department. Operates and maintains the fresh food production areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza), prepares the areas for sales, fries food, operates the rotisserie oven, prepares ready-to-bake/baked pizzas, etc. Receives inventory, verifies receipt of ordered product, and stocks in designated areas. Consistently provides friendly, courteous service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work. Generally works 6-8 hour shifts between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve, and thank customers. Maintains an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Takes orders, answers questions, and performs suggestive selling.
  • Prepares, stocks, displays, straightens, and rotates product in fresh food areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza).

  • Prepares case by putting the product in fresh pans, rotating product, putting product back, filling, etc.
  • Places proper signage on all products which includes pricing, description, code dating, and COOL information on all required products.
  • Cleans and maintains department equipment such as fryers, slicers, etc. by breaking down and reassembling equipment, operating dish washer and hand washing dishes, cleaning all appropriate parts with sanitizing solution.

Requirements

Ability to:

  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Communicate (hearing & speech) effectively with customers to receive orders and perform customer relation skills.
  • Conduct visual inspections, read and follow production guides, recipes and product labels, log production quantities, temperature readings, etc. on proper forms.

  • Stand, walk and move rapidly for extended periods of time.
  • Bend, stoop, twist, turn and reach over the counter and in tight areas frequently.
  • Lift up to 50 lbs. occasionally and reach, push and pull racks.

  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

title: Research Assistant
description:
About the Position

The Research Assistant I provides assistance to the Principal Investigator and
Study Team coordinating research activities that may include recruiting participants, data collection and management and other research activities as assigned. The RA will assist with report generation and project close-out support.

About the Project

The Research Assistant will play a key role in participant recruitment and study operations. Primary responsibilities include engaging active-duty service members in the primary clinic waiting area, explaining the study, and inviting eligible individuals to complete an online screening questionnaire. The Research Assistant will also assist with participant consent, answer questions about the study, support protocol amendments and regulatory requirements, and help ensure compliance with study procedures. This position requires an on-site presence at Womack Army Medical Center, primarily during morning sick call hours to support recruitment activities. The study will recruit up to nine (9) service members from units at Fort Bragg for enrollment. The project is currently in Phase I, which focuses on participant recruitment and enrollment. Phase II will involve facilitating and supporting focus groups to gather participant feedback and inform future program refinement.
