title: Global Director, Forecasting – Infectious Disease
location: Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States of America
description:
Global Director, Forecasting – Infectious Disease (ID) Gaithersburg, MDGlobal Insights, Analytics & Forecasting, BBUHybrid Work - on average 3 days a week from office

The Director is a senior global forecasting leader responsible for demand forecasting across the Infectious Disease portfolio, spanning early-stage, late-stage, and in-market assets, as well as business development and investment case building. The role serves as the global forecasting lead and strategic thought partner to Early Commercial, Finance, Market Access & Pricing, Marketing, Medical, Research & Development, and Business Development teams. The position also includes vendor and resource management to ensure rigorous use of data and analytics within forecasting, continuous improvement of forecasting approaches, and delivery of decision-grade commercial assessments. Time allocation may vary by business cycle and portfolio priorities.

You’ll play a critical role in shaping global commercial expectations, portfolio choices, risk and opportunity framing, and executive decision-making for early-stage, late-stage, in-market, and external business development opportunities.

What you’ll do

Global Forecasting Leadership (Core Accountability)

  • Lead global short- and long-term demand forecasts—including patients, volume, treatment starts, and revenue—for ID assets using robust patient-based and market-based models.

  • Own forecast methodology, assumptions, and governance, ensuring objectivity, transparency, and consistency with enterprise standards.

  • Develop and refine forecasts for early-stage, late-stage assets to support stage-gate decisions, portfolio prioritization, investment choices, and resource allocation.

  • Use primary market research, epidemiology, competitive intelligence, access and pricing dynamics, real-world evidence, and other relevant data and analytics to inform forecast assumptions and models.

  • Proactively identify and quantify key risks and opportunities through scenario and sensitivity analyses.

  • Partner closely with Early Commercial, Finance, Market Access & Pricing, Marketing, Medical, Research & Development, Business Development, and regional or market teams to ensure alignment on assumptions and implications.

  • Support global business planning, governance reviews, portfolio decisions, and opportunity assessments with clear, executive-ready narratives.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior global leaders, clearly articulating forecast drivers, changes, uncertainties, and strategic implications.

Business Development and Investment Case Building

  • Lead forecasting and commercial case development for business development opportunities, including in-licensing, partnerships, acquisitions, and other external innovation opportunities.

  • Build patient-based market models, revenue forecasts, risk-adjusted scenarios, and commercial inputs to valuation and investment cases.

  • Conduct commercial due diligence by assessing unmet need, patient pathways, market evolution, competitive dynamics, access and pricing considerations, and strategic fit.

  • Translate incomplete or uncertain evidence into transparent assumptions, scenarios, trade-offs, and recommendations for governance and executive decision-making.

  • Ensure alignment between business development forecasts, internal pipeline forecasts, therapeutic area strategy, and portfolio planning.

Forecasting Capability and Resource Leadership

  • Ensure relevant data, analytics, and insights are applied appropriately to forecasting, scenario development, and business case building.

  • Manage and prioritize internal forecasters, contractors, and external vendors supporting forecasting and business development deliverables.

  • Partner with data and analytics specialists, Global IA&F, and GIBEX capability teams to evaluate and deploy data sources, tools, and modeling approaches that strengthen forecasts.

  • Identify opportunities to embed AI and automation into forecasting workflows to improve efficiency, scalability, transparency, and decision quality.

  • Champion continuous improvement in forecasting processes, AI-enabled modeling, and automation.

  • Contribute to the development and sharing of global best practices across the ID forecasting community.

Essential for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, scientific, health, or business-related field, such as Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Life Sciences, or Decision Science.

  • 4+ years’ experience in global pharmaceutical commercial forecasting, including early-stage, late-stage, launch, and/or in-market assets.

  • Experience supporting business development evaluations, commercial due diligence, opportunity assessments, or investment case development.

  • Hands-on model ownership experience, including build, refresh, and performance tracking across short- and long-term horizons.

  • Expertise in scenario-based forecasting, sensitivity analysis, and driver-based narratives to support senior decision-making.

  • Strong capability using multiple data and evidence sources—such as epidemiology, claims, real-world evidence, syndicated data, competitive intelligence, and primary research—to build coherent, decision-grade forecasts.

  • Demonstrated forecast governance and model risk discipline, including traceable assumptions, documentation, and clear explanations.

  • Strong understanding of global market access, pricing, reimbursement, policy, and regional market dynamics and how they affect demand.

  • Ability to translate complex forecasts and supporting evidence into clear, executive-ready insights, options, and recommendations.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen across key demand and valuation levers, including positioning, adoption, competition, lifecycle events, probability of technical and regulatory success, and risk adjustment.

​

Desirable for the role

  • Advanced degree, such as an MBA, MS, MPH, or PhD in Economics, Statistics, Decision Sciences, Life Sciences, or a related field.

  • Infectious Disease and/or Rare Disease experience, including familiarity with immunization dynamics, patient-based forecasting, and lifecycle management in preventive or infectious disease therapies.

  • Experience forecasting across multiple geographies and working with global, regional, and market stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with ambiguity and limited evidence in early-asset and business development settings.

  • Change leadership: builds adoption for new tools, processes, and ways of working across cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Product perspective for forecasting: defines user needs, success measures, and a roadmap for global portfolio forecasting capabilities.

Office Working Requirements

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn’t mean we’re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $194,571.20 - 291,856.80 USD. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. ​

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-09-16 11:59 PM

This role is a hybrid work arrangement. Work schedule to be discussed with the Hiring Manager according to the guidelines defined by the department.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Are you deeply curious about how the media and advertising ecosystem really works under the hood? We are seeking a high-caliber early-career analyst (fresh graduate in Business Management, Technology, or Futuresight-related disciplines) who possesses relentless intellectual curiosity and an appetite to explore the complex intersections that others overlook.

In this role, you will analyze the media ecosystem end-to-end—spanning commercial advertising models, digital distribution mechanics, subscription economics, and emerging tech stacks. You will be expected to thrive in uncertainty, challenge assumptions, and produce rigorous, evidence-backed insights to guide executive decision-making.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ecosystem & Vendor Intelligence: Deliver comprehensive vendor dossiers and category analyses within tight timelines, evaluating category fit, integration feasibility, exit costs, vendor viability, and clear decision confidence levels.

  • End-to-End Media Economics Research: Map and analyze the overlapping dependencies between commercial ad mechanics, audience measurement, first-party data strategies, social tech platforms, and subscription revenue streams.

  • Rigorous Pilot & Hypothesis Testing: Pre-register every pilot with clear hypotheses, success metrics, stop conditions, and market-as-control measurement designs before execution. Ensure all test results produce actionable, decision-grade findings rather than anecdotal summaries.

  • Governance & Constraint Screening: Rigorously screen all technical and strategic recommendations against procurement, legal, privacy, and regulatory boundaries before presenting to leadership forums.

  • Competitive & Supply Chain Tracking: Monitor industry shifts including programmatic supply chain developments, unified sales platforms, broadcaster consolidation, and platform-side API/policy changes.

  • Quantified Impact: Track, validate, and own the quantification of vendor spend avoided and value unlocked through strategic analysis.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS SOUGHT

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Business Analytics, Technology Information Systems, Innovation Strategy, or a related field (Recent Graduates encouraged).

  • Structured Research & Synthesis: Exceptional writing and analytical skills with a disciplined focus on writing for executive decision-making rather than word count.

  • Exceptional Technical Documentation: Expertise in translating complex technical parameters and multi-dimensional tech transformations into clear, visual, and highly structured business summaries (such as matrices and process maps).

  • Skeptical & Evidence-Driven Mindset: Skeptical by disposition; naturally treats vendor claims and market hype as unproven hypotheses requiring rigorous empirical proof.

  • Comfort with Uncertainty & Tech Stacks: Eager to navigate complex, multi-layered environments involving programmatic infrastructure, log-level ad data, SSP/ad server reporting, and data clean rooms.

  • Financial & Statistical Literacy: Capability to build financial models sufficient to size revenue opportunities and integration costs, and statistical literacy to distinguish actual signal from noise.

  • Uncompromising Integrity: Willingness to state uncertainty explicitly and report negative or failing pilot results clearly without softening outcomes.

WHY JOIN US?

This position offers a rare launchpad for a forward-thinking graduate to work at the intersection of business strategy, commercial tech, and future market dynamics. You will have direct exposure to executive decision-makers (including C-level leadership) and the autonomy to investigate complex industry challenges end-to-end.

This position will not be filled until consideration has been made by the CBC/Radio-Canada / APS Workforce Adjustment Committee.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:

title: Customs Trainer
description:
Join the BDO family

At BDO, we believe that knowledge is meant to be shared. That’s why we are looking for a Customs Trainer to strengthen our Tax & Legal team and help our clients stay ahead in an increasingly complex customs environment.

Are you passionate about customs and enjoy translating complex legislation into clear, practical and engaging training? Do you like working with different clients, sharing your expertise and continuously developing your own knowledge? Then this could be the opportunity for you!

At BDO, you will become part of a close-knit team where your expertise matters, your ideas are valued and you have the opportunity to grow. Let’s Grow Together!

What will you be doing?

What will you do?

As a Customs Trainer, you will play a key role in developing and delivering high-quality customs training for our clients and internal teams.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and delivering practical and engaging customs training sessions for clients, colleagues and other stakeholders, both on our e-learning platform and in the form of physical sessions.
  • Translating complex customs legislation, regulations and developments into clear, accessible and business-oriented training content.
  • Preparing training materials, presentations, case studies, exercises and other learning tools tailored to the needs of different target audiences.
  • Keeping training content up to date with the latest developments in EU and Belgian customs legislation, procedures and case law.
  • Identifying relevant customs developments and translating them into practical insights for our clients.
  • Working closely with our customs specialists and Tax & Legal colleagues to ensure the accuracy and relevance of training content.
  • Supporting clients in strengthening their internal customs knowledge and compliance processes through targeted training and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Contributing to the further development of BDO's customs training offering, identifying new topics and opportunities based on market developments and client needs.
  • Participating in client meetings and discussions to understand their specific customs challenges and translate these into appropriate training solutions.
  • Building trusted relationships with clients and becoming a recognised point of contact for customs-related knowledge and training.
  • Sharing your knowledge internally and contributing to the continuous development of our customs team.

Depending on your experience and interests, you may also have the opportunity to contribute to customs advisory projects and support clients with more complex customs matters.

What do you bring to the table?

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a customs professional who combines technical expertise with strong communication and presentation skills.

You have:

  • A strong knowledge of customs legislation and customs procedures, preferably within a Belgian and/or European context.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in customs, for example within a consultancy firm, customs department, logistics company, multinational organisation or public authority.
  • A genuine interest in training, knowledge sharing and developing people.
  • The ability to explain complex technical topics in a clear, structured and engaging way.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to address both technical specialists and non-specialist audiences.
  • A pragmatic and client-oriented mindset, with the ability to adapt your approach to different industries and levels of expertise.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage several training projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A proactive attitude and the drive to continuously develop your own expertise.
  • Strong written and spoken English and Dutch. Knowledge of French is not required but is a nice bonus.
  • A creative all-rounder with strong PowerPoint skills.

Most importantly, you are someone who enjoys sharing knowledge, connecting with people and making complex matters easier to understand.

What do we bring to the table?

What do we offer?

At BDO, we want you to feel challenged, supported and empowered to grow.

You can expect:

  • A varied role combining customs expertise, training, client interaction and knowledge development.
  • The opportunity to work with a diverse portfolio of Belgian and international clients.
  • A stimulating environment where you can further develop your expertise in a constantly evolving regulatory field.
  • The opportunity to help shape and further develop BDO's customs training offering.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team where knowledge sharing is part of our culture.
  • Continuous learning opportunities and access to internal and external training.
  • A competitive salary package with attractive additional benefits.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance.
  • A workplace where you can grow professionally while making an impact for our clients.

Ready to grow with us?

If you are ready to turn your customs expertise into practical knowledge that helps businesses navigate an increasingly complex regulatory landscape, we would love to hear from you.

Join BDO and let’s grow together!

title: Director of Quality and Accreditation
description:
Overview

Sierra Tucson Behavioral Health is seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Quality and Accreditation to lead our facility’s efforts in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and safety. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing regulatory compliance, quality assurance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives across all clinical and operational areas. The Director will guide the development and implementation of quality protocols, manage accreditation processes, and lead the Quality Assurance and Process Improvement (QAPI) program. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, strategic thinker with a strong commitment to achieving excellence in care delivery and regulatory readiness.

Sierra Tucson Behavioral Health offers an extensive array of benefits to our valued team members. Current offerings encompass:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance coverage
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
  • Company-paid Basic Life & AD&D insurance
  • Disability benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with a company match
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Employee Discount Program
  • Paid Holidays for work-life balance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Tuition Reimbursement opportunities for career advancement

PURPOSE STATEMENT:

The Director of Quality and Accreditation is responsible for ensuring patient safety and superior quality of care as measured by survey readiness, treatment program fidelity, and compliance with state and federal laws and regulations and accreditation standards. As such, the Director is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of policy development; comprehensive implementation of Acadia’s prescribed clinical protocols, operational quality oversight standards, and programmatic expectations; critical incident reporting; regulatory engagement, including development and submission of plans of correction; certification achievement and maintenance; oversight of the quality assurance and process improvement (QAPI) program; and on-going regulatory readiness strategies at the facility. Through routine physical presence in patient care areas, data analysis and documentation monitoring, and intentional sharing of deep subject-matter expertise, the Director will ensure a proactive, multidisciplinary focus on quality and excellence within the facility.

Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead and monitor day-to-day regulatory readiness, patient safety, and service excellence across the facility.
  • QAPI program oversight and management – follow and develop processes for identification, collection, and analysis of quality performance data.
    • Utilize collected data regarding the outcome of activities for delivering continuously improving services.
    • Conduct annual preparation and evaluation of the facility QAPI Program.
    • Complete process improvement projects and incorporate the results into patient care improvements.
    • Submit quality scorecard data to Acadia corporate office as requested.
    • Coordinate the abstraction of clinical data according to Joint Commission specifications and data entry via vendor database for Inpatient Psychiatric Core Measures (ex. national quality measures such as HBIPS).
    • Identify key aspects of care relevant indicators and evaluation of data using formal and informal feedback from consumers of services and other collateral sources is aggregated and used to improve management strategies and service delivery practices.
    • Lead/coordinate data collection and analysis from all departments within the facility.
    • Prepare and present program data trends and action plans to the monthly Quality Council and quarterly to the Medical Executive Committee and the Governing Board.
  • Regulatory preparedness – implement sustainable survey preparation and ongoing monitoring processes, including facility-wide auditing and early-issue identification, to maximize achievement of zero- or standard-level survey outcomes.
    • Facility-wide support – collaborate with other departments to sustainably implement best-practices in regulatory/accreditation compliance as evidenced by measurable results with regard to survey outcomes, patient safety metrics, patient experience results, HBIPS, etc.
    • Develop and maintain proficiency in regulatory planning strategy for all standards for all relevant regulatory and accrediting bodies at the local, state, and federal level.
    • Develop and maintain proficiency in the functionality and auditing within electronic platforms such as electronic patient observations and the electronic medical record, as applicable.
    • Lead Root-Cause Analyses and conduct timely and regular evaluation of serious incidents, complaints, grievances and related investigations to:
      • Identification of events, trends and patterns that may affect client health, safety and or treatment efficacy,
      • Committee evaluation findings and recommendations submitted to agency management for corrective action,
      • Implemented actions, outcomes, trends analyzed over time
    • Develop corrective action plans for the resolution of areas of regulatory vulnerability or those which could compromise patient safety in collaboration with other facility leaders.
    • Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
    • Ensure proper reporting of incidents and adverse clinical outcomes to duly authorized enforcement agencies or regulatory agencies as appropriate and/or required.
    • In conjunction with assigned corporate Division Quality Director, initiate and lead communications with regulatory agencies as appropriate.
    • Develop sustainable performance improvement practices through analysis of data and prioritization of efforts to improve survey readiness and consistency of care delivery using expected best-practices.
    • Ensure multidisciplinary ownership of best-practices in self-monitoring, auditing, and process improvement, escalating opportunities for improved engagement to the facility CEO as appropriate.
    • Ensures strategic and operational implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and standards of federal, state, and local licensing agencies, accrediting and certifying organizations.
    • Collaborates with Division and Corporate entities and external parties to ensure strategic quality and patient safety initiatives are fully executed at the facility level. Facilitates effective communication with facility and division leadership regarding key clinical performance improvement activities and initiatives.
    • Serves as a technical advisor, educator and internal consultant to all hospital management, staff, and physicians on the use of performance improvement tools and techniques, analytical techniques, and statistical applications.
    • Ensure facility compliance with policies and applicable standards as required by regulatory/accrediting bodies.
    • Facility leader and subject matter expert on high reliability principles and strategies to achieve zero harm.
  • Clinical program excellence – assess fidelity and identify root-causes for gaps/lapses in fidelity to Acadia standards. Support other departments in developing and implementing remediation and improvement plans to achieve fidelity to Acadia’s expected practices, including all elements of treatment program implementation.
    • Develop, review, and educate on internal clinical procedures and appropriate use of outcome evaluation tools and the associated results – including patient experience data and other quality scorecard metrics – to ensure continuous quality improvement and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and third-party regulatory requirements.
    • Translate standards, requirements, and policies into terms or processes meaningful to the facility.

description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Job Position Overview:

The Associate Director – Project Management delivers new and renovated capital assets for the Global Facilities Delivery (GFD) organization leading and managing teams that deliver large programs of $1BN USD or more in capital assets and/or programs that are highly business critical in nature. This role leads teams of Lilly and non-Lilly professionals from front-end planning (conceptual design) at brownfield or greenfield sites through operational qualification. The role is accountable for delivering asset capability and capacity safely and with assurance of cost, schedule, and quality, in compliance with Company policies and procedures.

Responsibilities:

Key objectives and deliverables for this role include the following:

· Leads and manages teams of Lilly and non-Lilly professionals to safely deliver large programs of $1BN USD or more in capital assets and/or programs that are highly business critical in nature, from front-end planning through operational qualification, achieving defined objectives for asset capability and capacity with safety, cost, schedule, and quality assurance.

· Leads with a disciplined, structured approach to project management, anticipating scope changes, facilitating issue resolution, and implementing project work safely and with quality, speed, and value.

· Leads from a regional distance from corporate headquarters while developing and maintaining effective communication with GFD leadership, the project team, governance teams, business partners, and other stakeholders.

· Develops and maintains safety and environmental execution plans for assigned projects and ensures compliance with safety and environmental policies, procedures, and work rules for project personnel, contractors, and subcontractors from conceptual design through operational verification.

· Leads program execution in compliance with Company policies and procedures and applicable regulatory and quality requirements for the facilities and systems delivered.

Basic Qualifications:

· Bachelor of Science in an engineering field or a field related to project management.

· Minimum of 10 years of experience in capital project delivery in industrial or manufacturing facilities.

Additional Skills/ Preferences:

title: IT Solutions Architect - Networking
description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Principal IT Engineer – Networking designs, implements, and operates enterprise network solutions with a primary focus on Cisco and Meraki wired and wireless technologies. This role is responsible for the day-to-day reliability and performance of campus and branch connectivity, partners with security and infrastructure teams to integrate identity and access controls (e.g., Cisco ISE), and drives continuous improvement through standardization, documentation, and automation.

The Principal IT Engineer leads incident triage and resolution, executes change activities using established change-management practices (e.g., ServiceNow), mentors junior engineers, and contributes to technical direction and roadmap planning.

This position is hybrid and requires regular onsite presence in Somerset, NJ or Austin, TX, with scheduling determined by business needs.

Role Description

​

Wireless LAN (Cisco & Meraki)

  • Design, configure, and operate Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers (e.g., Catalyst 9800 series) and Meraki wireless networks.

  • Plan and optimize RF designs (channel, power, roaming, capacity) and validate changes using surveys and spectrum analysis.

  • Implement and maintain SSIDs, guest access, segmentation, and wireless security standards aligned to corporate policies.

  • Troubleshoot complex wireless issues across controller, access point, client, and authentication layers; lead root-cause analysis and remediation.

  • Integrate wireless access with Cisco ISE (802.1X, MAB, posture/policy) to enforce identity-based access controls.

  • Monitor wireless health and user experience; define and improve alerts, KPIs, and operational runbooks.

Routing & Switching (LAN/WAN)

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure, including campus and branch connectivity.

  • Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot routing and switching technologies (e.g., VLANs, STP, HSRP/VRRP, OSPF, BGP; EIGRP where applicable).

  • Operate Cisco switching and routing platforms (e.g., Catalyst, Nexus) and associated services (DHCP relay, DNS dependencies, NTP, QoS).

  • Engineer resiliency and high availability, including redundant paths, fast convergence, and failover testing, and document design decisions.

  • Monitor and analyze performance using telemetry and network-management methods (e.g., SNMP, NetFlow) to drive performance improvements.

  • Plan and execute upgrades, expansions, and lifecycle refreshes in partnership with site IT, security, and application stakeholders.

Operations, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead incident triage, escalation, and resolution for network-related events; perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative actions.

  • Maintain operational hygiene, including monitoring and alert tuning, capacity tracking, asset and configuration accuracy, and routine health checks.

  • Execute changes through established change-management processes (e.g., ServiceNow), including risk assessment, implementation planning, and backout procedures.

  • Create and maintain network documentation (standards, diagrams, runbooks) and promote reuse and standardization across sites.

  • Automate repeatable tasks and reporting using scripts and APIs; identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.

  • Partner with service desk teams and junior engineers to enhance troubleshooting workflows and knowledge-sharing resources.


Behaviors and Competencies

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others.

  • Adaptability: Can proactively adapt to challenging situations, anticipate changes, and make modifications to meet the demands of changing circumstances.

  • Self-Motivation: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate self-development projects, and contribute to personal or professional innovative ideas.

  • Teamwork: Can lead a team effectively, facilitating cooperation, sharing information, and ensuring that all team members are able to contribute to their full potential.

  • Analytical Thinking: Can synthesize complex data, identify patterns, draw insights, and present findings clearly and understandably.

  • Detail-Oriented: Can manage complex tasks or projects, identifying errors or inconsistencies, and ensuring all details are addressed, necessary corrections are made, and quality is maintained.

  • Organization: Can effectively coordinate multiple projects, delegate tasks where appropriate, and employ advanced organizational tools and methods.

  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify potential problems, initiate preventive measures, and propose and contribute to innovative solutions.

  • Initiative: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate projects, and contribute to innovative ideas.

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Can proactively seek out potential technical problems, initiate preventive measures, and contribute to innovative solutions.


Skill Level Requirements

  • Expert-level troubleshooting across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking in enterprise environments.

  • Advanced ability to design, operate, and optimize wired and wireless enterprise networks (Cisco and/or Meraki).

  • Strong understanding of routing, switching, high availability, and network resiliency concepts.

  • Proficiency in identity and access integrations, including 802.1X, RADIUS/TACACS+, and network segmentation.

  • Ability to analyze network performance using telemetry and monitoring tools.

  • Experience managing firewall technologies, including policy configuration, NAT, VPN, and traffic analysis.

  • Knowledge of cloud networking concepts, including VPC/VNet design, routing, VPN connectivity, and security controls.

  • Familiarity with IT service management processes (incident, problem, and change management).

  • Scripting and automation capability using tools such as PowerShell, Python, or APIs.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Proven analytical problem-solving skills using structured troubleshooting methodologies.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders.

  • Mentorship capability to guide and develop junior engineers.

  • Ability to prioritize and adapt in a dynamic environment with competing operational and project demands.​


Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or relevant work experience required

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience supporting and engineering enterprise networks.

  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and operating Cisco and/or Meraki wired and wireless environments.

Preferred

  • Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, and/or Meraki CMNA.

  • Experience with Cisco ISE design and policy administration in an enterprise environment.

  • Experience performing wireless surveys and using RF and spectrum analysis tools.

  • Experience with network automation, configuration management, or infrastructure-related tooling.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $180,000 - $220,000 which includes a base salary. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

title: Plasma Processing Technician
description:
Job Description Summary

Responsible for the accurate and timely sampling, testing, shipping and storage of plasma collected from donors.

Job Description

1 In compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), responsible for collecting plasma samples and moving plasma units to freezer to ensure product quality.

2 Ensures plasma units are properly stored according to SOPs, which could include unsuitable plasma units and samples.

3 Ensures accuracy of unit labeling by verifying the pre-printed label matches the dynamic label.

4 Utilizes sterile technique to draw samples and uses heat sealer to assure the sterility and quality of plasma unit samples per SOPs.

5 May ensure samples and units are packed and shipped in accordance with SOPs and center procedures. Prepares shipping and unit disposal documentation.

6 Monitors freezer and refrigerator temperatures and immediately informs appropriate personnel if equipment is not functioning properly. Records variances.

7 Conducts daily calibration of equipment according to SOPs.

8 Ensures the accurate recording of donor data in the electronic donor information management system as outlined in the SOPs.

9 Understands the policies and procedures associated with hyper immune programs at the center if applicable.

10 Maintains clean efficient work environment, and ensures sufficient operating supplies and forms are available as needed. Follows all Health Safety & Environmental (HSE) and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) policies and procedures. Promotes safety in all actions.

11 Maintains confidentiality of all personnel, donor and center information.

13 Bilingual skills may be required, at the discretion of the organization, to meet the needs of the business.

14 Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Education

• High school diploma or equivalent required

Experience

• Minimum of three (3) months experience in laboratory or warehouse environment preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Must be able to perform basic math calculations

Working Conditions

(physical & mental requirements)

• Ability to understand, remember and apply oral and/or written instructions

• Ability to understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines

• Must be able to see and speak with customers and observe equipment operation.

• Occasionally perform tasks while standing and walking up to 100% of time

• Reach, bend, kneel and have high level of manual dexterity

• Occasionally be required to lift and carry up to 25 pounds

• Fast paced environment with frequent interruptions

• Frequently exposed to hazardous chemicals, extreme temperatures and to blood borne pathogens

• Required to wear Personal Protective Equipment while performing specific tasks or in certain areas

• Required to work overtime and extended hours to support center operational needs

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, national origin or other legally protected classifications.

title: Associate Product Owner - HR Technology
description:
Function

HR

Our Company

We’re Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We’re crucial to the company’s strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast-moving digital transformation market.

Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Job description

Position Overview- The Team

The HR Technology Associate Product Owner supports the implementation, optimization, and ongoing management of Workday and related HR technologies, including Core HR, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Learning, Absence, and Onboarding. As a key member of the HR Technology team, this role partners with HR leaders, IT, and vendors to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions that improve HR processes, system performance, and employee experience.

The Role- Key Responsibilities:

Need 2- 6 Yrs of experienced candidate.

Technology Implementation & Optimization

  • Participate in the end-to-end implementation of Workday modules and other HR systems, including design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
  • Ensure seamless integration of complementary technologies with Workday to support broader HR operations.
  • Manage data conversions and migrations, ensuring accuracy, integrity, and security of HR data.

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Contribute to the definition and execution of product roadmaps for Workday and supplementary HR tools to align with business needs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and prioritize system requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that optimize system performance, functionality, and user experience while aligning solutions with business objectives.

System Management & Maintenance

  • Support system upgrades, patches, and enhancements to maintain smooth operations.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Training & User Support

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
Open the door to your dream job and join #TeamMainStreet. With more than 40,000 homes in 30 markets, Main Street Renewal is one of the largest providers of single-family rental homes across the country. We understand that our employees are the invaluable drivers of our success. That's why we hire the most talented, passionate individuals who enjoy contributing to a growing, winning team. Here, you'll be a part of a fast-growing company dedicated to providing a best in class leasing and customer service experience to our residents.

Amherst is a financial services and technology company that gives global investors access to the U.S. residential real estate market at scale. Our platform manages thousands of homes and billions of dollars of investment capital — and the software behind it spans the full lifecycle of a home: acquisition, renovation, leasing, maintenance, and sale.

The Senior Software Developer builds and extends the applications that run that operation. This is a hands-on role on a fast-moving Agile delivery team, working across our Salesforce platform, our Node/TypeScript integration services, and our consumer-facing React applications. You will work directly with the technical architect, team lead, and product owner to take work from design through implementation, release, and iteration.

AI is a first-class part of that platform, not a side experiment. We are building LLM-backed and agentic capabilities directly into the products our operators, vendors, and residents use every day — and we expect our engineers to use AI aggressively in how they build. This role sits at the center of both.

We are looking for developers who are scrappy and fast, who bring solutions instead of problems, who understand that code is cost, and who hold a high bar for their own work.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship business-critical applications across the Salesforce Lightning platform (Apex, LWC, Flows) and our custom services and web applications.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, our middleware layer, and third-party platforms using REST and SOAP APIs, event-driven patterns, and secure authentication (OAuth, JWT, HMAC).
  • Ship backend RESTful APIs and microservices on Node.js/TypeScript, and front-end features in React.
  • Lead and participate in technical design sessions; evaluate trade-offs in cost, performance, scalability, and technical debt, and make the call clearly.
  • Own features end to end — requirements refinement, development, unit and integration testing, code review, deployment, and post-release support.
  • Set and enforce engineering standards: coding practices, integration patterns, test coverage, documentation, and CI/CD discipline.
  • Support change management, environment strategy, and release activities across development, test, and production.
  • Improve and modernize existing applications and services, including retirement of legacy patterns and reduction of technical debt.
  • Partner with product owners, QA, design, and other technology teams; translate complex technical issues for non-technical audiences.

AI in This Role

We hold two distinct expectations here, and we mean both of them:

1. Building AI into the platform

  • Design and ship features backed by large language models — conversational agents, document and data extraction, summarization, classification, and decision support — integrated into our existing systems of record rather than bolted on beside them.
  • Build agentic workflows that can reason over business context and take real action through governed tools and APIs, with the guardrails, approvals, and audit trails that regulated real estate operations require.
  • Develop and maintain the plumbing that makes this work: model gateways, tool and context layers (including MCP-style tool servers), retrieval pipelines, prompt and context management, and structured output contracts.
  • Treat AI features like any other production system — instrumented, versioned, cost-monitored, and measured against an evaluation set, not judged by demo quality.
  • Apply sound judgment on where AI genuinely belongs. A deterministic API call is often the better answer, and knowing the difference is part of the job.

2. Building with AI

  • Use AI coding assistants and agentic development tools as part of your daily practice to move faster on scaffolding, refactors, test coverage, migrations, and documentation.
  • Help the team raise its own bar — sharing effective patterns, context and prompt strategies, and workflow improvements that compound across the group.
  • Own everything you ship regardless of what generated it. AI-assisted output is held to exactly the same standard for correctness, security, performance, and readability as hand-written code, and you are accountable for it in review.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with emphasis on application development, integrations, and data-driven systems.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development: Apex (triggers, controllers, batch, async), SOQL, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and Service Cloud.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce governor limits, code coverage requirements, standard object model, Salesforce Sites, and integration security.
  • Salesforce development using SFDX and source-driven deployment.
  • Strong foundation in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, HTTP, and RESTful API design.
  • Experience shipping production applications in React (or a comparable modern framework).
  • Experience architecting and shipping backend APIs on Node.js, C#/.NET, or a similar platform.
  • Proficiency with SQL and relational databases.
  • Solid computer science fundamentals — algorithms, data structures, and design patterns.
  • Experience with Git-based source control, code review, and continuous build/deployment pipelines.
  • Working fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools, including a clear point of view on where they help and where they do not.
  • Prior delivery experience in a Scrum or Kanban environment.
  • BS/BA in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience building on foundation model APIs (AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) — tool/function calling, structured outputs, streaming, and cost and latency management.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, or context engineering over enterprise data.
  • Experience building or consuming MCP servers, or comparable agent tool-integration frameworks.
  • Experience defining evaluation and regression testing approaches for non-deterministic systems.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer certification.
  • Salesforce Field Service (FSL) and Experience Cloud implementation experience.
  • Experience with .NET Framework or .NET Core.
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS preferred) including serverless architectures.
  • React Native, iOS, or Android development experience.
  • Real estate, fintech, or proptech domain experience.
  • An eye for quality UI/UX.

What We Look For

  • Knowledgeable. You are a real pro with deep command of your stack and its ecosystem.
  • Intellectually curious. You are constantly learning and raising your own bar.
  • AI-forward. You have already changed how you work because of AI, and you are pragmatic rather than credulous about it.
  • Entrepreneurial. You wear many hats and hustle to get things done.
  • Problem solver. You are a critical thinker who brings solutions to the table, not problems.
  • Scrappy and fast. You find creative ways to move work forward and aren't afraid of a tough deadline.
  • Strong communicator. You explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Accountable. You take ownership, sweat the details, and put team success first.

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment. The noise level is usually moderate. Normal operating hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; hours may change based on the needs of the business. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Other Duties

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Employee signature below constitutes the employee's understanding of the requirements, essential functions, and duties of the position.

Our full-time employee benefits include:

  • A competitive compensation package, annual bonus, 401k match

  • Flexible PTO including 7 paid holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 1 volunteer day

  • Employer-paid benefits (medical, dental, vision, health savings account)

  • Professional career development and reimbursement

  • Up to 16 weeks paid maternity leave; up to 4 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Backup childcare offered through Bright Horizons

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or veteran status, and encourage all applicants to apply.

title: Chargeback Analyst
description:
Job Summary

The Chargeback Analyst validates and processes debit and credit memos (trade chargebacks issued to wholesalers and distributors under contract and pricing agreements) within Model N, working across trading partner accounts that represent more than $600M in annual volume. As part of an integrated Customer Operations team spanning Master Data, Order Management, Chargebacks, and Product Returns, this role manages day-to-day communication with chargeback vendors, wholesalers, and distributors to resolve errors and keep accounts current. Using internal reporting tools, the Analyst tracks error and dollar trends to catch revenue leakage early, paying particular attention to issues that recur, tracing them to root cause and partnering with Membership, IT, or Finance to resolve them at the source.

What the Customer Operations Team Does

The Customer Operations team protects contract integrity, prevents revenue leakage, and ensures transactional data precision across the order-to-cash lifecycle. Operating as a single, connected unit covering Returns, Chargebacks, Order Management, and Customer Master Data, the team:

  • Secures Revenue: Validates, audits, and settles commercial transactions in alignment with commercial and government contracts.
  • Advances Customer-Centric Operations: Streamlines processes and leverages systems to remove manual complexity, enabling consistent execution and strong cross-functional alignment.
  • Drives System Integrity: Optimizes core platforms to support accurate pricing, reliable transaction processing, and seamless data flow across the organization.
  • Shapes the Customer Experience: Interprets complex commercial policies, resolves disputes, and manages reverse logistics to ensure a consistent and trusted customer journey.

What You'll Do

  • Adjudicate & Validate Chargebacks: Review daily chargeback transactions against contract and pricing terms, making sure credits are issued accurately within Model N's 3–5 day window. Research and resolve errors directly, looping in the Senior Analyst or Manager when an issue points to a systemic problem.
  • Reconcile Multi-Channel Transactions: Adjudicate and reconcile high-volume EDI 844 and 844 resubmission transactions, along with manual claims, across distributor and direct purchase channels.
  • Strengthen Data Integrity: Work with the Membership Analyst to track down customer misalignments and bad data trends. Use cleaned customer master data to process accurate transactions, and flag recurring rejection patterns so they can be corrected at the source.
  • Track Trends & Report: Use internal reporting tools, including Power BI, to track trends in claim submissions and dollar impact, and share findings with Account Managers and Finance.
  • Prepare for Account Reviews: Prepare materials for scheduled business reviews with wholesalers and distributors, track error trends, and follow up on open action items.
  • Reconcile Order-to-Cash Activity: Work with Accounts Receivable on customer credit clearance, keeping chargeback processing on pace with department KPIs.
  • Contribute to Cross-Functional Projects: Join cross-functional initiatives and system testing as needed, working with IT on enhancements and production support.
  • Assist with Audits & Compliance: Investigate claims and compile documentation to support internal and external audits, under the guidance of the Senior Analyst or Manager.

What You Bring

  • Experience: Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in commercial operations, data entry, finance, or contract administration.
  • Analytical Rigor: Comfortable working with large, rule-based datasets and turning raw data into clear, concrete conclusions. Strong attention to detail and an instinct for spotting patterns and tracking down the source of a discrepancy.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable in MS Excel; experience with SQL, Power BI, or similar reporting tools is a plus.
  • Education: BA/BS preferred, in business, finance, data analytics, computer science, or a related field.

Who You Are

  • Eager to Grow: Wants to build specialized trade-chargeback expertise from the ground up. Picks up systems and processes quickly and asks questions when something falls outside standard procedure.
  • A Problem Solver: Notices when the same issue keeps showing up, not just one-off mistakes, and enjoys tracing it back to the root cause. Willing to loop in the right people, even outside the immediate team, to fix it rather than just report it.
  • A Clear Communicator: Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document your work clearly for teammates and stakeholders.
  • Adaptable and Collaborative: Comfortable multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment and working well within a team.

About CSL Seqirus

CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.

To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit and CSL Plasma at .

Our Benefits

You Belong at CSL

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

Epsilon, Inc. has joined AMERICAN SYSTEMS! As one organization, we offer expanded resources, streamlined operations, and increased opportunities for growth and development.

description:

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

The Service Tech is responsible for performing repairs and/or electrical testing on the Spectrum Infusion Pump. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety and comfort during the x-ray exam

title: Senior Engineer -Low Power CLP
description:
Job Description: In Arm's Solutions Engineering group, our primary focus extends beyond the development of advanced System-on-Chips (SoCs). In the endeavour to deliver a quality silicon we need to ensure all our signoff checks across various domains are diligently performed. Delivering quality silicon leads to quality rewards and every effort and skill is recognized and appreciated at ARM. Our responsibilities also encompass improvising methodologies, influencing EDA tools and build a knowledge base which will help in our product design. Learning and sharing knowledge is part of ARM culture and is very much appreciated and encouraged. If your interested in working with a team of collaborative and smart engineers responsible for validating RTL-to-Gate and Gate-to-GDS implementations, ensuring power intent correctness, and enabling high-quality silicon tapeout

Responsibilities:

Low Power structural check

  • Perform low-power verification using Cadence Conformal Low Power (CLP) or Synopsys VCLP.
  • Verify and validate UPF implementation across RTL, netlist, and physical design stages.
  • Perform power-aware equivalence checking and resolve identified issues.
  • Analyze, debug, and resolve CLP structural, rule-based, and power-aware verification failures.
  • Implement SoC-level low-power structural checks and debug issues through closure.

Logical Equivalence Checking (LEC/Formality):

  • Perform RTL-to-Synthesis, Synthesis-to-P&R, and ECO logic equivalence verification using Cadence Conformal LEC.
  • Analyze, debug, and resolve non-equivalences and aborts across different stages of the design flow.
  • Develop, automate, and maintain robust LEC flows and signoff methodologies.
  • Drive LEC failure resolution and closure, and generate comprehensive signoff reports.
  • Implement and debug SoC-level flat LEC runs through signoff.

Methodology and Automation:

  • Develop TCL, Perl, and Python scripts to automate verification tasks and improve productivity.
  • Build and maintain reusable verification flows and debug utilities to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Drive methodology enhancements for low-power verification signoff and efficient resolution of verification aborts.

Required Skills and Experience :

  • We are looking for a candidate with 5+ years of relevant experience in logical signoff and low-power structural verification for sophisticated SoC and IP development programs.
  • Strong experience with low-power design and verification, including hands-on knowledge of UPF/CPF and SystemVerilog.
  • Hands-on experience with low-power verification tools such as Cadence Conformal Low Power (CLP) or Synopsys VCLP.
  • Experience with Logic Equivalence Checking (LEC) and power-aware LEC, with strong skills in analyzing and resolving verification failures.
  • Ability to effectively debug CLP/VCLP and LEC issues and drive them through closure.
  • Understanding of synthesis and Place & Route (P&R) flows is an advantage.
  • Ability to collaborate across design, verification, and implementation teams to support successful signoff of complex SoC and IP designs.

description:
Our Company

Amerita

Overview

title: Director, Compensation
location: Austin, Texas, United States of America
description:
Job Description

Summary

The Director, Compensation owns the strategy, governance, and operational execution of Zendesk’s global compensation programs. This role is responsible for translating compensation into a business advantage by enabling competitive pay decisions, supporting talent retention and growth, and delivering scalable, equitable, and market-aligned compensation practices.

The Director will set the functional roadmap for global compensation advising, compensation analytics, tools and systems, with strong emphasis on data rigor, automation, process discipline, and cross-functional partnership. This leader will partner closely with senior leaders in Finance, Legal, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Total Rewards, and business executives to drive org-level outcomes that directly impact workforce planning, pay equity, budget management, and talent strategy.

This is a high-impact leadership role accountable for building scalable compensation operations, establishing practical policy guardrails, and serving as the final decision-maker for complex compensation escalations, exceptions, and executive compensation support.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Direct and oversee the global compensation function, including compensation advising, analytics, tools and systems, policy governance, and employee and manager support.
  • Develop, modify, and execute global compensation policies, guidelines, and procedures, ensuring alignment with business objectives, compensation philosophy, and organizational values.
  • Establish and implement compensation strategies and operating models that support pay decisions, job architecture, promotions, market pricing, and annual compensation cycles.
  • Serve as the functional authority on complex compensation matters and provide guidance to business leaders, HR partners, and employees on policy interpretation, exceptions, and competitive pay decisions.
  • Partner with Finance, Payroll, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and Total Rewards to support compensation planning, budget allocation, offer design, pay progression, and broader workforce planning.
  • Lead compensation analytics and insights, including market benchmarking, pay equity analysis, range penetration, incentive analysis, and executive-ready reporting.
  • Own compensation tools and systems, including configuration, workflow design, data integrity, reporting, and process automation to improve scale, accuracy, and user experience.
  • Support executive compensation activities, including executive offer packages, annual executive pay review processes, equity support, and coordination of governance and approvals.
  • Build forecasting and planning processes for compensation spend, merit cycles, promotions, adjustments, equity refreshes, and other compensation-related investments.
  • Analyze market trends, internal compensation data, and best practices to identify opportunities for program optimization, competitiveness, and improved employee experience.
  • Drive continuous improvement through process redesign, technology enablement, and standardization of compensation practices across regions and business functions.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the team supporting global compensation operations, establishing priorities and accountability for results.
  • Monitor program performance, data quality, escalations, and compliance risks, taking corrective action as needed.
  • Own short- to mid-term planning for the function, including annual goals, service delivery priorities, and strategic initiatives.
  • Establish KPIs, SLAs, and dashboards to measure compensation cycle effectiveness, turnaround time, decision quality, employee experience, and operational health.
  • Build and maintain governance frameworks for compensation decisions, including exception handling, approvals, documentation standards, and audit readiness.
  • Partner with leadership to ensure compensation programs support hiring strategy, retention goals, internal equity, and market competitiveness.
  • Lead org design, hiring, development, and succession planning for the Global Compensation team.
  • Build career frameworks and development paths for compensation specialists and managers, with clear accountability for performance and promotion readiness.
  • Manage vendor strategy, including RFPs, negotiations, contract management, and ongoing performance governance for compensation survey providers, analytics tools, and systems vendors.
  • Ensure compliance with global compensation requirements, including wage and hour considerations, pay transparency laws, internal controls, and data/privacy obligations, partnering with internal stakeholders to mitigate risk.
  • Provide executive-ready reporting and recommendations on compensation trends, risk, cost, and program effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in global compensation, executive compensation, total rewards, compensation analytics, or enterprise HR leadership.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including managing managers and scaling teams.
  • Strong experience partnering with senior Finance, Legal, Payroll, HR, and business leaders on compensation strategy and execution.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable compensation programs, playbooks, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience with financial forecasting, budgeting, accruals, and compensation planning related to enterprise workforce programs.
  • Deep knowledge of compensation principles, market pricing, pay equity, job architecture, incentive design, and compensation compliance requirements.
  • Experience leading vendor strategy, including RFPs, negotiations, and contract review.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to communicate complex compensation issues to senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguity while maintaining disciplined accountability.
  • Ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting data and turning insights into actionable recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCP certification or equivalent compensation credentials.
  • Experience supporting executive compensation programs and governance processes.
  • Experience with compensation management systems, workflow automation, and reporting tools.
  • Experience with pay transparency implementation and global compensation compliance.
  • Experience with equity programs, incentive design, and broader total rewards strategy.
  • Experience influencing organizational design, hiring strategy, or business planning through compensation insights.

title: Site Care Partner - 1 Year Contract - FSP
description:
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose - moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role

We are seeking a Site Care Partner II (SCP II) to join our team in a Istanbul or Ankara. As a Site Care Partner II, you are the face of the client - accountable for ensuring that investigative sites receive the support and engagement they need, issues are resolved promptly, and the client's reputation is upheld throughout the study lifecycle. You will serve as the primary client point of contact for investigative sites, leading site start-up activities through activation, building and retaining investigator site relationships, driving site-level recruitment and operational success, and safeguarding quality and patient safety at every site you support.

You will contribute to country and site selection activities by proactively collaborating with key stakeholders, providing local intelligence to country outreach surveys, investigator strategies, and client pipeline opportunities. You may also support country-specific activities required to assure end-to-end clinical trial implementation from start-up through closeout.

This is a high-impact, field-based role for a seasoned clinical professional who thrives on building relationships, solving complex site challenges, and driving study delivery across a global portfolio. You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where your expertise directly influences patient access to new therapies. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Site Care Partner II can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide input into country strategy, site planning, and site recommendations using in-depth knowledge of regional sites, processes, practices, and site performance metrics

  • Support the SOM/Global SM in defining local requirements for the importation and exportation of investigational medical product and ancillary supplies

  • Deploy Global Site and Study Operations (GSSO) site strategies by qualifying and activating assigned sites

  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to provide country and regional input to outreach surveys, including protocol feasibility, country standard of care, and local medical practices

  • Conduct site-level start-up activities including PTA, site activation checklist coordination, Informed Consent Document (ICD) finalization, and Site Initiation Visit (SIV) management

  • Drive site recruitment planning and delivery consistent with global, country, and local enrollment targets, responding to recruitment issues from investigators

  • Maintain regular communications with investigative sites to gather status updates and drive delivery against study goals, including recruitment and data entry timelines

  • Act as the operational point of contact for all site questions, liaising with and escalating to appropriate teams to resolve issues

  • Assure quality and consistency in monitoring delivery and drive monitoring efficiencies and best practices across study, region, and program

  • Coordinate with cross-functional roles including Study Monitor, Investigator Contracts Lead, Site Activation Partner, and Clinician to optimize communications and enhance visibility into site-level quality

Candidate Profile

You will thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Experience in project management

As a Staff Gen AI Scientist within Cotiviti you will be responsible for delivering solutions that help our clients improve the quality of healthcare outcomes, reduce the cost of healthcare processes, and/or identify payment integrity issues. You will work as part of a team and will be individually responsible for the delivery of value associated with your projects. You will be expected to follow processes and practices that allow your models to be incorporated into our machine learning platform for production execution and monitoring, however, initial exploratory data analysis allows for more flexible experimentation to discover solutions to the business problems presented.

  • Work with key stakeholders within Research and Development as well as Operations, along with product management to assess the potential value and risks associated with business problems that have the potential to be solved using machine learning and Artificial Intelligence techniques.
  • Develop an exploratory data analysis approach to verify the initial hypothesis associated with potential Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning use cases.
  • Document your approach, thinking and results in standard approaches to allow other data scientists to collaborate with you on this work.
  • Prepare your final trained model and develop a validation test set for QA.
  • Work with production operations to deploy your model into production and support them in monitoring model performance.
  • Participate in other data science teams collaborating with your peers to support their projects.
  • Participate in knowledge sharing sessions to bring new insights and technologies to the team.
  • Participate in design sessions to continuously develop and improve the Cotiviti machine learning platform.
  • Provide End to End value-based solutions, including data pipeline, model creation and application for end user consumption.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science/Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research covering Advanced Statistics, Machine learning and AI.
  • Experience with the latest techniques in natural language processing including transformers, fine-tuning LLMs, measuring/benchmarking and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, Llama/Mistral and OpenAI, vector databases.
  • 7+ years of hands-on data science/AI experience, using typical machine learning and data science tools including pandas, scikit-learn, keras, nltk, and TensorFlow/PyTorch, GPU's.
  • Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience working with Apache Spark™ and large-scale distributed datasets.
  • Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences is a plus.
  • Passion for collaboration, learn it all mindset and driving value with AI.

Mental Requirements:

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaborate as a team with a sense of urgency.
  • Professional with ability to properly handle confidential information.
  • Be value-driven, understand that success is based on the impact of your work rather than its complexity or the level of effort.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work within a matrixed organization.
  • Proficiency in all required skills and competencies above.
  • Communicating with others and teamwork.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Flexibility to work with global teams as well geographically dispersed US based teams.
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.

Base compensation ranges from $171,000 to $197,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.
