title: Learning Consultant
description:
Overview

The Learning Consultant serves as a business partner to business area leaders, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to identify talent development needs and design solutions that drive business results and build workforce capabilities. This role manages learning initiatives from discovery and analysis through design, implementation, and evaluation, leveraging evidence-based learning strategies, instructional design expertise, and strong consulting skills.

The Learning Consultant recommends and develops learning and non-learning solutions to improve individual and organizational performance while supporting business goals. Solutions may include professional and technical training, compliance education, performance support resources, learning pathways, and other talent development initiatives. The role manages multiple projects simultaneously while building trusted relationships, influencing stakeholders, and ensuring learning solutions align with organizational goals.

This position may be based in one of our office locations or fully remotely.

You Will

Business Consulting & Partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with business area leaders, subject matter experts, HR partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Consult with stakeholders by facilitating strategic discussions on development strategies, learner engagement, and talent development best practices.
  • Serve as a learning and development advisor to the assigned business area.
  • Contribute to a collaborative community of Learning Consultants by sharing ideas, building capabilities, and advancing learning consulting practices together.

Learning Strategy & Solution Development

  • Conduct needs analysis to identify business challenges, capability needs, desired outcomes, and success measures.
  • Recommend evidence-informed learning and non-learning solutions aligned with strategic business objectives.
  • Design, develop, implement, and evaluate instructor-led (in-person and virtual), blended, and self-paced learning experiences and solutions that apply adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and incorporate continuous development practices.
  • Develop courses, learning paths, curated content collections, job aids, and other resources to support job performance.
  • Facilitate engaging and learner-centered virtual and in-person experiences.

Project Management & Communication

  • Lead learning projects from analysis through implementation and evaluation.
  • Create project plans, reflecting scope, timelines, dependencies, roles and responsibilities, and planned deliverables and/or outcomes.
  • Coordinate activities across stakeholders and project team members.
  • Document and communicate project status, risks, challenges, and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple priorities while ensuring quality, responsiveness, and achievement of business objectives.
  • Update project workload indicators in tracking systems to show capacity, communicate progress, and support informed decision-making.

Learning Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish success measures and strategies to evaluate the impact of learning initiatives.
  • Analyze learner and business leader feedback, performance insights, and business outcome data to inform recommendations and continuous improvements.
  • Stay current on learning science, workplace learning trends, and emerging technologies to drive innovation.

Learning Operations & Compliance

  • Support learning technologies, learning management systems, and digital learning platforms.
  • Maintain learning records, reports, communications, and documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable continuing education, regulatory, accreditation, or organizational standards where applicable.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of enterprise learning programs and annual development initiatives.

You Have

  • Bachelor's degree in instructional design or technology, adult education, organizational development, I-O or educational psychology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience consulting with business leaders to identify learning and development needs and recommend solutions that improve performance and achieve business outcomes.
  • 5+ years’ experience applying adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and learning consulting practices to design and deliver a variety of learning solutions in corporate settings.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and collaborating across functions.
  • Ability to collaborate across functions, influence, negotiate, and facilitate productive discussions with leaders and teams.
  • Skilled in business partnering, stakeholder management, conducting needs analysis, information synthesis, and solution recommendation.
  • Proficiency with virtual collaboration technologies, Microsoft 365 applications, learning management systems, and authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Rise and Storyline, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, or similar).
  • Strong skills in facilitation, project management, communication, presentation, and organization.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional partners.
  • Commitment to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and strengths-based work environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in professional services, consulting, or other knowledge-based industries.
  • Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD) or Associate Professional in Talent Development (APTD) credential
  • Gallup®-Certified Strengths Coach credential

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $90,000 - $110,000. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on factors such as company and personal performance. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact careers@berrydunn.com to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.

BerryDunn is a client-centered, people-first professional services firm with a mission to empower the meaningful growth of our people, clients, and communities. The firm has been recognized for its efforts in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, and for its focus on learning, development, and well-being. Learn more at berrydunn.com.

title: Clinical Scheduler - Dermatology
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

The Clinical Scheduler provides comprehensive clinical scheduling and high-level administrative and secretarial support. This includes managing a high volume of incoming calls and faxes, assessing the nature and urgency of inquiries, and directing callers as appropriate. The role involves evaluating scheduling requests within a team-based structure, ensuring prompt and courteous service to patients and referring providers using the EPIC scheduling system. Duties also include scheduling general dermatology appointments, cosmetic procedures and elisions, managing appointments, communicating with office staff & providers as well as providing information to patients and visitors, and maintaining accurate patient records. Flexibility in work hours and the ability to provide cross-coverage in various clinical areas are essential.

This role is REMOTE, but must live in CT.

The 1st 6-8 weeks will be fully on-site for training and then Fully remote after that.

Required Skills and Abilities

1. Customer Service: Demonstrated experience with Surgical scheduling. Demonstrated excellent customer service skills with strong verbal and interpersonal communication, capable of interacting professionally with patients, providers, and staff.
2. Organizational Skills: Strong attention to detail and timeliness, able to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
3. Technology Proficiency: Proficiency in EPIC or similar EMR systems, with experience in scheduling and patient information management.
4. Communication and Listening: Effective listening skills and the ability to accurately assess and direct inquiries, with professional telephone etiquette.
5. Independence and Judgment: Ability to use sound independent judgment and critical thinking to manage patient interactions and resolve issues effectively.

Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. Medical Terminology: Knowledge of medical terminology and previous experience in a medical office or call center, especially in high volume settings.
2. Bilingual Skills: Spanish-speaking proficiency is advantageous for communicating with a diverse patient population.
3. Advanced Technology Skills: Experience with additional software, such as Microsoft Excel and multi-line telephone systems, is beneficial.
4. Specialized Experience: Experience in dermatology, and familiarity with EPIC .
5. Flexibility and Adaptability: Demonstrated ability to adapt to different clinical areas, manage high call volumes, and learn new procedures and technologies quickly.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Answers telephone calls and assess urgency of call. Provides assistance or directs caller to appropriate person, contacting physician/nurse directly for urgent needs. Provides assistance to other receptionists in screening patient calls. 2. Provides specialized information related to section, policies, procedures, insurance and services. Assists patients with the completion of forms. 3. Builds monthly provider master schedules and clinic calendars from established sources and verifies provider sessions worked. Modifies master schedules to accommodate time off, extra patients, hospital emergencies, etc. Creates patient bump lists as necessary due to last minute provider call outs. 4. Schedules patient appointments and resolves scheduling conflicts. Notifies patients of changes/cancellations and prioritizes urgency of appointments for rescheduling. May schedule patients into clinical research studies. 5. Receives patients and visitors. Secures names and needs and directs accordingly. Updates patient information and verifies insurance information, level of services and tracks referrals when necessary. Initiates billing process by completing patient encounter forms and accepts and processes fee for service payments. 6. Books diagnostic tests and specialized appointments for patients at hospitals and other medical facilities and ensures patients are provided with necessary paperwork and specialized instructions for procedures. 7. Schedules surgical procedures for patients. Coordinates available dates for surgery and scheduling of pre and post operative exams and lab work. Obtains and distributes necessary paperwork and maintains system to track completion. Coordinates surgery schedule changes as necessary. 8. Schedules and coordinates departmental meetings, classes, clinics, conferences, etc. 9. Utilizes computer input and retrieve data. Merges and manipulates data to generates complex reports. Compiles and maintains clinical and patient statistical data and produces summaries and reports. 10. Keyboards correspondence, clinical information, reports, publicity material, educational handouts etc. Composes general written material. 11. Obtains patient charts, medical records and lab reports and verifies for completeness. 12. Sorts, screens and distributes incoming mail. Prioritizes and ensures completion of medical forms by clinical staff. Coordinates interdepartmental communication including distribution of medical records and reports. 13. Establishes and maintains filing systems. 14. Maintains inventory of office supplies and educational material. 15. May oversee and instruct support staff. Ensures adequate coverage of reception desk. 16. Performs additional functions incidental to office activities. Required Education and Experience Four years of related work experience, two of them in the same job family at the next lower level, and a high school education; or two years of related work experience and an Associate degree; or an equivalent combination of experience and education.

Job Posting Date

09/15/2026

Job Category

Administrative Support

Bargaining Unit

L34

Compensation Grade

Labor Grade C

Compensation Grade Profile

Hourly Range

$28.43

Time Type

Full time

Duration Type

Staff

Work Model

Remote

Background Check Requirements

All candidates for employment will be subject to pre-employment background screening for this position, which may include motor vehicle, DOT certification, drug testing and credit checks based on the position description and job requirements. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of the background check. description:

The Project Engineer, or project manager-in-training, is responsible for assisting the Project Manager and Superintendent in all aspects of the day-to-day management of a construction project. In Brinkmann’s “concept-to-completion” business model, Project Engineers enjoy a high-level of responsibility and accelerated career path to project management. Duties include but are not limited to:

At Brinkmann Constructors, we don't just build buildings - we build community, relationships, and a team that inspires confidence. Together, let's build a future we can be proud of and make a difference, one construction project at a time. Our purpose is people. Our passion is building.

title: Driver CDL B Large Container
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: A Driver- CDL (B) is responsible for safely operating a collection truck, and providing prompt, courteous and complete waste removal services for customers. In addition, a Driver – CDL (B) is responsible for ensuring his or her vehicle is in compliance with the Company’s safety standards prior to operating the vehicle, ensures that all Company, state and federal regulations are adhered to at all times while operating the vehicle, and completes vehicle condition reports (“VCRs”) on a daily basis to ensure that any vehicle defects are repaired in a timely manner.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform complete pre- and post-operation inspection of the vehicle in accordance with Company policy to ensure tire pressure, fluid levels, safety equipment, gauges, and controls are in proper working order. Report any safety issues on standard reports.
  • Safely operate his or her heavy truck along his or her designated route and to the disposal site; read route sheet, follow map and service each customer as identified on the route sheet or as assigned by the dispatcher and/or supervisor.
  • Operate manual and/or automatic controls in accordance with Company safety policies and procedures to lift and load refuse, operate compactor and dispose of collected material at the designated facility.
  • Courteously interact with all customers, dispatchers and others on a daily basis to ensure all customer routes are serviced in a timely and professional manner.
  • Identify unsatisfactory waste containers and tag containers in accordance with applicable departmental procedures.
  • Continuously monitor waste for evidence of unacceptable waste.
  • Clean area around an accidental waste spill, ensuring adherence to all applicable safety standards and policies.
  • Continuously monitor the condition of the vehicle to ensure it is operationally ready at all times to minimize down time; clean waste from the packer blade and truck body (where appropriate) on each disposal trip.
  • Complete required route/productivity sheets, VCRs and other reports, as required.
  • Maintain adherence to required productivity standards for the department to ensure all customers are serviced in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Follow all required safety policies and procedures.
  • Actively participate in the Company’s ReSOP program.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.
  • Good customer services skills to meet and exceed customer expectations; acts in a professional, courteous and cooperative manner toward customers and co-workers; works with a sense of honesty and trustworthiness.
  • Good time management skills to ensure assigned responsibilities are completed in an efficient and safe manner.
  • Good follow through ability; adheres to work schedule and follows through on challenges as they arise.
  • Ability to adhere to Company policies and rules set forth; promotes the Company’s safety standards; does not take inappropriate risks.
  • Maintains a feeling of pride in work; strives to achieve all goals.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Class B or higher Commercial Driver’s license with air brakes endorsement.

Rewarding Compensation and Benefits

Eligible employees can elect to participate in:
• Comprehensive medical benefits coverage, dental plans and vision coverage.
• Health care and dependent care spending accounts.
• Short- and long-term disability.
• Life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment insurance.

• Benefits:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: Associate Director, Global Health Economics and Outcomes Research Analytics
description:
Location: Barcelona - Spain (3 days working from the office and 2 days working from home)

This is what you will do:

The Associate Director, Global Health Economics & Outcomes Research (GHEOR) Analytics, develops and implements HEOR Analytics strategy, including conceptualizing real-world evidence studies, identification of data sources, study conduct and execution of publication plan. The incumbent will engage in hands on programming in R, python (or SAS if needed) and other programming languages or tools to efficiently work with real-world databases, to identify and discover target patient populations, describe treatment patterns, disease burden, health care resource utilization and cost, and other exploratory questions. The Associate Director is responsible to ensure that outcomes and quality data are produced to ensure the scientific medical standing of the potential value and real-world impact of Alexion products for payers, healthcare providers, and patients and caregivers.

You will be responsible for:

  • Designs and implements HEOR studies that support the clinical, economic, and patient centered value propositions, as well as reimbursement requirements for the therapeutic areas of interest.

  • Manages analytics consultants and oversees the analysis activities by providing inputs to the analysis plans, monitoring the study conduct and reviewing study results.

  • Provides statistical guidance or methodology and interprets the analysis results.

  • Serves as a real-world data expert, identify data sources, and provide strategies to generate valid evidence from the appropriate databases.

  • Provide new insights for disease area to help shape clinical development strategies and generates real world evidence for value decisions of therapies.

  • Collaborates with Biostatistics team to work on clinical trial post-hoc analysis.

  • Generates rapid real-world evidence to empower the development needs, speed up clinical trial design or facilitate quick decisions.

  • Support preparation of medical or payer advisory meetings to solicit feedback on Alexion products and therapeutic areas specific disease impacts.

  • Ensure quality and timely deliverables for all assigned studies/projects.

  • Supports publication planning and execution, reviews, and approves abstracts or manuscripts.

  • Participate in acquisition strategy for real-world data sources for possible in-license/ purchase and additional analytical tools for analytic needs.

  • Contributes to the global HEOR analytics infrastructure, including develop best practices in HEOR Analytics function, identify areas for process improvement, and provide measures to improve quality and efficiency.

You will need to have:

  • BS/MS/MA in Statistics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Mathematics and/or PhD in related area.

  • Expertise in statistical methodologies including general linear models, multivariate regression, nonparametric methods, bayesian inference etc.

  • 5+ years prior experience in data sciences/biostatistics, analytical programming using R, Python, SAS and other languages in the biopharmaceutical/pharmaceutical industry.

  • Good understanding of the data structure and limitations of various types of real-world databases, and experience in working with large EMR or claims database are preferred.

  • Experience with big data science, machine learning, AI models.

  • Knowledge of clinical trials, and experience in analyzing and interpreting clinical trial data.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

  • Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.

  • Attention to detail while managing multiple projects under tight timelines.

  • Flexibility and adaptability to internal and external changes.

  • Experience and knowledge in rare disease is helpful, but not mandatory

title: Director of Enterprise Reporting
description:
Overview

Role Overview

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

We are seeking a highly effective senior program leader to drive our Enterprise Reporting Transformation. This leader will be responsible for the development and delivery of an enterprise performance dashboard, customer commitment and health reporting, and scorecards for our biggest customer opportunities. This leader will also own the strategic direction and end-to-end development of the data lake and enterprise reporting infrastructure, partnering closely with stakeholders across operations, product, and technology who will be building this capability. This role may also support other Transformation Initiatives over time related to reporting or more broadly, such as building customer advocacy, implementation excellence, etc.

This role demands strong cross-functional leadership — success will come from the ability to bring together teams across operations, product, sales, advisory, and customer success—aligning priorities, driving execution, and delivering against target outcomes. The ideal candidate thrives in complex environments, builds alignment across diverse stakeholders, and delivers large-scale transformation through disciplined program management. This role will also require working with senior management to shape the strategic plans and objectives for the initiatives described above, make final decisions on implementation plans, and be accountable for outcomes that have a critical impact on HealthEdge’s reporting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Enterprise Reporting Transformation Initiatives
  • Define and drive the roadmap for a unified enterprise reporting framework
  • Translate strategic objectives into clear, actionable plans
  • Engage with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver on plans and ensure we are delivering impact to all parts of the business
  • Work with senior management to help shape strategic plans and objectives for the enterprise reporting function, and make final decisions on implementation approach and prioritization
  • Enterprise Reporting & Data Lake Development
  • Serve as product owner for the three core reporting tools: the enterprise dashboard, customer commitment and health reporting, and big whale customer scorecards
  • Own the design and oversee the development of the reporting end-to-end, with support from tech and product resources
  • Own the development of the data lake and enterprise reporting infrastructure end-to-end, partnering with stakeholders across operations, product, and technology who will be developing this capability
  • Establish and own reporting on the status, progress, and impact of enterprise transformation initiatives
  • Develop standardized views for leadership that provide clear visibility into milestones, risks, dependencies, and outcomes
  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment
  • Partner closely with operations, product, technology, sales, advisory, and customer success teams
  • Build alignment on reporting priorities, definitions, and success metrics
  • Act as the central coordination point across functions to ensure consistency and cohesion
  • Interact regularly with senior management, executives, and key stakeholders, raising critical updates and risks and reconciling multiple stakeholder views to drive business results
  • Prioritization & Governance
  • Establish a structured approach to evaluating and prioritizing reporting initiatives
  • Balance competing demands while maintaining focus on enterprise value
  • Implement governance mechanisms to ensure standardization and accountability, enforcing a single source of truth for every metric across the business
  • Execution Excellence
  • Lead end-to-end execution of reporting transformation initiatives, from planning through delivery
  • Manage interdependencies, risks, and trade-offs across multiple workstreams
  • Ensure timely delivery with a strong focus on quality, scalability, and reliability
  • Escalate risks early and propose resolutions
  • Drive Standardization & Simplification
  • Reduce fragmentation by promoting a single, consistent approach to reporting
  • Align stakeholders on common definitions, metrics, and reporting practices
  • Change Management & Adoption
  • Champion adoption of the unified reporting approach across the organization
  • Drive communication, engagement, and behavioral change to embed new ways of working
  • Provide Functional & People Leadership
  • Direct the activities of the enterprise reporting function, including matrixed and cross-functional teams, through team and functional leads
  • Own resourcing decisions for the function, ensuring alignment with broader Transformation Office

Qualifications & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in program management, transformation, or operational leadership roles
  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in matrixed organizations
  • Strong experience working across business, product, and technology teams
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority
  • Experience in environments with competing priorities and high levels of ambiguity
  • Experience operating at a director level or equivalent scope, participating in senior leadership strategic planning and making final decisions on complex, loosely defined problems with critical, long-term impact on the business
  • Demonstrated experience establishing and managing executive-level reporting for large-scale initiatives is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with healthcare payer, health plan, or health IT environments is a plus
  • Experience owning or co-owning data platforms, data lakes, or enterprise data infrastructure, partnering with technology and product teams on architecture, build, and scalability is a plus but not required (close partnership with Product and Tech teams will provide this expertise)

Key Skills

  • Exceptional program and project management capabilities
  • Stakeholder management and executive communication
  • Ability to translate strategy into execution
  • Strong prioritization and decision-making skills
  • Change management and organizational influence
  • Analytical thinking to define KPIs linked to strategic priorities
  • Data literacy and comfort partnering with BI and analytics teams on dashboard design, KPI definition, and reporting standards
  • Data architecture and infrastructure acumen, with experience partnering with technology teams to design and scale data lake and platform solutions is a plus

What Success Looks Like

  • A scalable data lake and enterprise reporting infrastructure delivered in partnership with operations, product, and technology stakeholders, providing a reliable foundation for enterprise reporting
  • A clearly defined, delivered, and actively adopted enterprise dashboard, customer commitment and health tracker, and customer scorecards — in use by senior leadership within the first 6 months
  • Reporting used to drive leadership discussions and provides insight to make decisions and deliver on customer needs
  • Strong alignment across operations, product, sales, advisory, and customer success teams
  • Improved consistency and reliability in reporting outputs, with data integrity in terms of definition and measurement approach
  • Streamlined prioritization and faster execution of reporting initiatives
  • Sustainable governance model supporting long-term scalability

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

title: Intern – Technology Strategy & Architecture (Hybrid: Onsite & Remote)
description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE

Join Our Community of Food People!

The US Foods Summer Internship Program provides a forum for students to apply classroom skills and academic training in a real-world business environment. In addition to being assigned business-impacting projects throughout the summer, students will be matched with a manager who will meet with them on a regular basis to provide direction on assignments as well as deliver performance feedback and a mentor who will be available to offer day-to-day guidance and support.

Interns will also get exposure to US Foods executive leadership; have an opportunity to participate in learning and social events with other interns across business functions and have an opportunity to deliver an end of summer presentation to showcase their accomplishments with key business leaders.

US Foods internships are full-time paid positions (40 hours per week from June - August) with the possibility of transitioning to a full-time position post-graduation dependent on availability and overall performance.

This position has been segmented as Hybrid meaning the work is a combination of onsite and remote.

Please note: We are unable to provide internships to students that require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., OPT, F-1, H-1B or any other visa status) now or in the future.

[For Rosemont based internships only] Local candidates are encouraged to apply. For qualified students whose permanent home of record is located outside 50 miles from US Foods Corporate HQ, a sign-on bonus will be offered to partially offset housing costs for the summer.

BASIC PURPOSE:

At US Foods, technology powers every part of our business, from customer ordering and supply chain operations to data, analytics, and digital experiences. As a Technology Strategy & Architecture Intern, you'll gain hands-on experience working with teams that help shape the future of technology across the enterprise.

This internship offers a unique opportunity to learn how large organizations make technology decisions, evaluate emerging solutions, and design scalable systems that support business growth. You'll collaborate with architects, engineers, product teams, and technology leaders to understand how technology strategy translates into real-world business outcomes.

Throughout the program, you'll contribute to meaningful projects while building skills in enterprise architecture, technology strategy, digital transformation, and solution design. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of technologies, platforms, and business functions while developing a deeper understanding of how innovation, modernization, security, data, and cloud technologies come together to create business value.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support the Enterprise Architecture team in documenting current-state and future-state architecture views, including business capabilities, applications, integrations, data flows, technology platforms, and key dependencies.
  • Assist with research, analysis, and documentation of emerging technologies, industry trends, architecture practices, and vendor capabilities that may support DigiTech and US Foods business priorities.
  • Help maintain enterprise architecture repositories, standards, reference materials, roadmaps, and decision records to improve transparency, reusability, and consistency across DigiTech.
  • Participate in architecture review activities by preparing meeting materials, capturing notes, tracking follow-ups, and helping summarize architecture recommendations, risks, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Partner with architects, product teams, business stakeholders, security, data, infrastructure, and application teams to gather information and support architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and modernization planning.
  • Assist with application portfolio analysis by collecting and organizing information related to application ownership, business value, technical fit, lifecycle status, redundancy, risk, cost, and modernization opportunities.
  • Support the development and refinement of architecture standards, guardrails, templates, and reusable guidance to help teams design secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Contribute to dashboards, reports, and executive-ready summaries that communicate architecture insights, project impacts, technology risks, and progress against architecture initiatives.
  • Help identify opportunities to simplify the technology landscape, reduce duplication, improve reuse, and align solutions with enterprise architecture principles and DigiTech strategic objectives.
  • Perform assigned project work, status reporting, presentations, and other duties as needed to support the Enterprise Architecture function and the overall US Foods Summer Internship Program experience.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS:

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited college, university, or technical program, preferably pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Typically, students currently between their Junior and Senior years or between their 1st and 2nd years of graduate school will be considered for internships
  • Authorized to work in the United States without requiring employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Available to work full-time, 40 hours per week, for the duration of the summer internship program.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid environment, including onsite and remote work as required by the position.
  • Basic understanding of technology concepts, business process analysis, systems thinking, data analysis, or enterprise applications.
  • Interest in enterprise architecture, design thinking, systems thinking, and structured problem solving, with a willingness to learn how business capabilities, processes, information, applications, and technology platforms work together to support enterprise outcomes.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn enterprise architecture practices, ask thoughtful questions, and contribute to continuous improvement across DigiTech architecture processes and deliverables.

description:

title: RTSM Specialist - UK - Remote
description:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Clinical Systems Department does at Worldwide

Our Clinical Systems Department plays an essential role for the entire organization by ensuring our systems are developed to study specifications, fully integrated, optimally running, and well-maintained throughout the studies’ lifecycle. The department works closely with industry specific systems such as: IRT, RTSM, EDC, RBQM Opra, ClinSpark, eTMF and CTMS. The department has various roles including client-facing Project Managers, System and Software Designers, and Implementation and Validation specialists. Each of these areas provides mentorship and training. In working with a variety of systems, the department has a proven record of success for promotions and growth internally.

What you will do

  • Provide project management oversight from award to RTSM decommissioning, including oversight and accountability of deliverables and timelines and completion of work to Worldwide SOP standards

  • Communicates information on applicable RTSM project activities to stakeholders, including internal and sponsor study teams. Serves as the escalation point of contact for all RTSM assigned study-related project issues

  • Overall accountability for coordination and timely delivery of RTSM project communications including study status reports, meeting agendas and minutes and scheduling project calls

  • Responsible for overall RTSM project budget and ensuring accurate vendor work orders for assigned studies

  • Responsible for overall RTSM study design, as well as writing or reviewing and approving User Requirements Specification (URS)

  • Perform financial review and budget management, including review of Change Orders

What you will bring to the role

  • Ability to communicate concisely and effectively in both written and spoken English

  • Proficient client-facing skills

  • Proficient in the use of common office software

  • Self-motivated individual who can positively contribute to a team environment

  • High attention to detail

  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects simultaneously

  • Flexible and able to use sound independent judgment and take initiative to assess information

  • Able to make effective decisions in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment

  • Able to be creative, adapt to new technologies, concepts and processes, make improvements and solve problems

Your experience

  • Educated to degree level in a relevant discipline or able to demonstrate equivalent experience

  • Minimum 2 years prior RTSM experience

  • Minimum 1 year prior project management experience

  • Minimum of 5 years experience within CRO /pharma environment

  • Contract Research Organization (CRO) or Pharmaceutical experience required

  • Familiar with RTSM topics, including RTSM study design, randomization methodologies, and just-in-time drug supply

  • Understanding of clinical trials, blinding, patient safety, data integrity and associated regulations

  • Proven ability to manage delivery of RTSM solutions deployed in clinical trials

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. title: Parking Supervisor - Winter 2026/27
description:
Location: Bend, Oregon

Are you interested in delivering memorable experiences, enhancing people's lives and having fun while doing it? This shared mission of POWDR and Mt. Bachelor creates a fun and inspiring culture that we live every day. We look for employees who are passionate about sharing mountain culture, have a positive attitude, are problem solvers and care about winning as a team. Our vision drives us to deliver exceptional experiences and it's our employees who become the true moment makers here at Mt. Bachelor.


This role comes with amazing perks & benefits because we want our employees to Work Where You Play!


  • Free employee season pass and free or discounted dependent(s) season pass
  • Free and discounted friends & family day passes
  • Free transportation to & from Bend, Sunriver, and La Pine
  • Discounts across the resort (food & beverage, retail, rentals, lessons & more)
  • Winter season employee housing program & Summer season camping program
  • 401k with up to 5% company match & immediate vesting
  • Discounted daycare onsite at Mt. Bachelor
  • Local & national discounts (YETI, Burton, Dell, Subaru, Nokian, Sunriver Golf, Mammut, & more)
  • Free reciprocal access for employees to other POWDR resorts & 50% day passes at IKON pass resorts

Position Summary

Oversee and coordinate all mountain parking operations. Hire and manage parking attendants. Develop the training for parking department staff, including guest service and safety training. Responsible for establishing and maintaining efficient traffic flows to maximize parking.

Essential Duties & Major Responsibilities

  • Maintain a functioning parking structure throughout the day in Mt. Bachelor parking areas.

  • Prepare parking areas for guest arrival using traffic cones, rope lines, movable signage, and other methods as needed.

  • Manage and train staff to perform work safely.

  • Manage department to meet budget goals.

  • Manage labor through scheduling, daily monitoring, and Workday. Communicate variations to Manager

  • Coach and evaluate staff.

  • Provide staff with the tools and training to deliver exceptional guest service.

  • Assist guests with vehicle issues including lockouts, tows, and jumpstarts safely and responsibly.

  • Responsible for maintenance and placement of signage that allows Mt. Bachelor parking operation to function in an efficient and safe manner and in accordance with D.M.V. laws and U.S. Forest Service rules.

  • Patrol for vehicles parked in restricted areas and issue warnings, tickets, or, if necessary, place the boot on the vehicle while in coordination with Public Safety.

  • Maintain communication with snow removal team to ensure safe operation of equipment in pedestrian areas.

Job Scope

The Supervisor works early mornings through late afternoons, with possible midday ski/ride breaks occasionally. Reports to the Parking Manager and Director of Base Operations for all aspects of proper operation of the parking department in supporting the mission and goals of Mt. Bachelor.

Secondary Function

  • Remove snow from emergency exits around lodges and other areas.

  • Monitor snowfall areas on parking-lot-adjacent sides of buildings and mitigate or block off as needed.

  • Oversee paid parking areas. Ensure Parking Attendant has working tablet to check in paid parking guests.

  • Writing citations.

  • Booting vehicles.

  • Picking up trash in parking lots.

  • Stock supplies in Dog Park area and remove waste as needed.

  • Scheduling of parking attendants and timekeeping.

  • Assisting guests with jump starts, and performing lockout services and other duties as assigned.

  • Replenish cinders, spread as needed to promote safe walking areas.

  • Drive parking truck (s) as needed on Mt. Bachelor property and up/down to Bend to keep work schedule and supervise/execute parking lot operations.

  • Conduct Employee Safety Trainings.

  • After completing training, assist with snow removal using heavy equipment.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Number of employees supervised: Up to 40

  • Positions Supervised: Parking Attendants & RV Attendants

  • Scheduling and assigning work: Yes

  • Training: Yes

  • Disciplinary actions: Yes

  • Performance review: Yes

  • Hiring/Termination: Yes, assist manager as needed.

Interpersonal Contacts

First contact with guests as they arrive at Mt. Bachelor. The supervisor has interactions with other parking attendants, snow removal, public safety, vehicle maintenance, and Mt. Dispatch. The Parking Supervisor should possess the ability to relate to and communicate with the managers and staff employed within these departments.

Specific Job Skills

  • License/Certification: Current and valid Driver’s License required. ATV Certificate.

  • Technical: Computer skills (Word, Excel) required.

  • Physical Capabilities: This is an outside position that requires good physical condition and ability to be on your feet for long periods of time in all weather conditions. Lifting up to 50 lbs. is required.

  • Additional: Must have excellent guest service skills.

Education/Related Experience

  • Minimum Education: High School Diploma or GED.

  • Minimum time in related position: 1 year resort experience preferred.

Physical Demands

  • The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Such accommodation requires an interactive discussion with the Human Resources Department before such accommodation can be made.

    • In addition to the specific conditions below, every position at Mt. Bachelor requires the ability to shovel snow and walk on steep and uneven surfaces.

Current Hiring Range: $22.31/hr

Minimum Age Requirement: 21+

Come Work Where You Play!

Please be aware incomplete applications will not be accepted or reviewed. Mt. Bachelor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Mt. Bachelor is committed to creating a quality work environment which makes full use of the talents and contributions of all employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin or citizenship status, sex, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, disability or military status.

title: Senior Engineer, Systems C&S
description:

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Baxter’s Front Line Care business unit products expand therapies to better help patients and physicians to monitor & manage chronic or acute respiratory and cardiac diseases (COPD, CHF, etc.). Excel in the creation and maintenance of technical files to the MDD and STED to MDR for CE mark

Excels in providing support in the creation of Declaration of Conformance for applicable products. Support in the creation and maintenance of Declaration of Conformity.

Communicates and educates R&D teams on codes & standards requirements, and their implementation

Collaborates with QA/RA to register products in different geographical regions.

Documents status and results accurately and succinctly, and with purpose

Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Bio-Medical, Industrial Engineering or related field

3 to 8 yrs of experience, mainly in Codes and Standards, testing & System engineering function of Electro-Mechanical System Design.

Education and Experience

Experience in Medical Device development, FDA Regulations and MDR.

Exposure to Usability Engineering Process

Experience in QFD, Pugh Matrix, CTQ, DFR, DFX

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with others in a team environment

Understanding of and adherence to FDA, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations and standards

title: Postdoctoral Investigator
description:
Job Summary

Job Description

The Department of Marine Chemistry and Geochemistry is seeing a full-time Postdoctoral Investigator to develop methods to characterize the chemical and isotopic composition of polysaccharides extracted from surface seawater. A large fraction of the organic carbon, nitrogen, and phosphorus that accumulates in seawater occurs as a family of high molecular weight polysaccharides. These polysaccharides are resistant to conventional methods of polysaccharide analyses, and new approaches that combine novel wet-chemical depolymerization with spectrometric characterization by NMR and HPLC-MS need to be developed. The investigator will lead the development of new approaches to depolymerize, label and separate/characterize complex mixtures of oligosaccharides by HPLC-MS. The position is full time for one year with an extension of up to 20 months upon satisfactory progress.

The candidate should have experience with large volume water sampling from open ocean oceanographic vessels, large volume ultraﬁltration techniques for polysaccharide isolation, wet-chemical techniques for dissolved organic matter processing and a range of analytical instrumentation (high pressure liquid chromatography, high resolution mass spectrometry, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy). Familiarity with methods to process small organic matter samples for natural abundance radiocarbon measurements as well as a general knowledge of dissolved organic matter cycling in the ocean is also desired.

We’re the team behind the scenes that make the IKEA products available to the many people. As a diverse mix of co-workers we use our supply process expertise to balance range and space capacity with forecasting and ordering to provide customers with high availability while minimizing costs. If you’ve wonder who’s responsible for finding effective and efficient ways of picking up the products for our customers, that’s us. We’re passionate about working together to improve the customer experience at IKEA!



Naast dat je jezelf herkent in onze waarden, een passie hebt voor woninginrichting en staat te trappelen om jezelf en IKEA verder te ontwikkelen, voldoe je aan de volgende voorwaarden:

• Je werkt graag in de vroege ochtend (05:00-10:00 uur), zodat je genoeg tijd overhoudt voor je andere bezigheden.
• Je werkt 3 ochtenden per week (totaal 12 uur). We vragen om 4 ochtenden per week beschikbaar te zijn om flexibel ingeroosterd te worden. We zoeken mensen die beschikbaar zijn op maandag, donderdag, • vrijdag, zaterdag of zondag in de ochtend van 05:00-10:00. Vier weken voorafgaand aan je werkweek ontvang je je definitieve rooster.
• Je kunt zelfstandig werken en schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende werkzaamheden.
• Je hebt ervaring met of staat open voor fysiek zwaar werk.
• Belangrijk: Je bent niet afhankelijk van openbaar vervoer i.v.m. de vroege werktijden in Amsterdam.

Goed voor onze aarde én voor jou

• Vanaf 18 jaar ontvang je afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring een all-in uurloon vanaf €17,74 per uur. Dit uurloon is inclusief een 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld. Deze worden standaard in december en mei uitbetaald, maar je kunt er ook voor kiezen om deze maatschappelijk/maandelijks te ontvangen.
• Een collectieve bonusregeling. Deze wordt jaarlijks vastgesteld en bedraagt maximaal 150% van je bruto maandsalaris.
• Reiskosten voor het openbaar vervoer worden 100% vergoed. Woon je binnen een straal van 5 tot 20 km van de IKEA-vestiging? Dan kun je ook kiezen voor een leasefiets. Reis je toch met de auto? Dan krijg je een tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten tot maximaal 243 euro per maand.
• 15% personeelskorting bij alle IKEA-winkels in Nederland.
• Een extra toeslag als je werkt op onregelmatige tijden. De toeslag bedraagt tussen de 50% en 100% en geldt voor doordeweekse dagen en de zaterdag als je werkt in de ochtend voor 7:00 uur of in de avond na 21:00 uur. Op zondag en tijdens feestdagen ontvang je gedurende de hele dag een toeslag.
• Diverse regelingen die passen bij jouw persoonlijke situatie. Denk hierbij aan transitieverlof en gelijk (100% doorbetaald) geboorteverlof ongeacht de samenstelling van je gezin. Ook mag je de in Nederland geldende feestdagen met niet-christelijke feestdagen ruilen. En elke winkel heeft een stilte-/gebedsruimte.

En nog veel meer! Benieuwd? Check onderaan deze vacature de link naar alle arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Kom werken in een wereld aan ideeën

Ben je enthousiast geworden over de functie en zie jij jezelf in deze rol? Fantastisch! Upload je CV en motivatiebrief en solliciteer vandaag nog.
Wij kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!
