title: Deputy Program Manager, Engineering (DPME) Future Combatants and Mission Systems (FCMS)
description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related Science, Engineering or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:Department of Defense Secret security clearance is obtainable within a reasonable amount of time after hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required. Candidate must be able to work onsite.

Responsibilities for this Position

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) is seeking a highly skilled, motivated, and mission-focused Deputy Program Manager, Engineering (DPME) to join the Future Combatants and Mission Systems (FCMS) business area.

FCMS is at the forefront of designing, integrating, testing, and delivering mission systems for the U.S. Navy’s surface fleet. Our teams help transform operational needs into capable, fleet-ready solutions—rapidly designing, integrating, and deploying critical products and upgrades to ships and Sailors. This is an opportunity to lead engineering across a dynamic portfolio that directly advances the surface-warfare capability the Fleet depends on. We work across the full engineering and delivery lifecycle—from defining requirements and developing solutions to integration, test, installation, and fielding—so that high-quality products reach operational platforms quickly and reliably.

Position Overview

  • The DPME is a key engineering leader responsible for guiding projects from concept through delivery and fleet deployment. You will lead cross-functional engineering execution to ensure technically sound, high-quality mission capabilities are designed, integrated, tested, and delivered on schedule and within program commitments. The successful candidate will combine disciplined systems engineering and program execution with a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and commitment to Fleet readiness.

  • Key Responsibilities

    • Lead engineering execution from project initiation through integration, test, delivery, and fleet deployment.
    • Develop and maintain engineering plans that align technical requirements, customer needs, schedules, budgets, and delivery objectives.
    • Ensure engineering deliverables and technical documentation are complete, compliant, high quality, and delivered on schedule.
    • Validate system requirements and oversee system integration, verification, test, and readiness for operational use.
    • Establish and analyze engineering performance measures; implement corrective actions to resolve technical and programmatic issues.
    • Drive proactive technical risk, opportunity, and engineering change management to protect scope, cost, schedule, and customer commitments.
    • Lead collaboration across engineering, program management, operations, supply chain, test, installation, and customer organizations to accelerate mission-capability delivery.
    • Conduct lessons-learned activities and identify AI-enabled opportunities that improve engineering quality, efficiency, insight, and speed of execution.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Technical and Analytical

    • Strong problem-solving ability in complex, multi-disciplinary engineering and program environments.
    • Experience applying systems engineering and project management practices across multiple life cycles, including Agile execution.
    • Working knowledge of program performance and control methods, including SPI, CPI, Earned Value Management (EVM), Cost Account Management (CAM), and Statistical Process Control.
    • Ability to balance rapid execution with disciplined engineering, quality, system verification, cybersecurity, and mission readiness.
    • Ability to anticipate technology, process, and workforce needs that support program execution and growth.

    Leadership and Communication

    • Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, align stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and manage competing priorities.
    • Strong communication, organizational, planning, and time-management skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex technical and programmatic information to diverse audiences.
    • Commitment to delivering reliable, mission-critical capability to the Fleet with urgency and accountability.

    Preferred Technical Skills and Experience

    The ideal candidate brings systems engineering leadership and practical experience with shipboard infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking, virtualization, and fleet delivery. Candidates are not expected to possess every skill listed; technical leadership and the ability to develop expertise rapidly are highly valued.

    • Total Ship Computing Environment (TSCE): Experience with TSCE architectures, software-baseline updates, engineering changes, MBSE tools such as Cameo or MagicDraw, cross-class configuration management, and fleet availability coordination.
    • Virtualization and infrastructure: Experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, clustering, virtual-machine lifecycle management, server consolidation, SAN storage, and isolated-network services such as Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.
    • Networking and communications: Cisco CCNA-level knowledge or equivalent experience with switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, network segmentation, SATCOM, and multi-enclave shipboard network design.
    • Cybersecurity and accreditation: CompTIA Security+-level knowledge or equivalent experience with DISA STIGs, secure configuration management, vulnerability remediation, cyber-resilient design, Navy/DoD authorization processes, encryption, and IDS/IPS capabilities.
    • Software and automation: Experience with Python, Bash, PowerShell, Git/GitLab, Ansible, VMware PowerCLI, CI/CD concepts, and container technologies.
    • Systems engineering at scale: Experience leading full-lifecycle systems engineering, Agile IPT execution, engineering change management, and development of BOEs, POA&Ms, BOMs, technical risk assessments, and mitigation plans.

Candidate must be local to area and able to work onsite in Pittsfield, MA.

title: Reliability Engineer - Graduate Programme
description:
Reliability Engineer - Graduate Programme

Robilante

At Sibelco, we advance life through materials.

The Global Graduate Programme – A Fast-Track to Leadership

The Sibelco Global Graduate Programme is a two-year rotational programme consisting of two one-year assignments in key operational and commercial roles.

Participants gain hands-on experience with real business projects, ensuring early responsibility and exposure to strategic decision-making.

Participants receive a permanent contract from the start, ensuring long-term career prospects within Sibelco. As part of this programme, we are recruiting a Graduate Reliability engineer for a one-year assignment focused on using operational and maintenance data, advanced analytics and AI to improve maintenance effectiveness and production performance at the Robilante Cluster in Italy.

Graduates must also be open to spending their second year in a different cluster outside their initial region to gain international or regional business exposure.

Your Impact in This Role:

• Support the development of a data-driven predictive maintenance approach to improve maintenance planning
• Identify opportunities to optimize spare-parts inventory and reduce the operational impact of maintenance activities
• Develop dashboards and analytical tools to monitor maintenance and operational performance
• Evaluate the potential impact of the proposed solutions on production reliability and maintenance effectiveness
• Develop a scalable methodology or prototype that could potentially be adapted to other Sibelco plants
• Present findings, recommendations and improvement opportunities to plant management and relevant stakeholders

What You Bring to the Table

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• Interest in artificial intelligence, predictive analytics and data-driven decision-making
• Knowledge of maintenance, manufacturing or operational processes is an advantage

• Structured approach to problem-solving and ability to translate data into actionable recommendations
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Opportunity to work on a real operational improvement project
• Exposure to AI and advanced analytics in an industrial environment

title: Transformation Methodology Lead (f/m/d)
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

About the Role

Join Takeda’s GSQ Transformation Office as Transformation Methodology Lead and play a key role in shaping how transformation is planned, governed, delivered, and sustained across the organization.

In this role, you will define and continuously evolve the transformation methodology, standards, governance practices, and delivery framework that enable consistent, transparent, and results-oriented execution across the transformation portfolio. You will help establish a common way of working across sites and functions, strengthen delivery discipline, and ensure that transformation initiatives are supported by clear processes, reliable data, and effective decision-making.

You will work closely with the Transformation PMO, Transformation Enablement Lead, site and cross-functional transformation teams, Finance, and senior business leaders to ensure the methodology is practical, scalable, and embedded into day-to-day execution.

Your ability to balance structure with agility will be critical: you will drive consistency and accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy, enabling teams to move faster while maintaining the standards required in a regulated environment.

How You Will Contribute

Methodology, Frameworks & Standards

  • Define, build, and maintain the end-to-end transformation methodology, including lifecycle stages, decision points, templates, standards, and quality gates.
  • Establish a common delivery framework and minimum standards for transformation initiatives across sites and functions.
  • Define standards for business case development, scope definition, milestone planning, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, benefits realization, and performance reporting.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives are structured, measurable, and aligned with Takeda’s strategic priorities, with clear ownership and accountability.
  • Continuously assess and evolve the operating model, methodology, and standards to meet changing transformation needs.
  • Support the consistent use of portfolio metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting to improve transparency and enable informed decision-making.

Governance & Delivery Excellence

  • Establish clear governance routines, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability mechanisms across the transformation portfolio.
  • Lead the operating rhythm for methodology reviews, governance checkpoints, and exception management.
  • Enable leaders to make timely, informed decisions by ensuring that risks, issues, dependencies, and performance insights are surfaced with the right data and context.
  • Monitor adherence to agreed methodologies and identify opportunities to strengthen controls, standards, and governance.
  • Drive standardization and simplification of processes and ways of working to reduce complexity and accelerate delivery.
  • Identify recurring delivery challenges and translate them into improvements to standards, governance, and methodology.
  • Promote disciplined execution while maintaining a pragmatic, outcome-focused approach.

Data, Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Support data cleaning, ontology alignment, and master data readiness to ensure transformation teams can plan, track, and report using accurate and well-structured information.
  • Ensure the transformation methodology enables compliant, well-documented execution within a regulated environment.
  • Maintain version control and accessible knowledge assets to enable consistent adoption of standards and best practices.
  • Capture lessons learned and translate them into methodology enhancements, reusable tools, and improved ways of working.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, quality, accountability, and high performance.
  • Enable sustainable adoption by supporting the transition of methodology ownership into the business.

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience developing or implementing transformation methodologies, PMO standards, governance frameworks, or structured delivery models.
  • 5+ years of experience in the global pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated environment.
  • Strong digital fluency, including experience with Microsoft Power Platform such as Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power BI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data and insights into practical improvements.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex business environments and translate new insights into effective methodologies and ways of working.
  • Results-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working independently and driving initiatives with limited supervision.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions and organizational levels.
  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • PMI or equivalent project management certification and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher are preferred.
  • Demonstrated alignment with Takeda’s values and leadership behaviors, including ownership, collaboration, integrity, and a patient-focused mindset.

Additional Information

As a recognized expert within Takeda globally, you possess in-depth expertise in your discipline and broad knowledge across related areas. You're adept at anticipating internal/external challenges, recommending improvements, and solving unique, far-reaching business problems. Your role involves working on abstract issues, assessing intangible variables, contributing to global Business/Functional strategy, and serving as the primary contact for contracts and operations, conducting briefings and meetings with top management and customers. Operating with significant autonomy in a complex environment, you also lead project teams to achieve milestones and objectives.

Empowering our people to shine

title: Software Engineer 6 – Context Enablement
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Productivity Engineering is an AI-native organization tasked with making Netflix engineers more effective. We build and support the infrastructure to create, build, test, deploy, run, and observe the Netflix stack, with a central focus on how AI changes how engineers work: the tools, context, evals, and paved roads that make agentic development reliable at scale. As Netflix grows, so does the complexity behind our engineering systems. Our challenge is deceptively simple: keep the developer experience excellent even as complexity increases. Our work impacts virtually every engineer at Netflix and enables other platform teams to innovate faster.

The Agent and Engineer Experiences organization exists to make agents more capable, trustworthy, and easier to manage at scale. We also focus on how engineers and agents work together in practice: from plugins which deliver context to the developer experiences where engineers discover, trust, and use agents. We operate with a bias to action in a fast-moving space: shipping incrementally, learning from production, and exercising strong judgment as models, tools, and practices change.

Who we are

The Context Enablement pod owns the context layer that grounds coding agents in how Netflix works. Agent quality depends on plugins and curated knowledge; that layer is now business critical for engineering productivity and is growing faster than the governance around it.

We are responsible for:

  • The agent plugin ecosystem, how teams package and distribute agent plugins, MCP servers, and tools

  • Dev Profiles, the standardized path for delivering the right tools and context to every engineer's environment

  • NECP (Netflix Engineering Context Provider), the curated knowledge system grounding coding agents in Netflix-specific frameworks and patterns

We serve context producers (platform and domain teams authoring context) and consumers (engineers whose daily agentic work depends on it). We are building toward a Context Development Lifecycle across creation, evals, distribution, and observability so domain owners can manage their curated context while the platform handles the rest.

We are hiring a Staff engineer to serve as the technical lead for this pod: accountable for technical outcomes, farming for dissent across partners, and making clear judgment calls when the space shifts. You will set technical direction for a team of 4+ engineers and work shoulder to shoulder with the pod's EM, PM, and the organization's Architect to turn an ambiguous, fast-moving space into durable platform work. This is a new team in a new space; this role will be central to bootstrapping how we deliver context and how it connects to the broader engineer and agent experience at Netflix.

What you will do

  • Shape how Netflix delivers, evaluates, and governs agent context across plugins, Dev Profiles, and NECP, with a bias to action and incremental delivery in production.

  • Exercise judgment under change: stay current on the AI landscape, separate signal from hype, and translate what matters into durable platform improvements for Netflix engineers.

  • Define and evolve technical strategy for the context platform as tools, models, and organizational needs shift.

  • Partner with platform and domain teams to enable context producers to improve the daily agent experience for consumers.

  • Establish feedback loops early: engage customers, measure quality and adoption, and iterate based on what you learn in production.

  • Operate with agility when requirements are ambiguous: socialize options, decide, align partners, and adjust course as you learn.

  • Make thoughtful technical and product tradeoffs in a fast-moving AI space.

  • Lead and grow a team of 4+ engineers as their technical lead: set the technical bar, mentor through design and code. You believe deeply in mentoring as a multiplier for team quality and velocity, not an optional extra, and you will also share that impact across the org.

What we'll expect from you

  • Prior experience leading large and/or cross-functional projects or product domains in a large engineering organization (500+ engineers).

  • Prior experience on a team that builds tooling for other engineers (Developer Productivity, Platform, Engineering Effectiveness, or similar).

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with agent context, plugins, and evals; strong fluency with modern agentic development practices and curiosity about where the space is headed.

  • Demonstrated judgment under change: you adapt quickly, make sound tradeoffs without perfect information, and improve your approach as tools and constraints evolve.

  • Track record of influence across teams without authority: standards, contracts, or paved paths other groups adopt.

  • Examples of positive impact outside your immediate team (efficiency, quality of life, user sentiment, measurable adoption).

  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin/Go or JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Strong product engineering mindset: empathy for peers and customers, clarity on who benefits from your work and why now vs later.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, incremental delivery, and continuous learning from production signals.

  • A track record of technically leading and mentoring a team of engineers (formally or as a tech lead), with genuine belief in the value mentoring brings and evidence you have raised the bar for those around you.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience with Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) where engineers discover tools, documentation, and agent workflows in one place. Our sister team works on Console, Netflix's Developer Portal, a primary place where engineers interact with agents.

title: Senior AWS Solutions Architect

We are seeking a senior, hands-on AWS Solutions Architect to lead the evolution of a modern AWS-based data platform from a federated data products layer into a scalable semantic layer powered by a Knowledge Graph. This role will play a critical part in shaping the architecture and technical direction of a next-generation data portal supporting advanced analytics, semantic search, and intuitive business-facing data experiences. GENERAL DESCRIPTION

Under the supervision of the Residential Services Manager, this position assists in the development and implementation of individual program plans; serves as an advocate and role model for all residential clients; plans and supervises client activities; ensures medication administration is completed accurately and per regulations and policies; assists clients with community integration; documents observations and results of all interventions; upholds client rights including confidentiality and maintenance of the residences. 11. Informs the appropriate individuals and/or supervisor of any client issues.

12. Ensures residences and clients remain clean and safe during all scheduled work shifts.

13. Provides for client transportation needs as needed.

14. Intervenes when clients demonstrate potential or actual harmful behavior using the least restrictive method.

15. Ability to provide verbal de-escalation and/or physical behavior management techniques as trained through BMC.

17. Models and completes activities of daily living, including self-care, laundry, meal preparation, grocery shopping, and cleaning.

18. Attends and/or completes all required meetings and trainings within required timeframes, including regular departmental staff meetings.

19. Embraces and supports Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion initiatives.

20. Performs other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

1. High School diploma or equivalent.

2. Verification of completion of a state-approved Medication Aide course.

3. One year of clinical experience working with individuals with psychiatric disorders.

4. Ability to teach, educate, and role model the skills necessary for clients to pursue more independent living.

description:
If you are wondering what makes Trimedx different, it's that all of our associates share in a common purpose of serving clients, patients, communities, and each other with equal measures of care and performance.

Summary

The Biomedical Technician III (BMET III) installs, inspects, troubleshoots, repairs, calibrates, and verifies the performance of highly complex biomedical equipment and systems, independent of technical supervision. The individual should be competent in the use of all applicable test equipment and tools required in the performance of duties. The BMET III serves as an advisor to administrative, medical, and clinical staff in the safe use and proper operation of clinical equipment and in developing specifications for the selection of new equipment. This position also contributes to department improvement and development by mentoring other associates. The individual demonstrates adherence to the TriMedx core values in all professional interactions by showing respect to all people, creating real value, initiating meaningful change, and exhibiting integrity.

Responsibilities

Technical Service – 40%

  • Perform performance assurance (PA) inspections, scheduled maintenance, electrical safety inspections (ESI), and operation verification procedures (OVP) on highly complex and intricate biomedical equipment and systems
  • Repair, install, and calibrate highly complex and intricate biomedical equipment and systems
  • Inform supervisors of the status of repairs, scheduled inspections, unusual equipment situations, and any customer concerns
  • Work with, direct, and document the activities of subcontractors, vendors, and outside service technicians to ensure proper service delivery
  • Maintain biomedical expertise through ongoing training and education
  • Lead Service Operations Special Projects as assigned. Travel to sites and\or work with other Central Office associates as necessary for the collection and analysis of information and\or data pertaining to any special assignments

Regulatory Compliance – 25%

  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of the equipment database to include the inventory, performance assurance (PA) schedules, nomenclature, and service history
  • Adhere to the Medical Equipment Management Plan (MEMP), including all regulatory agency compliances and other applicable policies and procedures
  • Responsible for ensuring all service and documentation is complete, timely, and accurate

Account Relationship Management – 25%

  • Build and maintain customer relationships
  • Discuss equipment status and functionality with clinicians
  • Adheres to the Mission, Vision, and Values of the organization(s) served.
  • Serve as an ambassador for TriMedx by integrating the core values into job performance

Inventory – 10 %

  • Perform periodic inspections of current inventory status
  • Verify the completion of security analysis for new customer equipment
  • Performs Incoming Inspections (II) to maintain a complete and accurate inventory of medical devices, including trial and evaluation, rental, and loaner equipment in addition to permanently assigned equipment inventory.
  • Maintain the accuracy and integrity of the equipment database to include inventory, performance assurance (PA) schedules, nomenclature, and service history

All other duties as assigned

Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience working with biomedical equipment in a clinical engineering environment
  • Complex computer skills required, including the ability to administrate a system, interpret error codes, defragment hard-drives, replace power supplies, interpret computer codes, and apply networking concepts
  • Ability to integrate information from a variety of sources
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentational communication skills
  • Valid driver’s license required; variable travel requirements depending on primary site that may require use of personal vehicle

Education and Qualifications

  • 2 year degree in a technical/electronics field or equivalent experience required. This requirement will be waived if the applicant has received the TRIMEDX Trained Certification or completed an equivalent biomedical related certification program.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering technology preferred

title: Senior Director - Data Architecture,Data Foundry
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Overview

Lilly Small Molecule Discovery is purpose-built to create molecules that make life better for people. Discovery Technology and Platforms (DTP) accelerates molecule discovery by building foundational platforms, streamlining lab operations through advanced technologies and data connectivity, and investing in novel capabilities.

Data Foundry is a multidisciplinary team within DTP that enables AI-native drug discovery through four integrated pillars: Architecture4Insight, Methods4Insight, Automation & Scale4Insight, and Preparedness4Insight. Together, these pillars provide the scientific foundation, data assets, analytical capabilities, and automation frameworks that empower both researchers and AI systems to accelerate molecular discovery.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Director, Data Architecture to define and drive the scientific information architecture that powers AI-native drug discovery across Molecular Discovery.

As a senior leader within Architecture4Insight, you will establish the architectural vision, standards, and roadmap that transform scientific data into a strategic asset for discovery scientists, computational researchers, and autonomous AI agents.

You will provide technical leadership across the Data Architecture capability, shaping scientific data platforms, ontologies, metadata frameworks, knowledge graphs, and AI-ready data ecosystems. As a player-coach, you will lead a small team of architects while remaining deeply engaged in the most critical data architecture decisions across Molecular Discovery.

This role requires deep expertise in scientific data architecture, strong technical leadership, and the ability to influence strategy across organizational boundaries. Success will be measured by the quality, adoption, scalability, and scientific impact of the data architectures that enable Molecular Discovery.

Responsibilities

Scientific Information Architecture

  • Define and drive the scientific information architecture strategy and implementation.
  • Establish standards and architectural principles for data modeling, metadata management, semantic interoperability, ontology governance, and FAIR data implementation.
  • Develop roadmaps for scientific data platforms, metadata capabilities, knowledge systems, and AI-ready data assets.

Technical Leadership & Influence

  • Serve as a senior technical leader and architecture authority across Data Foundry initiatives.
  • Mentor architects, engineers, and scientific informatics professionals.
  • Personally contribute to architecture design, technology evaluation, and solution development for high-priority initiatives.

People Leadership & Technical Coaching

  • Lead a team of Data Architects supporting scientific information architecture across Molecular Discovery.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and scientific partnership.
  • Promote architectural consistency, knowledge sharing, and adoption of best practices across Architecture4Insight.

Architecture Stewardship

  • Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and architectural standards.
  • Measure and improve platform interoperability, metadata quality, discoverability, and architecture adoption across Molecular Discovery.
  • Help shape the long-term evolution of Data Foundry's scientific data ecosystem.

Data Modeling, Ontologies & Semantic Architecture

  • Enable unified discovery and exploration of scientific knowledge across previously disconnected systems and data sources including molecules, targets, pathways, assays, experiments, structural biology data, and AI-generated insights.
  • Drive adoption of semantic technologies including RDF, OWL, SPARQL, and modern knowledge representation frameworks.
  • Drive consistency in metadata harmonization, ontology integration, and semantic interoperability across scientific platforms.

Basic Requirements

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Information Science, or related STEM field.
  • Ph.D. with 8+ years or M.S. with 12+ years of experience in scientific informatics, data architecture, platform architecture, data engineering, or related technical disciplines.
  • Deep expertise spanning data modeling, metadata management, ontology engineering, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, scientific data platforms, and AI-ready data ecosystems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience defining architecture strategy for large-scale scientific data platforms and research informatics ecosystems.
  • Experience leading small teams of highly skilled architects, engineers, or scientific informatics professionals while remaining an active technical contributor.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical architecture decisions into scientific and business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of discovery science workflows, including chemistry, biology, screening, automation, imaging, structural biology, genomics, proteomics, and computational sciences.
  • Expertise with Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Delta Lake, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, vector databases, and cloud-native data platforms.
  • Experience with semantic web technologies, ontology engineering, FAIR implementation, and scientific knowledge graphs.
  • Experience enabling machine learning, generative AI, retrieval architectures, and agentic systems through modern data architectures.
  • Familiarity with laboratory informatics platforms including LIMS, ELN, Benchling, laboratory automation systems, and scientific workflow platforms.

title: Ford Racing Battery Modeling Engineer
description:
Racing is where our story began.

In 1901, Henry Ford climbed into a car he built himself "Sweepstakes" and beat America's most famous driver. He wasn't a racer, but he had to win. He did. Ford Motor Company was born from that victory.

That fighting spirit lives on in Ford Racing today. We're the engineers, strategists, and competitors who bring Ford's track-tested edge into every vehicle we build. Every track, every stage, every proving ground that's where we prove ourselves.

The result: one of the world's most iconic brands, legendary nameplates, and a team unmatched in the industry.

Our mantra: Race to win, engineer to lead.

If you're a competitor, innovator, or performance obsessive, Ford Racing is where you belong. Help us write the next chapter.

In this position...

You'll work at the intersection of battery chemistry, data, and competition turning test results into physics-based models that translate into faster lap times. If you love seeing your work make a measurable impact, this is where that happens.

You'll be part of a small, high-performing motorsports team where ownership is high, ideas are tested fast, and continuous improvement is the mission.

You'll apply your modeling expertise to Ford Racing's current battery systems, then set the direction for future methods and battery designs.

What you'll do...

  • Build and refine electrochemical models using tools like MATLAB and COMSOL to drive future development and guide decisions on cell chemistry and format direction.
  • Build and refine thermal and equivalent circuit models using tools like GT-Suite and Simulink to predict how battery cells will perform under real track conditions.
  • Work with array design engineers to shape how cells integrate into the battery array, informing cooling methods and heat rejection designs for optimum system efficiency.
  • Provide technical expertise to a global team of internal and external stakeholders spanning Ford Racing production and motorsport vehicles.
  • Guide testing strategies to ensure data needed for models are generated effieciently. Define requirements for battery management systems as they relate to cell state estimation, life, and operational efficiency.

You'll have...

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field: Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a relevant field
  • 2+ years of direct experience modeling Li-Ion battery cells
  • Competency in relevant engineering software (e.g., COMSOL, GT-Suite, Python, MATLAB Simulink)
  • Working knowledge of battery cell test methods, chemistry, and key design parameters
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally, as required

Even better, you may have...

  • Master’s / Ph. D in a related field: Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a relevant field
  • Experience with 3D heterogeneous chemistry modeling
  • Hands-on experience producing lab-scale Li-Ion battery cells
  • High Voltage Safety Training
  • Competitive spirit and interest in professional motorsports



You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more

  • Paid time off for individual and team community service
  • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

Join a Team at the Centre of Complex Financing Transactions. This is a great opportunity to build your expertise in a client-facing role with exposure to a broad range of financing structures and industry sectors.

The Team

Working closely with offshore colleagues, the team is focused on delivering a high-quality, client-centric service while continuously improving processes and controls.

  • Managing deal closings, funds flow, and transaction onboarding.

  • Reviewing facility documentation to ensure compliance with internal policies and market standards.

  • Coordinating with lenders, borrowers, legal counsel, and internal stakeholders to deliver transaction milestones.

  • Acting as the primary contact for agency-related queries and issue resolution.

  • Facilitating amendments, waivers, consents, and syndicate communications.

  • Investigating operational issues and mitigating transaction risks.

  • Overseeing offshore servicing activities to ensure excellent client delivery.

How to Succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

  • To be successful in this role, you'll bring proven experience within Loans Agency operations, with a strong understanding of credit documentation and the ability to confidently interpret complex loan agreements. Experience using LoanIQ is essential, enabling you to manage transactions accurately and efficiently from day one.

  • You'll thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. title: Director, eDiscovery – Technology Consulting
description:
Who We Are


FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About the Role

This Director position is within FTI Consulting's Technology practice. FTI Technology utilizes modern review platforms for native document review and case management. Our practice primarily provides professional consulting services to corporations and law firms for coordinating document review and production using Relativity and/or Nuix Discover. The Director will be responsible for managing multiple aspects of specific client matters.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who:

  • Is technically minded - all our work requires thinking in a logical, mathematical way about processes and sets of data

  • Works flexibly with a variety of team members - we work on a variety of projects at the same time, each of which can be staffed differently

  • Is eager and excited to learn - a positive, open-minded attitude will ensure quality work and bodes well for long-term career development

  • Works hard - while we do innovate, everyone has regular assigned tasks that are part of the overall workflow and on which high quality client service depends

  • Enjoys solving the impossible - we often receive requests that require us to consider difficult questions and develop new processes

What You'll Do

  • Have responsibility for day-to-day activities of projects including interaction with other consultants, supervisors, and client personnel

  • Apply analytical skills and leverage existing methodologies to various client situations and practice disciplines and create novel, customized solutions to meet shifting client needs

  • Utilize logical reasoning skills to provide complete client service

  • Work to ensure a quality product and delivery of all work within established timeframes.

  • Introduce additional FTI services to clients as needs dictate

  • Provide superior client service in demanding, deadline-driven situations

  • Maintain professional image within the firm and project same to those outside the firm

How You Will Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need To Succeed

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • 6+ relevant experience utilizing eDiscovery technology (Relativity, Nuix Discover, and/or Reveal)

  • Ability to travel to clients and FTI office(s) as needed

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis; this position does not provide visa sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency with Windows and related software, such as Microsoft Excel

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Access and SharePoint

  • Excellent communication and client interface skills

  • Outstanding client service in demanding, deadline–driven situations

  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, multi-task environment

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
• Responsible for executing, monitoring, and training inventory best practices and standard operating procedures for the entire store, including both front end and pharmacy. Supports pharmacy inventory management activities, including receiving, counting, ordering, and facilitating returns. Champions On-Shelf Availability and is responsible for receiving, counting, pricing, returns, and all in-store inventory processes. Validates and ensures accuracy of planograms.
  • Responsible for reviewing and coordinating the proper use of reports and system applications, which have an impact on the accuracy of front end and pharmacy on-hand balances and pricing.
  • Responsible for executing and maintaining front end and pharmacy asset protection techniques, and filing claims for warehouse and vendor overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods including prescription drugs.
  • In designated stores, as required, opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems start-ups, required cash handling and cashier responsibilities, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day.
Customer Experience
  • Engages customers by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
Operations
  • Executes and coaches team members on warehouse and vendor inventory management processes including but not limited to creating, reviewing, and receiving orders.
  • Scans in all deliveries while the vendor is still in the store, including common carrier deliveries. Focuses on One Box receiving. Takes the appropriate action marking delivery as received if the product was physically delivered, contacting vendor for past undelivered scheduled receipts, and opening tickets as needed to correct inaccurate orders.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge, verifies all pharmacy shipments are posted for products physically received at the store. Completes or verifies postings of all pharmacy warehouse orders, ABC prescription and OTC orders daily, secondary vendor orders, flu and dropship orders performing any necessary tote audits, and accurately reporting any shortages or damaged product.
  • Completes On-Shelf Availability (OSA) end-to-end process including warehouse and direct store delivery (DSD) for planogrammed departments, executing disposals, call-ins, and vendor returns before expiration, completes scan outs/ scan outs returns on all subscribed departments including vendor/ DSD departments and pharmacy scan outs.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge,completes pharmacy inventory activities including but not limited to pharmacy recalls following Pharmacy Hazardous Waste Policy, vendor returns, non-controlled, and damaged salvage returns. Facilitates excess inventory returns or interstore pharmacy transfers where applicable for non-returnable ABC overstock. Verifies posting of all pharmacy/ prescription claims.
  • Completes execution of all pricing activities including price changes, markdowns, and markdowns deletes. Responsible for basic department pricing, including daily price changes, accurate pricing with correct signage, and reliable and timely completion of any additional regulatory pricing tasks.
  • Responsible for supporting front end and pharmacy ordering by ordering expense items. Monitors pharmacy manual orders to identify excess orders. Maintains consigned inventory and orders as required.
  • Ensures all designated pull & quarantine item on-hands are updated and placed in the designated holding area.
  • Maintains accurate inventory counts. Maintains the accuracy of on-hand quantities including but not limited to basic departments, stockroom, overstock locations.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge, maintains accurate inventory counts and accuracy of on-hand quantities in pharmacy and completes pharmacy smart counts.
  • Ensures the store maintains inventory compliance with state and local laws regarding regulated products (e.g., alcoholic beverages and tobacco products).
  • Assists in the maintenance of inventory records, including receiving and posting of all products (in the front-end)) received at the store in all inventory systems. Organizes files and retains all invoices/receipts/return authorizations necessary for all inventory activities.
  • Helps to prepare for physical inventory and supports the physical inventory day activities, including but not limited to preparing sales floor, stockroom, and pharmacy for inventory and auditing the third party team on the day of inventory.
  • Supports keeping all counters and shelves clean and well merchandised.
  • Knowledgeable of all store systems and equipment.
  • Assists and coaches store team on all package delivery activities, including scanning in and out of packages, completing all daily inventory functions and, package returns at Walgreens. Supports execution of Pickup Program.
  • In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned point-of-sale system (POS), including records of scanning errors, price verifications, items not on file, price modifications, and voids. Completes product returns, order voids, customer refunds, cash drops to safe, and provides change as requested for point of sale.
  • Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
  • Completes any additional activities and other tasks as assigned.
Training & Personal Development
  • Attends company-based trainings for continuous development and completes all e-learning modules including safety training requirements.
  • Obtains and maintains a valid pharmacy license/certification as required by the state.
Communications
  • Serves as a liaison between management and non-management team members by coaching and developing other capabilities with inventory systems. When serving as the leader on duty, communicates assigned tasks to team members and reports disciplinary issues and customer complaints to management.


Basic Qualifications
  • Six months of prior work experience with Walgreens (internal candidates) or one year of prior retail work experience (external candidates).
  • Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English (except in Puerto Rico).
  • Must have a willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to multi task and manage execution.
  • Experience in identifying operational issues and recommending and implementing strategies to resolve problems.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Prefer previous experience as a shift lead, pharmacy technician, designated hitter, or customer service associate.
  • Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens, with an evaluation on file.

title: Principal Biostatistician
description:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What The Principal Scientist, Biostatistician does at Worldwide

Use independent judgment and technical expertise to assist in designing studies; preparing statistical analysis plans; analyzing data from pharmacokinetic, clinical, and pre‑clinical studies; interpreting statistical results from pharmacokinetic, clinical, and related analyses; and generating randomization schedules for clinical studies.

Principal Scientists are recognized as scientific leaders in the company. They regularly contribute to literature and to building Worldwide Clinical Trials’ intellectual property and are capable of leading interdisciplinary project teams.

What you will do

  • Accurately and efficiently perform tasks that are broad in scope

  • Use knowledge and judgment to reach well‑defined goals in project management

  • Work independently and collaboratively to solve technical problems by implementing contemporary methods

  • Assist the clinic, method development, and marketing/business development by applying knowledge, conducting literature reviews, providing information, and offering related support

  • Train and guide less experienced personnel in techniques required for work assignments

  • Supervise personnel involved in statistical and pharmacokinetic‑related work

  • Assist with the design of clinical studies and construct data analysis plans to meet study protocol requirements and maximize information from available data

  • Perform statistical analyses on clinical and pharmacokinetic data using appropriate methods and software programs

  • Prepare documentation for final reports, including text, tables, graphs, and analysis outputs

  • Interact with clients, bioanalytical personnel, and clinical personnel regarding study design, statistical analyses, pharmacokinetic data analyses, and data interpretation

  • Identify problems or potential problems in generating quality statistical and pharmacokinetic documents, report concerns to their supervisor, and propose possible solutions

  • Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all‑inclusive.

What your bring to the role

  • Familiarity with corporate policies, goals, and objectives, normally acquired after three months of exposure to Worldwide Clinical Trials’ operations

  • Understands and applies Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) guidelines and U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) guidance documents pertinent to statistical analysis, pharmacokinetic studies, pharmacokinetic analyses, and reports

  • Excellent SAS programming skills

  • Proficient in the use of WinNonlin, nQuery, Microsoft Word, and Microsoft Excel

  • Ability to read, write, and understand complex literature

  • Ability to write concise, understandable study reports and communicate clearly with clients and Worldwide Clinical Trials personnel

  • Ability to create, understand, and interpret graphs, tables, and charts

  • Strong organizational and problem‑solving skills and ability to set priorities

  • Ability to interact effectively with superiors, peers, and others and communicate ideas clearly

  • Ability to follow and implement Worldwide Clinical Trials’ policies and Standard Operating Procedures, normally associated with three months of experience at Worldwide Clinical Trials

Your experience

  • PhD or postgraduate degree with a scientific focus preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree with a scientific focus and 12 or more years of relevant work experience required

title: Lead Counsel, Controversies
description:
As a global leader in advanced mobility solutions, our outstanding team of legal professionals helps us navigate the continually changing legal and regulatory landscape. In our Office of General Counsel, you’ll be part of an organization that collaborates with outside counsel to operate as a global team and deliver world-class legal, tax and audit services to client groups throughout the company.

In this position…


Ford Motor Company’s Office of the General Counsel is seeking an outstanding attorney to join our Consumer Litigation Team in the Controversies Practice Group. A successful candidate for this position will demonstrate strong litigation capability, persuasive written and oral communication skills, as well as the ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams of business clients, internal legal colleagues, and outside counsel to effectively and strategically manage complex litigation matters.


Client counseling is also an essential part of this position. A successful candidate will demonstrate both business acumen and sound legal judgment to support and counsel Ford’s customer experience and field service organizations, and other business teams. The ability to align goals of the business and legal department, while managing tactical and day-to-day requirements in time-sensitive situations and challenging environments is key, as well as the ability to provide legal advice and training to company leaders in a business-friendly manner.


To keep pace with the changing industry and legal landscape, we are also seeking a candidate that can identify and execute creative strategies to do our work more efficiently and effectively. This will include helping to design and implement new technology solutions and AI tools to our practice.

What you’ll do…

You will provide strategic oversight of a portfolio of complex consumer litigation matters, which will include: retaining and managing outside counsel; driving the assessment of litigation risk, case strategies, and trial readiness; developing legal defenses; leading settlement negotiations; implementing new technology solutions and workflow automations to efficiently manage matters and reduce costs; managing arbitrations; and providing support, counseling, and training to business teams on legal risks, lessons learned, and risk mitigation strategies.


You will also regularly collaborate with other legal teams, including discovery, class actions, product litigation, consumer finance, regulatory, and more. Your Role as Clinical Supervisor:

The Clinical Supervisor is responsible for the supervision of a clinical team in an outpatient opioid treatment program (OTP) recovery environment. You will maintain standards of professional counseling practice in accordance with clinic policies and procedures. The Clinical Supervisor is responsible for directing care of patients, facilitating work flows, and serves as a resource for staff and providing team leadership.

  • Master’s Degree in behavioral or related field and 2 years of clinical experience in a health or human service agency;

  • Minimum 2 years of supervised substance use/addiction counseling experience is required

  • Leadership experience in addiction recovery or behavioral health settings, including outpatient, residential, or correctional facilities.

  • In-depth knowledge of Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) protocols and practices, including the use of methadone, buprenorphine, and naltrexone.

You will use your passion for data, background in problem solving, and customer engagement to advance the build of this platform and its associated environment.

What Your Day Might Include…

  • Working with the team to design and maintain the application's Postgres data model on AWS RDS, including schema design, indexing strategy, and query optimization.
  • Writing and reviewing SQLAlchemy models and queries, and developing Alembic migrations that run cleanly across environments.
  • Supporting the vector search and similarity search capabilities behind the application's generative AI features.
  • Helping build and maintain ingestion and embedding pipelines that integrate with AWS Bedrock, with inline verification and validation.
  • Supporting data flows for both structured relational data and unstructured document content.
  • Contributing to CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins and CloudBees.
  • Working within GitHub repositories and the team's code review process.
  • Evaluating data models and making optimization recommendations as usage and data volume grow.
  • Working within AWS GovCloud constraints, including IAM security and Role Based Access Control (RBAC).
  • Partnering closely with application engineers and other IT units to improve the overall computing environment.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years industry experience with software development projects and a passion for solving complex problems.
  • Expertise in Python.
  • Production experience with SQLAlchemy and Alembic, including writing and troubleshooting migrations against live databases.
  • Advanced working SQL knowledge with PostgreSQL specifically — query authoring, execution plan analysis, indexing, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with AWS serverless services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, S3) and AWS RDS.
  • Hands-on experience with vector search and embeddings — PGVector, OpenSearch Serverless, or a comparable vector store.
  • Experience integrating with AWS Bedrock or comparable LLM and embedding APIs.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with Jenkins and CloudBees, and working in GitHub-hosted repositories.
  • Experience with APIs (REST, JDBC) and data formats (JSON, XML, CSV).

title: ADMINISTRATIVE COORDINATOR 4
description:

In your role as an Administrative Coordinator with the Registrar of Voters Office, you will help to administer Louisiana's voter registration laws by maintaining accurate voters rolls and support election operations. If you are organized, detail-oriented, and eager to contribute to the democratic process, we encourage you to apply.

An ideal candidate should possess the following competencies:

  • Accepting Direction: The ability to be open and willing to follow guidance or instructions.
  • Following Policies and Procedures: The ability to follow, reinforce, adapt, or develop policies and procedures to maintain compliance with federal and state legal requirements, State Civil Service rules, and organizational policies.
  • Managing Resources: The ability to manage financial, physical, and contractual resources to ensure compliance and maximize business value.
  • Building and Supporting Teams: The ability to combine one’s actions and efforts with others to work toward achieving a common goal.

Minimum Qualifications

Three years of experience in administrative services.

EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION:
Every 15 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as six months of experience.

Job Specification

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

Job Duties and Other Information

Job Duties:

  • Supervise, direct, train, and assist staff on the procedures of registering voters, entering address, name, and/or party changes, in compliance with the Louisiana Election Code and the National Voters Registration Act.
  • Supervise, direct, train, and assist staff in procedure for researching and/or issuing challenges in compliance with the Louisiana Election Code and the National Voters Registration Act.
  • Supervise, direct, train, and assist staff in the verification process of voter registration and the completion of certificates of residence forms.
  • Supervise, direct, train, and assist staff in completing a variety of forms for registered voters from other agencies as requred or requested.
  • Supervise, direct, train, and assist staff in the annual voter Canvass, in conjunction with the Louisiana Secretary of State, and in compliance with the Louisiana Election Code.
  • Supervise, direct, train, and assist staff in all Absentee Voting and Early Voting procedures, as well as serve as an Early Voting Site Manager.
  • Supervise, direct, and assist staff with daily and monthly reports.
  • Research, review, and be knowledgeable of the Louisiana Election laws.
  • Research and provide statistical information upon request of the Registrar or his/her designee
  • Participate in Voter Outreach Programs.

Position-Specific Details:
Appointment Type: Probational or Promotional for permanent employees.
Overtime Requirements: For every election cycle, the selected applicant must be available to work on the two Saturdays during early voting, extended daily hours during early voting and also the day of the election which is normally a Saturday. Overtime is required to support other election operations such as the canvass, recall petitions, etc.

title: TV, Video, Audio & Display Senior Specialist
description:
Who we are:

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d love to hear from you if:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Senior Specialist, TV, Video, Audio & Display (TVAD), you will launch and improve TV, video, audio, and display campaigns to grow new customers and revenue - while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll follow clear Tinuiti Way practices, turn performance and media learnings into next actions, and pilot small, safe innovations before wider rollout. You’ll partner closely with Client Leadership, Analytics/Econometrics, Creative, and channel teams (Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media) in your Pod, communicate clearly with clients, and document what works so the team can reuse it. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key responsibilities

Client‑Centric

  • Prepare accurate, on‑time updates and contribute to QBR inputs; explain results and next steps in plain language tied to goals (reach, CAC/CPx, revenue/LTV).

  • Identify and recommend changes (budget, pacing, frequency cap adjustments, network mix) within guardrails, noting potential; trade‑offs.

The Tinuiti Way

  • Apply solid TVAD craft aligned with the Tinuiti Way (audience/data sources, inventory quality, frequency/overlap control, attention/quality) with growing multi‑channel awareness

  • Document simple “how‑to” guides others can reuse.

Product‑Led

  • Run small, safe pilots and monitor results before scaling.

  • Use team‑shared Bliss Point signals (Always‑On Incrementality, Brand/Creative/Customer Insights) to guide day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback for Product/Analytics partners.

Data & Measurement‑Driven

  • Monitor performance daily/weekly; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/Bs (or simple holdouts when feasible) with predefined success criteria and read cadence; keep budgets and pacing healthy.

  • Explain and advocate for Tinuiti's measurement and attribution framework to both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Support data/ops quality with checklists

Owner Mindset

  • Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time

  • Reduce rework and non‑converting spend (e.g., unmanaged frequency, low‑quality/IVT inventory, overlapping buys, tagging gaps)

Ways of working and values

  • Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, and embrace new tools and AI.

  • Clients grow, we grow: Focus on outcomes, evidence, and simple explanations.

  • Culture of ownership: Move fast, cut waste, and own results end‑to‑end.

Professional & Technical Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years running TV/video/audio/display with hands‑on builds, launches, pacing, and optimizations; or 3–5+ years in analytical roles (finance/consulting) with strong media analytics exposure.

  • Comfortable with GA4 and platform analytics; can turn data into clear next steps and simple forecasts; SQL a plus.

  • Familiar with testing basics (A/B, incrementality/lift at a high level) and statistical significance.

  • Strong communication: clear writing and presenting; effective partner to broader team and confident on weekly client calls with limited oversight.

KPIs

  • Growth: Contribute to qualified reach/new‑household acquisition and revenue/LTV from TVAD.

title: Senior Security Research Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Job Description:

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Security Research Engineer to join our Vulnerability Detection Signature Research team. In this role, you will research, develop, and deliver vulnerability detection signatures for our scanning products. You will investigate and resolve vulnerability scanning and detection issues that impact our customers, working within our sustenance research team to ensure expert handling of customer concerns and support escalations. Collaboration with cross-functional teams will be key to resolving complex challenges.

This position demands a strong technical foundation in vulnerability management, scanning tools, and security best practices, along with the ability to own problems end-to-end, mentor peers, and handle customer-facing issues with confidence.

Responsibilities

  • Research, develop, implement, and continuously improve vulnerability detections and scanning processes for our products.

  • Investigate, analyze, and troubleshoot vulnerability detection issues reported by customers, then modify the code to resolve these problems.

  • Participate in and help drive customer calls and meetings, ensuring that all issues are clearly understood and effectively addressed.

  • Dedicate time to staying up to date with the latest vulnerabilities, attacks, and countermeasures.

  • Help coordinate team tasks, prioritize work, and ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

  • Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across the team.

  • Explore, where valuable, how AI/ML techniques can accelerate research, development, and validation such as automated signature generation, false positive/negative reduction, anomaly detection, and triage of emerging vulnerabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in network and systems security.

  • BE/B.Tech/MCA, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Deep understanding of common protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP, SSH, SSL/TLS.

  • Strong knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques.

  • Hands-on experience with Python and Bash scripting.

  • Hands-on working experience with containers and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with network analysis tools and packet capture analysis.

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • System administration experience on Windows or Unix/Linux platforms.

  • Strong understanding of VPNs, Firewalls, and IDS/IPS technologies.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exposure to applying AI/ML to security problems - e.g., using machine learning for detection, classification, anomaly detection, or pattern recognition, or leveraging LLMs to automate research, code, or content-generation workflows.

  • Knowledge of Lua (preferred) or Java.

  • Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMWare, VirtualBox, XEN, etc.

  • Understanding of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud).

  • Experience using or developing vulnerability scanners, IDS/IPS, and other security tools.

  • Prior experience building security-related tools or automation.

  • Industry certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, and GIAC.

  • Ability to lead projects independently and work with minimal supervision.

title: Payment Integrity Analyst
description:
Position Summary

The Facets Payment Integrity Analyst is responsible for supporting payment accuracy, claim cost containment, and payment integrity initiatives within a health plan environment. This role leverages expertise in the TriZetto Facets platform, claims processing, provider reimbursement, and payment integrity methodologies to identify, investigate, and resolve claims payment discrepancies. The analyst collaborates with Claims Operations, Configuration, Provider Network, Compliance, Finance, and Vendor partners to ensure accurate claim adjudication and recovery of overpayments while maintaining regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Payment Integrity & Claims Analysis

  • Analyze medical, behavioral health, and ancillary claims to identify payment inaccuracies, overpayments, underpayments, and billing irregularities.
  • Perform pre-payment and post-payment claim reviews to ensure adherence to benefit plans, provider contracts, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Investigate payment integrity opportunities including duplicate claims, unbundling, upcoding, incorrect coding, coordination of benefits (COB), and provider billing discrepancies.
  • Research and document root causes of payment errors and recommend corrective actions.

Facets System Support

  • Utilize the Facets claims processing platform to analyze claims transactions, benefit plans, provider contracts, and payment outcomes.
  • Review claim adjudication logic and identify configuration issues impacting payment accuracy.
  • Partner with Configuration and IT teams to validate system changes, enhancements, and payment integrity initiatives.
  • Support testing and quality assurance activities related to Facets enhancements, benefit updates, and reimbursement changes.

Recovery & Cost Containment

  • Identify and quantify overpayment recovery opportunities.
  • Coordinate with recovery vendors and internal teams to facilitate recovery efforts and track results.
  • Monitor payment integrity savings and recovery performance metrics.
  • Assist in developing strategies that reduce future payment errors and improve first-pass claims accuracy.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and trend analyses related to claims payment performance and integrity initiatives.
  • Analyze large data sets to identify payment patterns, emerging risks, and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Present findings and recommendations to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including recoveries, savings, claim accuracy, and audit outcomes.

Compliance & Collaboration

  • Ensure compliance with CMS, state, federal, and health plan regulations.
  • Collaborate with Claims, Provider Relations, Utilization Management, Finance, Compliance, and Vendor partners.
  • Participate in internal and external audits related to claims payment accuracy.
  • Support special projects and process improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Finance, Information Systems, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience in health plan claims operations, payment integrity, claims auditing, or healthcare reimbursement.
  • Hands-on experience with the TriZetto Facets platform.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare claims processing, provider reimbursement methodologies, and benefit plan structures.
  • Experience analyzing medical claims data and payment outcomes.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plans.
  • Knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, DRG, and revenue codes.
  • Experience with payment integrity vendors and recovery programs.
  • SQL, SAS, Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics/reporting tools.
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA), or similar certification.
  • Experience supporting healthcare regulatory audits and compliance initiatives.

Key Competencies

  • Payment Integrity Expertise
  • Facets Claims Processing Knowledge
  • Data Analysis and Reporting
  • Healthcare Reimbursement
  • Critical Thinking
  • Process Improvement
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Attention to Detail

description:

With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

This position is responsible for leading strategic client relationships, overseeing operational delivery, driving project performance, and ensuring the highest standards of pharmacovigilance quality and regulatory compliance.

You will serve as a trusted partner to clients and internal stakeholders, providing expertise across project planning, financial oversight, process optimization, and patient safety operations.
